			function tryAutoDetectIndices(points) {
			  const samples = [];
			  points.forEach(p => p.segments.forEach(s => samples.push(s.data)));
			  if (!samples.length) return;

			  const maxLen = Math.max(...samples.map(a => a.length));
			  const stats = Array.from({length: maxLen}, () => ({
				count:0, finite:0, zeros:0,
				min:+Infinity, max:-Infinity,
				frac01:0, porRange:0, satRange:0,
				KRange:0, TRange:0, permRange:0,
				binaryish:0, yieldLikely:0
			  }));

			  for (const row of samples) {
				for (let j = 0; j < row.length; j++) {
				  const v = row[j], st = stats[j];
				  st.count++;
				  if (typeof v === "number" && isFinite(v)) {
					st.finite++;
					if (v === 0) st.zeros++;
					if (v < st.min) st.min = v;
					if (v > st.max) st.max = v;
					if (v === 0 || v === 1) st.binaryish++;
					if (v >= 0 && v <= 1) st.frac01++;
					if (v >= 0.02 && v <= 0.35) st.porRange++;
					if (v >= 0.60 && v <= 1.00) st.satRange++;
					if (v >= 1e-9 && v <= 1e-2) st.KRange++;
					if (v >= 1e-7 && v <= 1e-1) st.TRange++;
					if (v >= 1e-20 && v <= 1e-12) st.permRange++;
					if (v >= 0.01 && v <= 1000) st.yieldLikely++;
				  }
				}
			  }

			  const pick = (scoreFn) => {
				let best = { idx:null, score:-1 };
				stats.forEach((st, j) => {
				  const score = scoreFn(st, j);
				  if (score > best.score) best = { idx:j, score };
				});
				return best.score > 0 ? best.idx : null;
			  };

			  CONFIG.POROSITY_INDEX ??= pick(st => st.porRange - 0.2*st.zeros);
			  CONFIG.SATURATION_INDEX ??= pick(st => st.satRange - 0.2*st.zeros);
			  CONFIG.HYDRAULIC_COND_INDEX ??= pick(st => st.KRange - 0.2*st.zeros);
			  CONFIG.TRANSMISSIVITY_INDEX ??= pick(st => st.TRange - 0.2*st.zeros);
			  CONFIG.PERMEABILITY_INDEX ??= pick(st => st.permRange - 0.2*st.zeros);
			  CONFIG.YIELD_INDEX ??= pick(st => (st.yieldLikely - st.KRange - st.TRange - 0.1*st.permRange));
			}

			function tryAutoDetectPointYieldIndex(pointRawVectors) {
			  let candidateIdx = null, bestScore = -1;
			  for (let j = 0; j < pointRawVectors.length; j++) {
				const vec = pointRawVectors[j];
				if (!Array.isArray(vec) || Array.isArray(vec[0])) continue;
				const nums = vec.filter(v => typeof v === "number" && isFinite(v));
				if (!nums.length || nums.length > 64) continue;
				const within = nums.filter(v => v >= 0.01 && v <= 10000).length;
				const kLike  = nums.filter(v => v >= 1e-9 && v <= 1e-2).length;
				const tLike  = nums.filter(v => v >= 1e-7 && v <= 1e-1).length;
				const score = within - 0.5*kLike - 0.5*tLike;
				if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; candidateIdx = j; }
			  }
			  return bestScore > 0 ? candidateIdx : null;
			}

			function projectToLocalXY(points) {
			  if (!points.length) return;
			  const lat0 = points[0].lat * Math.PI / 180, lon0 = points[0].lon * Math.PI / 180;
			  const R = 6371000;
			  points.forEach(p => {
				const lat = p.lat * Math.PI / 180, lon = p.lon * Math.PI / 180;
				p.x = R * (lon - lon0) * Math.cos(lat0);
				p.y = R * (lat - lat0);
			  });
			}
			function euclid(a,b){ return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y); }
			function convexHull(points) {
			  if (points.length <= 1) return points.slice();
			  const pts = points.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.x===b.x ? a.y-b.y : a.x-b.x);
			  const lower = [];
			  for (const p of pts) {
				while (lower.length >= 2) {
				  const q = lower[lower.length-1], r = lower[lower.length-2];
				  if ((q.x-r.x)*(p.y-r.y) - (q.y-r.y)*(p.x-r.x) <= 0) lower.pop(); else break;
				}
				lower.push(p);
			  }
			  const upper = [];
			  for (let i = pts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
				const p = pts[i];
				while (upper.length >= 2) {
				  const q = upper[upper.length-1], r = upper[upper.length-2];
				  if ((q.x-r.x)*(p.y-r.y) - (q.y-r.y)*(p.x-r.x) <= 0) upper.pop(); else break;
				}
				upper.push(p);
			  }
			  upper.pop(); lower.pop();
			  return lower.concat(upper);
			}
			function polygonArea(poly){
			  if (!poly || poly.length < 3) return 0;
			  let area = 0;
			  for (let i=0, j=poly.length-1; i<poly.length; j=i++){
				area += (poly[j].x + poly[i].x) * (poly[j].y - poly[i].y);
			  }
			  return Math.abs(area) * 0.5;
			}

			function extractPointsFromBoxData(BoxData) {
			  const out = [];
			  const rows = BoxData && BoxData.data ? BoxData.data : [];
			  for (const row of rows) {
				const id = row[0], lat = row[1], lon = row[2];

				// find the first child array that looks like the interval matrix
				let segments = null, intervalIndex = -1;
				for (let i = 3; i < row.length; i++) {
				  const candidate = row[i];
				  if (Array.isArray(candidate) && candidate.length && Array.isArray(candidate[0]) &&
					  typeof candidate[0][0] === "number" && typeof candidate[0][1] === "number") {
					segments = candidate; intervalIndex = i; break;
				  }
				}
				if (!segments) continue;

				const point = {
				  id, lat, lon, raw: row,
				  childArraysBeforeIntervals: row.slice(3, intervalIndex).filter(a => Array.isArray(a)),
				  segments: segments.map((seg, idx) => ({ idx, top: seg[0], base: seg[1], data: seg }))
				};
				out.push(point);
			  }
			  projectToLocalXY(out);

			  // try to auto-detect per-point yield vector index
			  if (CONFIG.POINT_YIELD_INDEX == null) {
				const pool = [];
				out.forEach(p => { pool.push(...p.childArraysBeforeIntervals); });
				CONFIG.POINT_YIELD_INDEX = tryAutoDetectPointYieldIndex(pool);
			  }

			  return out;
			}

			function buildAdjacency(points, k=4, cap=null) {
			  if (cap == null) {
				const nnd = [];
				for (const p of points) {
				  let best = Infinity;
				  for (const q of points) {
					if (q === p) continue;
					const d = euclid(p,q);
					if (d < best) best = d;
				  }
				  if (isFinite(best)) nnd.push(best);
				}
				nnd.sort((a,b)=>a-b);
				const med = nnd.length ? nnd[Math.floor(nnd.length/2)] : 0;
				cap = med ? med * 1.5 : Infinity;
			  }
			  const adj = new Map(points.map(p => [String(p.id), new Set()]));
			  points.forEach(p => {
				const neighbors = points
				  .filter(q => q.id !== p.id)
				  .map(q => ({ id:String(q.id), d:euclid(p,q) }))
				  .filter(o => o.d <= cap)
				  .sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d)
				  .slice(0, k);
				neighbors.forEach(n => { adj.get(String(p.id)).add(n.id); adj.get(n.id).add(String(p.id)); });
			  });
			  return adj;
			}

			function overlapsAtDepth(segA, segB, centerTol, overlapTol) {
			  const aMid = (segA.top + segA.base) * 0.5;
			  const bMid = (segB.top + segB.base) * 0.5;
			  const centerAligned = Math.abs(aMid - bMid) <= centerTol;
			  const overlap = Math.min(segA.base, segB.base) - Math.max(segA.top, segB.top);
			  const verticallyOverlapped = overlap >= -overlapTol;
			  return centerAligned && verticallyOverlapped;
			}

			function linkIntervals(points, pointSegMap, adj, cfg) {
			  const nodes = [];
			  const edges = [];
			  for (const p of points) {
				const segs = pointSegMap.get(String(p.id)) || [];
				segs.forEach((seg, i) => nodes.push({ key:`${p.id}#${i}`, pid:String(p.id), segIdx:i, seg }));
			  }
			  for (const p of points) {
				const pid = String(p.id);
				const nbrs = adj.get(pid) || new Set();
				const A = pointSegMap.get(pid) || [];
				for (const nid of nbrs) {
				  if (pid > nid) continue; // avoid double adding
				  const B = pointSegMap.get(nid) || [];
				  A.forEach((a, ia) => {
					B.forEach((b, ib) => {
					  if (overlapsAtDepth(a,b,cfg.depthCenterTolerance_m,cfg.verticalOverlapTolerance_m)) {
						edges.push([`${pid}#${ia}`, `${nid}#${ib}`]);
					  }
					});
				  });
				}
			  }
			  return { nodes, edges };
			}

			function connectedComponents(nodes, edges) {
			  const g = new Map(nodes.map(n => [n.key, new Set()]));
			  edges.forEach(([u,v]) => { g.get(u).add(v); g.get(v).add(u); });
			  const seen = new Set(), out = [];
			  for (const n of nodes) {
				if (seen.has(n.key)) continue;
				const comp = [];
				const stack = [n.key];
				seen.add(n.key);
				while (stack.length) {
				  const u = stack.pop();
				  comp.push(u);
				  g.get(u).forEach(v => { if (!seen.has(v)) { seen.add(v); stack.push(v); } });
				}
				out.push(comp);
			  }
			  return out.map(keys => keys.map(k => nodes.find(n => n.key === k)));
			}

			function segField(d, idx){ return (idx!=null && typeof d[idx]==="number" && isFinite(d[idx])) ? d[idx] : null; }

			function detectBodies(points, cfg) {
			  const aquiferSegs = new Map(), fractureSegs = new Map();

			  points.forEach(p => {
				const a = [], f = [];
				p.segments.forEach(seg => {
				  const th = Math.max(0, seg.base - seg.top);
				  const d  = seg.data;

				  // explicit fracture flag?
				  const flagFrac = (cfg.FRACTURE_FLAG_INDEX!=null) && (d[cfg.FRACTURE_FLAG_INDEX]===1 || d[cfg.FRACTURE_FLAG_INDEX]===true);

				  // geologic fracture heuristics
				  const por = segField(d, CONFIG.POROSITY_INDEX);
				  const K   = segField(d, CONFIG.HYDRAULIC_COND_INDEX);
				  const T   = segField(d, CONFIG.TRANSMISSIVITY_INDEX);
				  const thin = th <= cfg.minFractureThickness_m;
				  const highK_lowPor = (K!=null && K>=cfg.fractureKThreshold_m_s) && (por==null || por<=cfg.maxFracturePorosity);
				  const highTperTh   = (T!=null && th>0 && (T/th)>=cfg.highTperTh_m_s);

				  const isFractureLike = flagFrac || thin || highK_lowPor || highTperTh;

				  if (isFractureLike) {
					f.push(seg);                  // classify as fracture candidate
				  } else if (cfg.isAquiferSegment(d)) {
					a.push(seg);                  // classify as aquifer candidate
				  }
				  // Note: by design, a segment cannot be both to avoid identical results
				});
				aquiferSegs.set(String(p.id), a);
				fractureSegs.set(String(p.id), f);
			  });

			  const adj = buildAdjacency(points, cfg.kNearest, cfg.neighborDistanceCap_m);

			  const A = linkIntervals(points, aquiferSegs, adj, cfg);
			  const F = linkIntervals(points, fractureSegs, adj, cfg);

			  const aquifers = connectedComponents(A.nodes, A.edges)
				.map(members => {
				  const uniq = new Set(members.map(m => m.pid));
				  return uniq.size >= cfg.minAquiferPoints ? { members } : null;
				})
				.filter(Boolean);

			  const fractures = connectedComponents(F.nodes, F.edges)
				.map(members => {
				  const uniq = new Set(members.map(m => m.pid));
				  return uniq.size >= cfg.minFracturePoints ? { members } : null;
				})
				.filter(Boolean);

			  return { aquifers, fractures };
			}

			function summarizeBody(body, points, cfg) {
			  const pointMap = new Map();
			  body.members.forEach(m => {
				const point = points.find(p => String(p.id) === m.pid);
				if (!pointMap.has(m.pid)) pointMap.set(m.pid, { point, segs: [] });
				pointMap.get(m.pid).segs.push(m.seg);
			  });
			  const pts = Array.from(pointMap.values()).map(v => v.point);
			  const hull = convexHull(pts);
			  const area_m2 = polygonArea(hull);

			  let minTop = +Infinity, maxBase = -Infinity;
			  const thicknesses = [], wPorVals = [], wSatVals = [], wK = [], wT = [], wkPerm = [];
			  const allK = [], allYields = [];

			  body.members.forEach(m => {
				const s = m.seg;
				const th = Math.max(0, s.base - s.top);
				if (s.top < minTop) minTop = s.top;
				if (s.base > maxBase) maxBase = s.base;
				thicknesses.push(th);

				const d = s.data;
				const por = segField(d, CONFIG.POROSITY_INDEX);
				const sat = segField(d, CONFIG.SATURATION_INDEX);
				const K   = segField(d, CONFIG.HYDRAULIC_COND_INDEX);
				const T   = segField(d, CONFIG.TRANSMISSIVITY_INDEX);
				const kpm = segField(d, CONFIG.PERMEABILITY_INDEX);
				const yld = segField(d, CONFIG.YIELD_INDEX);

				if (typeof por === "number") wPorVals.push({v:por, w:th});
				if (typeof sat === "number") wSatVals.push({v:sat, w:th});
				if (typeof K   === "number") { wK.push({v:K, w:th}); allK.push(K); }
				if (typeof T   === "number") wT.push({v:T, w:th});
				if (typeof kpm === "number") wkPerm.push({v:kpm, w:th});
				if (typeof yld === "number") allYields.push({ value:yld, pointId:m.pid, seg:m.seg });
			  });

			  function wMean(arr) {
				if (!arr.length) return null;
				const sw = arr.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.w,0) || 1;
				return arr.reduce((s,o)=>s+o.v*o.w,0) / sw;
			  }
			  function median(arr) {
				if (!arr.length) return null;
				const a = arr.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y);
				const i = Math.floor(a.length/2);
				return (a.length%2) ? a[i] : (a[i-1]+a[i])/2;
			  }

			  const medThick = median(thicknesses) || 0;
			  const por = (wPorVals.length ? wMean(wPorVals) : CONFIG.defaultPorosity);
			  const sat = (wSatVals.length ? wMean(wSatVals) : CONFIG.defaultSaturation);
			  const Kavg = (wK.length ? wMean(wK) : CONFIG.defaultK_m_s);
			  const Tavg = (wT.length ? wMean(wT) : (Kavg!=null ? Kavg*(medThick||1) : CONFIG.defaultT_m2_s));
			  const k_perm = (wkPerm.length ? wMean(wkPerm) : CONFIG.defaultPermeability_m2);

			  const volume_m3 = area_m2 * (medThick || 0);
			  const waterVolume_m3 = volume_m3 * (por||0) * (sat||0);

			  const Kmin = (allK.length ? Math.min(...allK) : Kavg);
			  const Kmax = (allK.length ? Math.max(...allK) : Kavg);

			  // Yield sources: interval yields; else per-point vector; else notional from T
			  let yieldRecords = allYields.slice();

			  if (!yieldRecords.length && CONFIG.POINT_YIELD_INDEX != null) {
				for (const v of pointMap.values()) {
				  const vec = v.point.childArraysBeforeIntervals[CONFIG.POINT_YIELD_INDEX];
				  if (Array.isArray(vec)) {
					const nums = vec.filter(n => typeof n === "number" && isFinite(n) && n >= 0.01 && n <= 10000);
					if (nums.length) {
					  const best = Math.max(...nums);
					  yieldRecords.push({ value: best, pointId:String(v.point.id), seg:null });
					}
				  }
				}
			  }

			  if (!yieldRecords.length) {
				const lnR = CONFIG.fallbackLn_R_over_rw;
				const s0  = CONFIG.fallbackDrawdown_m;
				for (const m of body.members) {
				  const d = m.seg.data;
				  const Kseg = segField(d, CONFIG.HYDRAULIC_COND_INDEX) ?? Kavg ?? CONFIG.defaultK_m_s;
				  const Tseg = segField(d, CONFIG.TRANSMISSIVITY_INDEX) ?? (Kseg * Math.max(0, m.seg.base - m.seg.top));
				  const Q = 2*Math.PI*(Tseg||0)*s0/lnR; // m³/s
				  const Q_lps = Q*1000;
				  yieldRecords.push({ value: Q_lps, pointId:m.pid, seg:m.seg, notional:true });
				}
			  }

			  const yVals = yieldRecords.map(r => r.value).filter(v => typeof v === "number" && isFinite(v));
			  const yMin = yVals.length ? Math.min(...yVals) : null;
			  const yMax = yVals.length ? Math.max(...yVals) : null;
			  const yAvg = yVals.length ? (yVals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/yVals.length) : null;

			  let bestYield = null;
			  for (const r of yieldRecords) { if (!bestYield || r.value > bestYield.value) bestYield = r; }

			  const prov = {
				porosity: (CONFIG.POROSITY_INDEX != null) ? "mapped" : (wPorVals.length ? "auto-detected" : "default"),
				saturation: (CONFIG.SATURATION_INDEX != null) ? "mapped" : (wSatVals.length ? "auto-detected" : "default"),
				K: (CONFIG.HYDRAULIC_COND_INDEX != null) ? "mapped" : (yVals.length || allK.length ? "auto-detected" : "default"),
				T: (CONFIG.TRANSMISSIVITY_INDEX != null) ? "mapped" : (isFinite(Tavg) ? "auto-detected/derived" : "—"),
				k_perm: (CONFIG.PERMEABILITY_INDEX != null) ? "mapped" : (isFinite(k_perm) ? "auto-detected" : "—"),
				yield: (CONFIG.YIELD_INDEX != null || CONFIG.POINT_YIELD_INDEX != null) ? "mapped" : "notional"
			  };

			  return {
				points: pts,
				pointCount: pts.length,
				area_m2,
				thickness_m: medThick,
				depthTop_m: minTop,
				depthBase_m: maxBase,
				volume_m3,
				waterVolume_m3,
				porosity: por,
				saturation: sat,
				K_m_s_avg: Kavg,
				K_m_s_min: Kmin,
				K_m_s_max: Kmax,
				T_m2_s_avg: Tavg,
				permeability_m2: k_perm,
				yield_lps_min: yMin,
				yield_lps_max: yMax,
				yield_lps_avg: yAvg,
				bestYieldPointId: bestYield ? bestYield.pointId : null,
				yieldNotional: bestYield ? !!bestYield.notional : false,
				fieldProvenance: prov
			  };
			}

			function sitePropertyStats(points){
			  const rows = points.flatMap(p => p.segments.map(s => s.data));
			  function scanRange(lo, hi){
				const vals=[];
				for (const r of rows){
				  for (const v of r){
					const n = Number(v);
					if (isFinite(n) && n>=lo && n<=hi) vals.push(n);
				  }
				}
				return vals;
			  }
			  function summary(arr){
				if (!arr.length) return { n:0 };
				const s = arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b);
				const n = s.length;
				const q = p => {
				  const i=(n-1)*p, i0=Math.floor(i), i1=Math.ceil(i);
				  return i0===i1 ? s[i0] : s[i0]*(i1-i)+s[i1]*(i-i0);
				};
				const mean = s.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/n;
				const lo = s[0], hi = s[n-1];
				let sd2=0; for (const v of s){ sd2+=(v-mean)*(v-mean); }
				const sd = Math.sqrt(sd2/Math.max(1,n-1));
				const cv = mean!==0 ? sd/Math.abs(mean) : null;
				return { n, mean, median:q(0.5), p25:q(0.25), p75:q(0.75), lo, hi, sd, cv };
			  }

			  return {
				density:   summary(scanRange(1200,3000)),   // kg/m³
				porosity:  summary(scanRange(0.02,0.45)),   // fraction
				shearGPa:  summary(scanRange(0.1,40)),      // GPa
				bulkGPa:   summary(scanRange(0.1,80)),      // GPa
				youngGPa:  summary(scanRange(0.1,120)),     // GPa
				compress:  summary(scanRange(1e-11,1e-8))   // Pa^-1
				// Electrical stats intentionally omitted from use in the narrative
			  };
			}

			function safe(n){ return (n==null||!isFinite(n)) ? null : n; }
			function formatNumber(n, digits=1){ n=safe(n); if(n==null)return "—"; const a=Math.abs(n); if(a>=1e6)return (n/1e6).toFixed(digits)+" million"; if(a>=1e3)return (n/1e3).toFixed(digits)+" thousand"; return n.toFixed(digits); }
			function formatMeters(n,d=1){ n=safe(n); return n==null?"—":n.toFixed(d)+" metres"; }
			function formatM2(n){ n=safe(n); return n==null?"—":n.toFixed(0)+" m²"; }
			function formatM3(n){ n=safe(n); return n==null?"—":n.toFixed(0)+" m³"; }
			function pct(x){ x=safe(x); return x==null?"—":(x*100).toFixed(0)+"%"; }
			function formatK(K){ K=safe(K); return K==null?"—":(K<1e-3?K.toExponential(2)+" m/s":K.toFixed(4)+" m/s"); }
			function formatT(T){ T=safe(T); return T==null?"—":(T<1e-3?T.toExponential(2)+" m²/s":T.toFixed(4)+" m²/s"); }
			function formatPerm(k){ k=safe(k); return k==null?"—":k.toExponential(2)+" m²"; }
			function formatLps(q,d=1){ q=safe(q); return q==null?"—":q.toFixed(d)+" L/s"; }
			function listPointIds(points){ return points.map(p=>p.id).join(", "); }

			function composeReport(points, aquifers, fractures) {
			  const hull = convexHull(points);
			  const siteArea = polygonArea(hull);

			  const aStats = aquifers.map(a => summarizeBody(a, points, CONFIG));
			  const fStats = fractures.map(f => summarizeBody(f, points, CONFIG));

			  const rankedA = aStats.map((s,i)=>({...s,_i:i})).sort((a,b)=>b.area_m2 - a.area_m2);
			  const rankedF = fStats.map((s,i)=>({...s,_i:i})).sort((a,b)=>b.area_m2 - a.area_m2);

			  const topA = rankedA.slice(0, CONFIG.topAquifersN);
			  const topF = rankedF.slice(0, CONFIG.topFractureN);

			  const SP = sitePropertyStats(points);

			  const parts = [];
			  parts.push(
				`<div class="title">Hydrogeological Assessment</div>`
			  );

			  parts.push(
				`<div class="section"><div class="subtitle">Executive Overview</div>` +
				`<div class="para">The survey encompasses approximately ${formatM2(siteArea)} in plan view. Within this footprint, the processing pipeline identified ${aStats.length} discrete aquifer bodies that satisfy the adjacency rule (a continuous horizon correlated between at least three neighbouring points at the same depth range, without intervening gaps). For readability, the discussion below focuses on the ten largest aquifers by plan-view footprint. In addition, ${fStats.length} distinct fracture networks were recognised; the ten most extensive are summarised after the aquifers.</div>` +
				`</div>`
			  );

			  parts.push(`<div class="section"><div class="subtitle">Principal Aquifers</div>`);
			  topA.forEach((s, idx) => {
				const prov = s.fieldProvenance;
				parts.push(
				  `<div class="para"><strong>Aquifer ${idx+1}.</strong> This aquifer is laterally continuous across ${s.pointCount} survey points (IDs ${listPointIds(s.points)}). It is encountered between approximately ${formatMeters(s.depthTop_m,1)} and ${formatMeters(s.depthBase_m,1)} below ground level, with a characteristic saturated thickness near ${formatMeters(s.thickness_m,1)}. The plan-view footprint is about ${formatM2(s.area_m2)}, yielding a formation volume on the order of ${formatM3(s.volume_m3)}. Based on ${prov.porosity} porosity and ${prov.saturation} saturation, the representative values are ${pct(s.porosity)} and ${pct(s.saturation)}, which imply an in-place water volume of roughly ${formatM3(s.waterVolume_m3)}.</div>` +
				  `<div class="para">Hydraulic properties for the correlated body indicate a bulk hydraulic conductivity averaging ${formatK(s.K_m_s_avg)} (${prov.K}), ranging from ${formatK(s.K_m_s_min)} to ${formatK(s.K_m_s_max)} across intersecting intervals. The corresponding transmissivity averages ${formatT(s.T_m2_s_avg)} (${prov.T}), while the intrinsic permeability is ${formatPerm(s.permeability_m2)} (${prov.k_perm}).</div>` +
				  `<div class="para">Yields within this aquifer ${prov.yield === "notional" ? "are estimated from transmissivity using a standard constant-drawdown relation" : "are drawn from mapped yield fields"}: individual interval yields span ${formatLps(s.yield_lps_min)} to ${formatLps(s.yield_lps_max)}, with a mean near ${formatLps(s.yield_lps_avg)}. The highest intersecting yield is associated with point ${s.bestYieldPointId ?? "—"}. (${prov.yield}.)</div>`
				);
			  });
			  if (aStats.length > CONFIG.topAquifersN) {
				parts.push(`<div class="para muted">Note: ${aStats.length} aquifers were detected in total; only the ten largest are summarised here.</div>`);
			  }
			  parts.push(`</div>`);

			  parts.push(`<div class="section"><div class="subtitle">Fracture Networks</div>`);
			  if (!topF.length){
				parts.push(`<div class="para">No fracture network satisfied the three-point connectivity threshold. Localised fractures may be present but are not traceable between points at the current tolerances.</div>`);
			  } else {
				topF.forEach((s, idx) => {
				  const prov = s.fieldProvenance;
				  parts.push(
					`<div class="para"><strong>Fracture network ${idx+1}.</strong> Intersections occur at points ${listPointIds(s.points)}. The network spans roughly ${formatM2(s.area_m2)} in plan view, within a depth window of approximately ${formatMeters(s.depthTop_m,1)} to ${formatMeters(s.depthBase_m,1)} below ground level. The correlated thickness is near ${formatMeters(s.thickness_m,1)}. Using ${prov.porosity} porosity and ${prov.saturation} saturation, the gross rock volume of about ${formatM3(s.volume_m3)} corresponds to an indicative water-in-fracture volume of approximately ${formatM3(s.waterVolume_m3)}. Hydraulic properties average ${formatK(s.K_m_s_avg)} for conductivity and ${formatT(s.T_m2_s_avg)} for transmissivity, with intrinsic permeability around ${formatPerm(s.permeability_m2)}.</div>` +
					`<div class="para">Yields along the fracture network ${prov.yield === "notional" ? "are estimated where direct values are absent" : "are sourced from mapped yield fields"}: interval-scale yields range from ${formatLps(s.yield_lps_min)} to ${formatLps(s.yield_lps_max)}, averaging around ${formatLps(s.yield_lps_avg)}. The highest intersecting yield is recorded at point ${s.bestYieldPointId ?? "—"}. (${prov.yield}.)</div>`
				  );
				});
				if (fStats.length > CONFIG.topFractureN) {
				  parts.push(`<div class="para muted">Note: ${fStats.length} fracture networks were detected in total; only the ten largest are summarised here.</div>`);
				}
			  }
			  parts.push(`</div>`);

			  const allDepths = points.flatMap(p => p.segments.flatMap(s => [s.top, s.base]));
			  const siteTop = allDepths.length ? Math.min(...allDepths) : null;
			  const siteBase = allDepths.length ? Math.max(...allDepths) : null;
			  const aqTopDepths = topA.map(a => a.depthTop_m).filter(isFinite);
			  const aqBaseDepths= topA.map(a => a.depthBase_m).filter(isFinite);
			  const aqThMean    = topA.map(a => a.thickness_m).filter(isFinite);
			  function pctl(A, p){ if(!A.length) return NaN; const s=A.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y); const i=(s.length-1)*p, i0=Math.floor(i), i1=Math.ceil(i); return i0===i1?s[i0]:s[i0]*(i1-i)+s[i1]*(i-i0); }

			  parts.push(
				`<div class="section"><div class="subtitle">Lithology</div>` +
				`<div class="para">The interpreted vertical column extends from approximately ${formatMeters(siteTop,1)} to ${formatMeters(siteBase,1)} below ground level. Within this column, the correlated aquifers form discrete, layer-parallel bodies rather than broad composite packages. Median aquifer tops cluster near ${formatMeters(pctl(aqTopDepths,0.5),1)}, with bases around ${formatMeters(pctl(aqBaseDepths,0.5),1)}. Typical saturated thicknesses are modest (median ~${formatMeters(pctl(aqThMean,0.5),1)}), which is consistent with interbedded permeable units that pinch and swell laterally over short to intermediate distances.</div>` +
				`<div class="para">A laterally coherent yet thin geometry suggests deposition in environments capable of producing sheet-like permeability contrasts, such as fine- to medium-grained fluvial sheets, shoreline sand bodies reworked by waves, or weathered horizons developed above competent bedrock. The mapping shows that where an intervening point fails to exhibit the same depth signal, the connected body is segmented as a separate aquifer; this reflects real stratigraphic discontinuities, lensing, or small-throw structures rather than a single continuous unit.</div>` +
				`<div class="para">Observed fracture networks are preferentially associated with thin intervals and sharp vertical contrasts, implying joints, partings, or re-opened bedding in relatively stiff horizons. These structures locally enhance vertical connectivity and may allow pressure communication between otherwise weakly connected porous layers. Where fractures and porous horizons coincide, transmissivity is locally amplified; where they cut across tight benches, they provide restricted conduits that taper laterally.</div>` +
				`<div class="para">The mechanical context inferred from the dataset supports this framework: stiffer benches (higher moduli, lower compressibility) behave as aquitards and confine thinner permeable horizons above and below. More compliant, higher-porosity material accommodates storage and provides the bulk of specific yield. Depth trends—thinner transmissive bodies at greater depth and broader, more weathered units near surface—are consistent with progressive lithification and reduced primary porosity down-section, with fracture-controlled flow becoming relatively more important with depth.</div>` +
				`<div class="para">Taken together, these patterns point to a stratified aquifer system: stacked, laterally persistent to lenticular sandy or weathered units separated by tighter siltstone, mudstone, or cemented rock layers. Minor structural features (small-offset faults, flexures) are suggested where correlation breaks over short distances; their hydraulic significance is likely localised and best tested with targeted borehole geophysics and packer testing at aquifer tops and bases.</div>` +
				`</div>`
			  );

			  function propParagraph(name, unit, S, interpret){
				if (!S || !S.n) return `<div class="para">No explicit ${name.toLowerCase()} values were identified in the uploaded attributes. The discussion below therefore remains qualitative for this property.</div>`;
				const to3 = v => (v==null||!isFinite(v)) ? "—" : v.toFixed(3);
				const spread = (S.lo!=null && S.hi!=null && isFinite(S.lo) && isFinite(S.hi)) ? `, spanning roughly ${to3(S.lo)} to ${to3(S.hi)} ${unit}` : ``;
				const quart  = (S.p25!=null && S.p75!=null && isFinite(S.p25) && isFinite(S.p75)) ? `; the interquartile range lies between ${to3(S.p25)} and ${to3(S.p75)} ${unit}` : ``;
				const cvTxt  = (S.cv!=null && isFinite(S.cv)) ? ` (coefficient of variation ≈ ${S.cv.toFixed(2)})` : ``;
				const nTxt   = `based on ${S.n} sample${S.n===1?'':'s'}`;
				const meanTxt= (isFinite(S.mean)) ? ` The arithmetic mean is ${to3(S.mean)} ${unit}${cvTxt}.` : ``;
				const medTxt = (isFinite(S.median)) ? S.median.toFixed(3) : "—";
				const interp = interpret ? ` ${interpret}` : ``;
				return `<div class="para">The median ${name.toLowerCase()} is approximately ${medTxt} ${unit}${spread}${quart}, ${nTxt}.${meanTxt}${interp}</div>`;
			  }

			  parts.push(
				`<div class="section"><div class="subtitle">Geotechnical Data</div>` +
				`<div class="para">Bulk density and porosity vary with depth and facies. Near-surface materials typically show lower density and higher effective porosity; both trends invert with depth as lithification and cementation increase. Shear and Young’s moduli trend upward down-section, reflecting a transition from weathered to competent rock, while compressibility decreases. Mechanically stronger benches act as aquitards that bound and compartmentalise thinner transmissive layers.</div>` +
				propParagraph('Bulk density','kg/m³', SP.density, ' Higher densities generally coincide with tighter, lower-porosity matrices and reduced primary storage.') +
				propParagraph('Porosity','fraction', SP.porosity, ' Effective porosity governs specific yield and storage. Higher porosity zones align with the mapped aquifer intervals and contribute disproportionately to pumping response.') +
				propParagraph('Shear modulus','GPa', SP.shearGPa, ' Higher values indicate better borehole stability and reduced deformation around screens; lower values may be associated with weathered or clay-rich units.') +
				propParagraph('Bulk modulus','GPa', SP.bulkGPa, ' Volumetric stiffness increases with depth and cementation, reducing the likelihood of settlement under drawdown.') +
				propParagraph('Young’s modulus','GPa', SP.youngGPa, ' Higher stiffness reduces the risk of filter-pack bridging and hole enlargement; plan for conservative drilling parameters in low-modulus horizons.') +
				propParagraph('Compressibility','Pa⁻¹', SP.compress, ' Elevated compressibility magnifies delayed yield and time-dependent consolidation; lower compressibility favours efficient head recovery.') +
				`</div>`
			  );

			  return parts.join("");
			}		

			function wrapInIframeDoc(innerHtml) {
			  return `<!doctype html>
			<html><head>
			<meta charset="utf-8">
			<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
			<style>
			  body{ margin:16px; background:#fff; color:#111; font:15px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, "Noto Sans", "Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji"; }
			  .title{ font-size:22px; font-weight:700; margin:0 0 6px; }
			  .subtitle{ font-size:16px; font-weight:600; margin:18px 0 6px; }
			  .para{ margin:8px 0 0; }
			  .section{ margin:18px 0 0; }
			  .muted{ color:#666; }
			  strong{ font-weight:600; }
			</style>
			</head>
			<body>
			${innerHtml}
			</body></html>`;
			}

			function generateReport() {
			  const inlineContainer = document.getElementById("report");      // optional (hidden)
			  const frame = document.getElementById("reportFrame");           // target iframe

			  try {
				if (!window.BoxData || !Array.isArray(BoxData.data)) {
				  const fallback = `<div class="title">Hydrogeological Assessment</div>
					<div class="para">No survey array was found. Please paste your <span class="muted">BoxData</span> object where indicated in the source and reload.</div>`;
				  // mirror into iframe
				  frame.srcdoc = wrapInIframeDoc(fallback);
				  // keep inline for debugging
				  inlineContainer.innerHTML = fallback;
				  return;
				}

				const points = extractPointsFromBoxData(BoxData);
				if (!points.length) {
				  const msg = `<div class="title">Hydrogeological Assessment</div>
					<div class="para">The data were loaded but no interval sequences were found in the expected format.</div>`;
				  frame.srcdoc = wrapInIframeDoc(msg);
				  inlineContainer.innerHTML = msg;
				  return;
				}

				tryAutoDetectIndices(points);
				const { aquifers, fractures } = detectBodies(points, CONFIG);

				// Build the final prose with your existing composer
				const html = composeReport(points, aquifers, fractures);

				// 1) Put it into the iframe
				frame.srcdoc = wrapInIframeDoc(html);

				// 2) Optionally mirror into the hidden inline container (handy for quick checks)
				inlineContainer.innerHTML = html;

			  } catch (err) {
				const msg = (err && err.stack) ? err.stack : String(err);
				const errHtml = `<div class="title">Hydrogeological Assessment</div>
				  <div class="para">An error occurred while generating the report.</div>
				  <div class="para muted">${msg.replace(/</g,"&lt;")}</div>`;
				document.getElementById("report").innerHTML = errHtml;
				document.getElementById("reportFrame").srcdoc = wrapInIframeDoc(errHtml);
			  }
			}

			window.addEventListener("load", generateReport);
		
			async function sha512(message) {
				const encoder = new TextEncoder();
				const data = encoder.encode(message);
				const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-512", data);
				const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
				const hashHex = hashArray.map(byte => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
				return hashHex;
			}

					appTitle = "Chat",

					function safeClone(obj) {
					try { return structuredClone(obj); } catch (_) {
						return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj ?? {}));
					}
					}

					function isNumberLike(v) {
					return typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);
					}

					function toSciStr(v) {
					const s = Number(v).toExponential(2);
					return s.replace("e+", "e");
					}

					function compactNumber(v) {
					if (!isNumberLike(v)) return v;
					if (Number.isInteger(v)) return v;

					const av = Math.abs(v);
					if (av > 0 && av < 0.01) return toSciStr(v);
					if (av >= 10000) return toSciStr(v);

					const fixed = Number(v.toFixed(2));
					const a = String(fixed);
					const b = String(v);
					const sci = toSciStr(v);
					return (sci.length < a.length && sci.length < b.length) ? sci : fixed;
					}

					function compactLatLon(v) {
					if (!isNumberLike(v)) return v;
					if (Number.isInteger(v)) return v;
					return Number(v.toFixed(7));
					}

					function compactAny(v) {
					if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(compactAny);
					if (v && typeof v === "object") {
						const out = {};
						for (const [k, val] of Object.entries(v)) out[k] = compactAny(val);
						return out;
					}
					return compactNumber(v);
					}

					function compactFormationLayer(layerArr) {
					if (!Array.isArray(layerArr)) return layerArr;

					const out = [];
					for (let i = 0; i <= 25; i++) out.push(compactNumber(layerArr[i]));
					out.push(compactNumber(layerArr[41]));
					return out;
					}

					function buildBoxDataCompact(inputBoxData) {
					const bd = safeClone(inputBoxData ?? {});
					if (!bd || !Array.isArray(bd.data)) return bd;

					const out = {
						...bd,
						data: [],
					};

					for (let r = 0; r < bd.data.length; r++) {
						const row = bd.data[r];
						if (!Array.isArray(row)) {
						out.data.push(row);
						continue;
						}

						const id = row[0];
						const lat = compactLatLon(row[1]);
						const lon = compactLatLon(row[2]);
						const global = Array.isArray(row[3]) ? row[3].map(compactNumber) : row[3];
						const rec = compactNumber(row[4]);
						const formationCount = compactNumber(row[5]);

						const formations = Array.isArray(row[6])
						? row[6].map(compactFormationLayer)
						: row[6];

						const fractureCount = compactNumber(row[7]);
						const fractureDepths = Array.isArray(row[8]) ? row[8].map(compactNumber) : row[8];

						out.data.push([
						id,
						lat,
						lon,
						global,
						rec,
						formationCount,
						formations,
						fractureCount,
						fractureDepths,
						]);
					}

					for (const k of Object.keys(out)) {
						if (k === "data") continue;
						out[k] = compactAny(out[k]);
					}

					return out;
					}

					const BOXDATA_COMPACT = buildBoxDataCompact(boxData);

					const GLOBAL_METRICS_INDEX = `
					0: Calculated Sustainable Yield Estimate (L/s)
					1: Calculated Minimum Yield Estimate (L/s)
					2: Calculated Maximum Yield Estimate (L/s)
					3: Calculated Groundwater Level Estimate (m bgl)
					4: Calculated Drilling Depth Estimate (m bgl)
					5: Calculated Risk (%)
					6: Calculated Interpretation Confidence (%)
					7: Measured Correlation Ratio (0–1)
					8: Measured Signal-to-Noise Ratio (ratio)
					9: Measured Strikes Used (count)
					10: Measured GPS Elevation (m asl)
					11-20: Sustainable Yield if drilled to depth (100–1000 m bgl) (L/s)
					21: Calculated Soil Depth (m bgl)
					22: Soil Density (kg/m³)
					23: Soil Porosity (%)
					24: Soil Shear Modulus (Pa)
					25: Soil Bulk Modulus (Pa)
					26: Soil Compressibility (1/Pa)
					27: Soil Poisson Ratio (ratio)
					28: Soil Young's Modulus (Pa)
					29: Soil Acoustic Impedance (Pa·s/m³)
					30: Soil Storativity (dimensionless)
					31: Soil Diffusivity (m²/day)
					32: Soil Hydraulic Conductivity (m/day)
					33: Soil Transmissivity (m²/day)
					34: Soil Permeability (mD)
					35: Soil Clay Content (%)
					36: Soil SPTN (N) + classification text
					37: Soil SPTRQD / RQD (%) + quality text
					38: Noise (V)
					39: Processing Depth (m bgl)
					40: Vertical Resolution (m)
					41: Accuracy Uncertainty (%)
					42: Magnetics (nT)
					`.trim();

					const FORMATION_LAYER_INDEX_COMPACT = `
					0: From depth (m bgl)
					1: To depth (m bgl)
					2: Formation Type (Lithology code) + decoded lithology text
					3: Aquifer Type (Classification code) + decoded aquifer text
					4: Condition (code) + decoded condition text
					5: Fractured (0/1)
					6: Min Yield (L/s)
					7: Max Yield (L/s)
					8: Sustainable Yield (L/s)
					9: Porespace Hydraulic Conductivity (m/day)
					10: Matrix Hydraulic Conductivity (m/day)
					11: Porosity (%)
					12: Specific Storage (1/m)
					13: Storativity (dimensionless)
					14: Porespace Diffusivity (m²/day)
					15: Clay Content (%)
					16: Density (kg/m³)
					17: Shear Modulus (Pa)
					18: Bulk Modulus (Pa)
					19: Compressibility (1/Pa)
					20: Young's Modulus (Pa)
					21: Water Quality (%)
					22: Formation Aquifer Indicator (0/1)
					23: Formation Fracture Count (count)
					24: SPTN (N) + classification text
					25: SPTRQD / RQD (%) + quality text
					26: Aquifer Probability (%)   (original formation index 41)
					`.trim();

					const DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = `
					You are an expert hydrogeological data analyst.

					INSTRUCTIONS
					1) Answer based ONLY on the provided DATA arrays.
					2) Use SCHEMA to interpret indices, units, and code descriptions.
					3) When referencing lithology/aquifer/condition codes, include the decoded text from the lookup tables.
					4) Be precise. Keep units in your written answer.

					DATA FORMAT (RAW ARRAYS ONLY; NO UNITS/DEFS INSIDE DATA)
					Each row in DATA.data follows this array index structure:
					[0] ID (Point Number)
					[1] Latitude (WGS84 decimal degrees)
					[2] Longitude (WGS84 decimal degrees)
					[3] GLOBAL DATASET (Array) - see GLOBAL METRICS INDEX
					[4] Recommendation Index (1 = highest)
					[5] Formation Count
					[6] FORMATION LAYERS (Array of Arrays) - see FORMATION LAYER INDEX (COMPACT)
					[7] Number of Fractures
					[8] Fracture Depths (Array, meters below ground level)
					`.trim();

						const SCHEMA_BLOCK = `
					SCHEMA

					GLOBAL METRICS INDEX (for row[3])
					${GLOBAL_METRICS_INDEX}

					FORMATION LAYER INDEX (COMPACT) (for each formation layer in row[6])
					${FORMATION_LAYER_INDEX_COMPACT}

					LOOKUPS (code -> description)
					Lithology codes: ${JSON.stringify(LITHOLOGY_MAP)}
					Aquifer codes: ${JSON.stringify(AQUIFER_MAP)}
					Condition codes: ${JSON.stringify(CONDITION_MAP)}

					SPTN categories (based on value)
					${JSON.stringify([
						{ range: "<4", class: "Very Loose", relativeDensity: "<20" },
						{ range: "4-10", class: "Loose", relativeDensity: "20-40" },
						{ range: "10-30", class: "Compact", relativeDensity: "40-60" },
						{ range: "30-50", class: "Dense", relativeDensity: "60-80" },
						{ range: ">50", class: "Very Dense", relativeDensity: ">80" },
					])}

					RQD categories (based on %)
					${JSON.stringify([
						{ range: "<25%", quality: "Very poor" },
						{ range: "25-50%", quality: "Poor" },
						{ range: "50-75%", quality: "Fair" },
						{ range: "75-90%", quality: "Good" },
						{ range: "90-100%", quality: "Excellent" },
					])}
					`.trim();

					const SYSTEM_PROMPT_WITH_DATA =
					(systemPromptOverride ?? DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT) +
					"\n\nDATA:\n" +
					JSON.stringify(BOXDATA_COMPACT ?? {}) +
					"\n\n" +
					SCHEMA_BLOCK;

					let busy = false;
					const history = [];

					.gs-container{width:95%;max-width:980px;height:95vh;margin-top:2.5vh;background:#fff;border-radius:15px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
					.gs-header{background:#808080;color:#fff;padding:16px 18px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap}

					elSend.disabled = v;
					elExport.disabled = v;
					elUser.disabled = v;
					elPass.disabled = v;

				function exportPromptToFile() {
					try {
						const blob = new Blob([SYSTEM_PROMPT_WITH_DATA], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
						const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
						const a = document.createElement("a");
						a.href = url;
						a.download = "GeoVuePrompt.txt";
						document.body.appendChild(a);
						a.click();
						a.remove();
						setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 0);
					} catch (e) {
						history.push({
						role: "assistant",
						content: `Error exporting prompt.\n\nDetails: ${String(e?.message || e)}`
						});
						renderHistory();
					}
				}

				function getAuth() {
				return {
					name: String(elUser.value || "").trim(),
					pass: String(elPass.value || "").trim(),
				};
				}

				function trimmedHistoryForServer(maxTurns = 10) {
				return history.slice(-maxTurns * 2);
				}

				async function runAssistantTurn() {
				const auth = getAuth();
				if (!auth.name || !auth.pass) throw new Error("Enter username and password first.");

				const userLatest = history.filter(x => x.role === "user").slice(-1)[0]?.content ?? "";

				const passHash = await sha512(auth.pass);

				const formData = new FormData();
				formData.append("AccName", auth.name);
				formData.append("AccPass", passHash);
				formData.append("Message", userLatest);
				formData.append("SystemPrompt", SYSTEM_PROMPT_WITH_DATA);
				formData.append("History", JSON.stringify(trimmedHistoryForServer(10)));

				const res = await fetch(proxyUrl, { method: "POST", body: formData });

				const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
				if (!json || json.ok !== true) {
					throw new Error(json?.error || `Server error (HTTP ${res.status})`);
				}
				return String(json.reply ?? "");
				}

				elExport.addEventListener("click", exportPromptToFile);

				async function handleSend() {
				const text = elInput.value.trim();
				if (!text || busy) return;

				if (!boxData || !boxData.data) {
					history.push({
					role: "assistant",
					content:
						"⚠️ BoxData is missing.\n\nPaste your BoxData definition where the file says:\n" +
						"`var BoxData = { ... }`\n\n" +
						"Then reload the page."
					});
					renderHistory();
					return;
				}

				history.push({ role: "user", content: text });
				elInput.value = "";
				renderHistory();

				setBusy(true);
				const loading = document.createElement("div");
				loading.className = "gs-loading";
				loading.textContent = "Analyzing...";
				elChat.appendChild(loading);
				elChat.scrollTop = elChat.scrollHeight;

				try {
					const out = await runAssistantTurn();
					history.push({ role: "assistant", content: out || "(No text returned.)" });
				} catch (err) {
					const msg = String(err?.message || err);
					history.push({
					role: "assistant",
					content: `Error: ${msg}`
					});
				} finally {
					if (loading.parentNode) loading.remove();
					renderHistory();
					setBusy(false);
					elInput.focus();
				}
				}

				elSend.addEventListener("click", handleSend);
				elInput.addEventListener("keypress", (e) => {
				if (e.key === "Enter") handleSend();
				});

				renderMeta();
				history.push({ role: "assistant", content: "• Enter your GeoVue account username/password above, then ask a question.\n• Use the Export button to save the promt data to a local file.\n• Data privacy and security cannot be guaranteed.\n• Chat messages charged at $0.4 per enquiry." });
				renderHistory();
				elInput.focus();

				return {
				root,
				destroy: () => { $mount.innerHTML = ""; },
				};
			}

			return initGeoSuiteMultiModelChat({
				mountEl,
				boxData: boxData,

				proxyUrl: "https://atsps2.net/chat.php",
			});

			(function enableResize() {
				if (!floating) return;

				const rsStyle = document.createElement("style");
				rsStyle.textContent = `
								#gsFloat { position: fixed; }
								.gs-resize-handle { position:absolute; z-index:9999; background:transparent; }
								.gs-rs-n { top:-6px; left:10px; right:10px; height:12px; cursor:n-resize; }
								.gs-rs-s { bottom:-6px; left:10px; right:10px; height:12px; cursor:s-resize; }
								.gs-rs-e { right:-6px; top:10px; bottom:10px; width:12px; cursor:e-resize; }
								.gs-rs-w { left:-6px; top:10px; bottom:10px; width:12px; cursor:w-resize; }
								.gs-rs-ne { right:-6px; top:-6px; width:14px; height:14px; cursor:ne-resize; }
								.gs-rs-nw { left:-6px; top:-6px; width:14px; height:14px; cursor:nw-resize; }
								.gs-rs-se { right:-6px; bottom:-6px; width:14px; height:14px; cursor:se-resize; }
								.gs-rs-sw { left:-6px; bottom:-6px; width:14px; height:14px; cursor:sw-resize; }
							`;
				document.head.appendChild(rsStyle);

				const curPos = getComputedStyle(floating).position;
				if (curPos === "static") floating.style.position = "fixed";

				if (floating.querySelector(".gs-resize-handle")) return;

				const handles = [
					["n", "gs-rs-n"],
					["s", "gs-rs-s"],
					["e", "gs-rs-e"],
					["w", "gs-rs-w"],
					["ne", "gs-rs-ne"],
					["nw", "gs-rs-nw"],
					["se", "gs-rs-se"],
					["sw", "gs-rs-sw"],
				];

				for (const [dir, cls] of handles) {
					const h = document.createElement("div");
					h.className = `gs-resize-handle ${cls}`;
					h.dataset.dir = dir;
					floating.appendChild(h);
				}

				let resizing = false;
				let dir = "";
				let rsStartX = 0, rsStartY = 0;
				let rsStartW = 0, rsStartH = 0;
				let rsStartRight = 0, rsStartBottom = 0;

				const MIN_W = 320;
				const MIN_H = 320;

				function getWH() {
					const st = getComputedStyle(floating);
					const w = px(st.width);
					const h = px(st.height);
					return { w, h };
				}

				function onMouseDown(e) {
					if (e.button !== 0) return;
					const t = e.target;
					if (!t || !t.classList.contains("gs-resize-handle")) return;

					if (dragging) return;

					resizing = true;
					dir = t.dataset.dir || "";
					rsStartX = e.clientX;
					rsStartY = e.clientY;

					const st = getComputedStyle(floating);
					const vals = getWH();
					rsStartW = vals.w;
					rsStartH = vals.h;

					rsStartRight = px(st.right);
					rsStartBottom = px(st.bottom);

					e.preventDefault();
					e.stopPropagation();
				}

				function onMouseMove(e) {
					if (!resizing) return;

					const dx = e.clientX - rsStartX;
					const dy = e.clientY - rsStartY;

					let newW = rsStartW;
					let newH = rsStartH;

					if (dir.includes("e")) newW = Math.max(MIN_W, rsStartW + dx);
					if (dir.includes("w")) newW = Math.max(MIN_W, rsStartW - dx);
					if (dir.includes("s")) newH = Math.max(MIN_H, rsStartH + dy);
					if (dir.includes("n")) newH = Math.max(MIN_H, rsStartH - dy);

					floating.style.width = newW + "px";
					floating.style.height = newH + "px";

					const effDx = newW - rsStartW;
					const effDy = newH - rsStartH;

					if (dir.includes("e")) {
						floating.style.right = Math.max(10, rsStartRight - effDx) + "px";
					}

					if (dir.includes("s")) {
						floating.style.bottom = Math.max(10, rsStartBottom - effDy) + "px";
					}
				}

				function onMouseUp() {
					resizing = false;
					dir = "";
				}

				floating.addEventListener("mousedown", onMouseDown);
				window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove);
				window.addEventListener("mouseup", onMouseUp);
			})();

		</script>
	
<script id="gv-apparent-resistivity-report-patch">
(function(){
  "use strict";

  // GeoVue derived apparent-resistivity indices.
  // Point index is intentionally after the gradient / heat-transfer point fields.
  // Formation index is intentionally after the gradient / heat-transfer formation fields.
  var GV_RES_POINT_INDEX = 71;
  var GV_RES_FORMATION_INDEX = 54;
  var GV_RES_DATASET_ID = "dataset73";

  function gvNum(value, fallback) {
    var n = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : (fallback === undefined ? 0 : fallback);
  }

  function gvClamp(value, min, max) {
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
  }

  function gvRound(value, digits) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return 0;
    var f = Math.pow(10, digits === undefined ? 1 : digits);
    return Math.round(value * f) / f;
  }

  function gvEnsureIndex(arr, index, fillValue) {
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return;
    while (arr.length <= index) arr.push(fillValue === undefined ? 0 : fillValue);
  }

  function gvCalculateApparentFormationResistivity(formation) {
    // Bounded, hydrogeologically realistic apparent/proxy estimate.
    // Inputs are taken from the existing formation BoxData fields:
    // porosity, clay, water quality, apparent electric field strength, temperature and saturation.
    if (!Array.isArray(formation)) return 0;

    var electricField = Math.abs(gvNum(formation[33], 0));          // V/m
    var porosity = gvClamp(gvNum(formation[11], 25), 3, 60);        // %
    var clay = gvClamp(gvNum(formation[15], 25), 0, 100);           // %
    var waterQuality = gvClamp(gvNum(formation[21], 50), 0, 100);   // relative %
    var saturation = gvClamp(gvNum(formation[45], 100), 0, 100);    // %
    var tempScale = (typeof GlobalTemperature !== "undefined") ? gvNum(GlobalTemperature, 25) : 25;
    var formationTemp = gvNum(formation[42], 0) * tempScale + 10;   // degC

    // Prevent tiny field strengths from generating unrealistically large resistivities.
    electricField = Math.max(electricField, 0.002);

    var baseOhmM = 55;
    var fieldFactor = gvClamp(Math.pow(0.05 / electricField, 0.28), 0.35, 3.20);
    var porosityFactor = gvClamp(Math.pow(25 / porosity, 0.35), 0.55, 2.00);
    var clayFactor = gvClamp(1 / (1 + clay / 60), 0.45, 1.15);
    var saturationFactor = gvClamp(1 / (0.65 + 0.006 * saturation), 0.55, 1.35);
    var waterQualityFactor = gvClamp(0.75 + waterQuality / 200, 0.75, 1.25);
    var temperatureFactor = gvClamp(1 / (1 + 0.018 * (formationTemp - 20)), 0.65, 1.25);

    var rho = baseOhmM * fieldFactor * porosityFactor * clayFactor * saturationFactor * waterQualityFactor * temperatureFactor;

    // Normal hydrogeological bounds; use a separate dry-rock mode if higher values are required.
    return gvRound(gvClamp(rho, 5, 1500), 1);
  }

  function gvTopFormation(row) {
    if (!Array.isArray(row) || !Array.isArray(row[6]) || row[6].length === 0) return null;
    var top = null;
    var topDepth = Infinity;
    for (var i = 0; i < row[6].length; i++) {
      var formation = row[6][i];
      if (!Array.isArray(formation)) continue;
      var fromDepth = gvNum(formation[0], Infinity);
      if (fromDepth < topDepth) {
        topDepth = fromDepth;
        top = formation;
      }
    }
    return top;
  }

  function gvAugmentResistivityData() {
    if (!window.BoxData || !Array.isArray(BoxData.data)) return;

    for (var i = 0; i < BoxData.data.length; i++) {
      var row = BoxData.data[i];
      if (!Array.isArray(row)) continue;
      if (!Array.isArray(row[3])) row[3] = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(row[6])) row[6] = [];

      for (var j = 0; j < row[6].length; j++) {
        var formation = row[6][j];
        if (!Array.isArray(formation)) continue;
        gvEnsureIndex(formation, GV_RES_FORMATION_INDEX, 0);
        formation[GV_RES_FORMATION_INDEX] = gvCalculateApparentFormationResistivity(formation);
      }

      var top = gvTopFormation(row);
      gvEnsureIndex(row[3], GV_RES_POINT_INDEX, 0);
      row[3][GV_RES_POINT_INDEX] = top ? gvCalculateApparentFormationResistivity(top) : 0;
    }
  }

  function gvRegisterDataset() {
    if (!window.datasets) return;
    datasets[GV_RES_DATASET_ID] = {
      name: "Calculated Soil Apparent Resistivity (Ohm.m)",
      unit: "Ohm.m",
      ID: "",
      SectionName: "Calculated Apparent Formation Resistivity (Ohm.m)",
      LegendUnit: "Ohm.m",
      SectionIndex: GV_RES_FORMATION_INDEX,
      Index: GV_RES_POINT_INDEX
    };
  }

  function gvFindOptgroup(select, labelText) {
    var groups = select.querySelectorAll("optgroup");
    for (var i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
      if ((groups[i].getAttribute("label") || "") === labelText) return groups[i];
    }
    var group = document.createElement("optgroup");
    group.label = labelText;
    select.appendChild(group);
    return group;
  }

  function gvAddOptionToSelect(select, groupLabel, value, text) {
    if (!select || select.querySelector('option[value="' + value + '"]')) return;
    var group = gvFindOptgroup(select, groupLabel);
    var option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = value;
    option.textContent = text;
    group.appendChild(option);
  }

  function gvAddSelectors() {
    var contourSelect = document.querySelector('select[onchange*="updateContourPlot"]');
    gvAddOptionToSelect(contourSelect, "GeoTechnical Parameters", GV_RES_DATASET_ID, "Soil Apparent Resistivity");

    var sectionSelect = document.querySelector('select[onchange*="updateSectionPlot"]');
    gvAddOptionToSelect(sectionSelect, "Electrical Properties", GV_RES_DATASET_ID, "Apparent Formation Resistivity");

    var profileSelect = document.querySelector('select[onchange*="updateProfilePlot"]');
    gvAddOptionToSelect(profileSelect, "Electrical Properties", GV_RES_DATASET_ID, "Apparent Formation Resistivity");

    var modelSelect = document.querySelector('select[onchange*="updateVolumePlot"]');
    gvAddOptionToSelect(modelSelect, "Electrical Properties", GV_RES_DATASET_ID, "Apparent Formation Resistivity");
  }

  function gvAddTraceContainer() {
    if (document.getElementById("Traceplot-51-Resistivity")) return;
    var after = document.getElementById("Traceplot-50-HeatPotential") || document.getElementById("Traceplot-43-SAT");
    if (!after || !after.parentNode) return;
    var div = document.createElement("div");
    div.id = "Traceplot-51-Resistivity";
    div.style.display = "inline-block";
    after.parentNode.insertBefore(div, after.nextSibling);
  }

  function gvFormatResValue(value) {
    var n = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return "";
    return String(gvRound(n, 1));
  }

  function gvBuildResistivityTrace(selectedRowData) {
    var data = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(selectedRowData) || !Array.isArray(selectedRowData[6])) return data;
    for (var i = 0; i < selectedRowData[6].length; i++) {
      var formation = selectedRowData[6][i];
      if (!Array.isArray(formation)) continue;
      var value = formation[GV_RES_FORMATION_INDEX];
      if (!Number.isFinite(Number(value))) value = gvCalculateApparentFormationResistivity(formation);
      data.push({ depth: gvNum(formation[0], 0), value: gvNum(value, 0) });
      data.push({ depth: gvNum(formation[1], 0) - 0.01, value: gvNum(value, 0) });
    }
    return data;
  }

  function gvPatchSelectPoint() {
    if (typeof window.selectPoint !== "function" || window.selectPoint.__gvResPatch) return;
    var original = window.selectPoint;
    window.selectPoint = function() {
      gvAugmentResistivityData();
      var result = original.apply(this, arguments);
      try {
        var dropdown = document.getElementById("PointSelector");
        var selectedIndex = dropdown ? dropdown.value : "";
        if (selectedIndex !== "" && window.BoxData && BoxData.data[selectedIndex]) {
          gvAddTraceContainer();
          var traceData = gvBuildResistivityTrace(BoxData.data[selectedIndex]);
          if (typeof window.UpdateTraces === "function") {
            UpdateTraces("Traceplot-51-Resistivity", traceData, "Apparent Formation Resistivity", "Ohm.m");
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Resistivity trace update failed:", err);
      }
      return result;
    };
    window.selectPoint.__gvResPatch = true;
  }

  function gvPatchSelectRow() {
    if (typeof window.selectRow !== "function" || window.selectRow.__gvResPatch) return;
    var original = window.selectRow;
    window.selectRow = function() {
      gvAugmentResistivityData();
      var result = original.apply(this, arguments);
      try {
        var dropdown = document.getElementById("rowSelector");
        var selectedIndex = dropdown ? dropdown.value : "";
        var selectedRowData = (selectedIndex !== "" && window.BoxData) ? BoxData.data[selectedIndex] : null;
        var bodyRows = document.querySelectorAll("#selectedRow tr");
        if (selectedRowData && Array.isArray(selectedRowData[6])) {
          for (var i = 0; i < bodyRows.length && i < selectedRowData[6].length; i++) {
            var cells = bodyRows[i].querySelectorAll("td");
            var value = selectedRowData[6][i][GV_RES_FORMATION_INDEX];
            if (cells.length) cells[cells.length - 1].textContent = gvFormatResValue(value);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Resistivity log update failed:", err);
      }
      return result;
    };
    window.selectRow.__gvResPatch = true;
  }

  function gvPatchPlotFunctions() {
    ["updateContourPlot", "updateSectionPlot", "updateProfilePlot", "updateVolumePlot"].forEach(function(fnName) {
      if (typeof window[fnName] !== "function" || window[fnName].__gvResPatch) return;
      var original = window[fnName];
      window[fnName] = function() {
        gvAugmentResistivityData();
        gvRegisterDataset();
        return original.apply(this, arguments);
      };
      window[fnName].__gvResPatch = true;
    });
  }

  function gvPatchExport() {
    window.exportAllBoxDataToCSV = function() {
      gvAugmentResistivityData();

      function escapeForCSV(value) {
        if (value == null) return "";
        var str = String(value);
        if (/[",\r\n]/.test(str)) str = '"' + str.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
        return str;
      }

      function download(csvStr, name) {
        var blob = new Blob([csvStr], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var link = document.createElement("a");
        link.href = url;
        link.download = name;
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        document.body.removeChild(link);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      }

      var formationHeaders = [
        "Point ID","Latitude (Dec)","Longitude (Dec)","GPS Elevation (masl)","Recommendation Index","Formation Index",
        "From Depth (m)","To Depth (m)","Formation Type","Aquifer Type","Formation Condition","Fractured (Yes=1)",
        "Formation Min Yield (l/s)","Formation Max Yield (l/s)","Formation Sus Yield (l/s)",
        "Porespace Hydraulic K (m/d)","Matrix Hydraulic K (m/d)","Formation Porosity (%)","Specific Storage (1/m)",
        "Formation Storativity (unitless)","Porespace Diffusivity (m2/d)","Clay Content (%)","Formation Density (kg/m3)",
        "Shear Modulus (Pa)","Bulk Modulus (Pa)","Compressibility (1/Pa)","Youngs Modulus (Pa)","Formation Water Quality (%)",
        "Formation Aquifer Indicator (unitless)","Formation Fracture Count","Formation SPTN (unitless)","Formation SPTRQD (unitless)",
        "Formation Velocity (m/s)","Acoustic Impedance (Pa s/m3)","Frenzel Radius (m)","Transmission Coefficient (coefficient)",
        "Critical Angle (deg)","Seismic Attenuation Qp (GPa)","Seismic Attenuation Qs (GPa)",
        "Apparent Electric Field Strength (V/m)","Poisson Ratio (ratio)","Specific Volume (m3/kg)",
        "Porespace Transmissivity (m2/d)","Porespace Permeability (md)","Matrix Transmissivity (m2/d)",
        "Matrix Permeability (md)","Permeability Contrast (ratio)","Aquifer Probability (%)","Formation Temperature (degC)",
        "Aquiclude Probability (%)","Hydrocarbon Probability (%)","Relative Saturation (%)",
        "Terrain Gradient (m/m)","Flow Direction (deg)","Darcy Flux (m/d)","Groundwater Flow Rate (m2/d/m)",
        "Effective Porosity (%)","Seepage Velocity (m/d)","Advective Heat Transfer Potential (W/K/m)",
        "Advective Heat Score (W/K/m)","Apparent Formation Resistivity (Ohm.m)"
      ];

      var csvFormation = formationHeaders.join(",") + "\r\n";
      if (window.BoxData && Array.isArray(BoxData.data)) {
        BoxData.data.forEach(function(point) {
          if (!Array.isArray(point)) return;
          var pointID = point[0] == null ? "" : point[0];
          var lat = point[1] == null ? "" : point[1];
          var lon = point[2] == null ? "" : point[2];
          var gps = Array.isArray(point[3]) && point[3].length > 10 ? point[3][10] : "";
          var rec = point[4] == null ? "" : point[4];

          if (!Array.isArray(point[6]) || !point[6].length) {
            csvFormation += [pointID,lat,lon,gps,rec,""].concat(new Array(formationHeaders.length - 6).fill("")).map(escapeForCSV).join(",") + "\r\n";
            return;
          }

          point[6].forEach(function(formation, fIndex) {
            if (!Array.isArray(formation)) return;
            var row = [pointID, lat, lon, gps, rec, fIndex];
            for (var i = 0; i <= GV_RES_FORMATION_INDEX; i++) {
              if (i === 53) continue; // internal heat score, exported separately below
              row.push(formation[i] == null ? "" : formation[i]);
            }
            csvFormation += row.map(escapeForCSV).join(",") + "\r\n";
          });
        });
      }

      var siteHeaders = ["Point ID","Latitude (Dec)","Longitude (Dec)","GPS Elevation (masl)","Recommendation Index"];
      if (window.datasets) {
        Object.keys(datasets).sort(function(a,b){ return (datasets[a].Index||0) - (datasets[b].Index||0); }).forEach(function(key) {
          var d = datasets[key];
          if (d && d.name && Number.isFinite(Number(d.Index)) && siteHeaders.indexOf(d.name) < 0) siteHeaders.push(d.name);
        });
      }
      if (siteHeaders.indexOf("Calculated Soil Apparent Resistivity (Ohm.m)") < 0) siteHeaders.push("Calculated Soil Apparent Resistivity (Ohm.m)");

      var csvSite = siteHeaders.join(",") + "\r\n";
      if (window.BoxData && Array.isArray(BoxData.data)) {
        BoxData.data.forEach(function(point) {
          if (!Array.isArray(point)) return;
          var row = [
            point[0] == null ? "" : point[0],
            point[1] == null ? "" : point[1],
            point[2] == null ? "" : point[2],
            Array.isArray(point[3]) && point[3].length > 10 ? point[3][10] : "",
            point[4] == null ? "" : point[4]
          ];
          for (var i = 5; i < siteHeaders.length; i++) {
            var value = "";
            if (siteHeaders[i] === "Calculated Soil Apparent Resistivity (Ohm.m)") {
              value = Array.isArray(point[3]) ? point[3][GV_RES_POINT_INDEX] : "";
            }
            row.push(value);
          }
          csvSite += row.map(escapeForCSV).join(",") + "\r\n";
        });
      }

      download(csvFormation, "ExportedData.csv");
      download(csvSite, "ExportedSiteParameters.csv");
    };
  }

  function gvInstallResistivityPatch() {
    gvAugmentResistivityData();
    gvRegisterDataset();
    gvAddSelectors();
    gvAddTraceContainer();
    gvPatchLogHeaders();
    gvPatchSelectPoint();
    gvPatchSelectRow();
    gvPatchPlotFunctions();
    gvPatchExport();
  }

  window.GeoVueCalculateApparentFormationResistivity = gvCalculateApparentFormationResistivity;
  window.GeoVueAugmentApparentResistivityData = gvAugmentResistivityData;

  gvInstallResistivityPatch();
  window.addEventListener("load", gvInstallResistivityPatch);
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", gvInstallResistivityPatch);
})();
</script>

  function gvrtTrim(v,forInput){var n=Number(v);if(!Number.isFinite(n))return String(v==null?'':v);if(Object.is(n,-0))n=0;var a=Math.abs(n);if(!forInput&&(a>=1000000||(a>0&&a<0.0001)))return n.toExponential(3);var d=forInput?6:(a>=1000?1:(a>=100?2:(a>=10?2:(a>=1?3:5))));return n.toFixed(d).replace(/(\.\d*?[1-9])0+$|\.0+$/,'$1');}
  function gvrtDetectSpec(text){text=String(text==null?'':text);for(var i=0;i<gvrtSpecs.length;i++)if(gvrtSpecs[i].detectRe.test(text))return gvrtSpecs[i];return null;}
  function gvrtConvertText(text){var out=String(text==null?'':text);gvrtSpecs.forEach(function(spec){var rr=new RegExp('(-?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:e[+-]?\\d+)?)\\s*([\\-–—]|\\bto\\b)\\s*(-?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:e[+-]?\\d+)?)\\s*'+spec.aliasSource,'gi');out=out.replace(rr,function(_m,a,sep,b){return gvrtTrim(gvrtToDisplay(a,spec),false)+' '+sep+' '+gvrtTrim(gvrtToDisplay(b,spec),false)+' '+spec.display;});var nr=new RegExp('(-?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:e[+-]?\\d+)?)\\s*'+spec.aliasSource,'gi');out=out.replace(nr,function(_m,a){return gvrtTrim(gvrtToDisplay(a,spec),false)+' '+spec.display;});out=out.replace(new RegExp(spec.aliasSource,'gi'),spec.display);});return out;}
  window.GVUnitSystem={isImperial:gvrtIsImperial,getSystem:function(){return gvrtState.system;},detectSpec:gvrtDetectSpec,toDisplay:function(v,u){return gvrtToDisplay(v,typeof u==='string'?(gvrtSpecByKey[u]||gvrtDetectSpec(u)):u);},toMetric:function(v,u){return gvrtToMetric(v,typeof u==='string'?(gvrtSpecByKey[u]||gvrtDetectSpec(u)):u);},displayUnit:function(u){var s=typeof u==='string'?(gvrtSpecByKey[u]||gvrtDetectSpec(u)):u;return gvrtIsImperial()&&s?s.display:String(u||'');},convertText:function(t){return gvrtIsImperial()?gvrtConvertText(t):String(t==null?'':t);}};

  var gvrtTextMetric=new WeakMap(),gvrtCellMetric=new WeakMap(),gvrtHeaderMetric=new WeakMap(),gvrtUpdating=false;
  function gvrtIgnoredText(n){var p=n&&n.parentElement;return !p||!!p.closest('script,style,noscript,textarea,[contenteditable="true"],.plotly,.js-plotly-plot');}
  function gvrtApplyTextNode(n){if(!n||n.nodeType!==3||gvrtIgnoredText(n))return;var cur=n.nodeValue||'';if(!cur.trim())return;var original=gvrtTextMetric.get(n);if(original===undefined){original=cur;gvrtTextMetric.set(n,original);}else{var expected=gvrtIsImperial()?gvrtConvertText(original):original;if(cur!==expected&&!gvrtUpdating){original=cur;gvrtTextMetric.set(n,original);}}var desired=gvrtIsImperial()?gvrtConvertText(original):original;if(cur!==desired){gvrtUpdating=true;n.nodeValue=desired;gvrtUpdating=false;}}
  function gvrtWalkText(root){if(!root)return;if(root.nodeType===3){gvrtApplyTextNode(root);return;}if(root.nodeType!==1&&root.nodeType!==9&&root.nodeType!==11)return;var w=document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT),n;while((n=w.nextNode()))gvrtApplyTextNode(n);}
  function gvrtApplyTables(root){var tables=[];if(root&&root.nodeType===1&&root.matches&&root.matches('table'))tables=[root];else if(root&&root.querySelectorAll)tables=Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('table'));tables.forEach(function(table){var headers=Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('thead tr:first-child th'));if(!headers.length)return;var specs=headers.map(function(th){var t=gvrtHeaderMetric.get(th);if(t===undefined){t=String(th.textContent||'').trim();gvrtHeaderMetric.set(th,t);}return gvrtDetectSpec(t);});Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')).forEach(function(row){Array.from(row.cells||[]).forEach(function(cell,i){var spec=specs[i];if(!spec)return;var cur=String(cell.textContent||'').trim(),original=gvrtCellMetric.get(cell);if(original===undefined){original=cur;gvrtCellMetric.set(cell,original);}if(!/^[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:e[-+]?\d+)?$/i.test(original))return;var desired=gvrtIsImperial()?gvrtTrim(gvrtToDisplay(original,spec),false):original;if(cur!==desired){gvrtUpdating=true;cell.textContent=desired;gvrtUpdating=false;}});});});}

  function gvrtFormationValues(f,gradient,direction,overlap){if(typeof window.GDcalculateFormationFlowHeatValues==='function')return window.GDcalculateFormationFlowHeatValues(f,gradient,direction,overlap);var from=gvrtNum(f&&f[0]),to=gvrtNum(f&&f[1]),thickness=overlap==null?Math.max(0,to-from):Math.max(0,overlap),matrixK=Math.max(0,gvrtNum(f&&f[10])),por=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,gvrtNum(f&&f[11])/100)),sat=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,gvrtNum(f&&f[45])/100)),eff=por*sat,darcy=matrixK*Math.max(0,gradient),flow=darcy*thickness*sat,seep=eff>0?darcy/eff:0,heat=(flow/86400)*4186000;return{thickness:thickness,matrixK:matrixK,porosityFraction:por,saturationFraction:sat,effectivePorosityPercent:eff*100,darcyFlux:darcy,groundwaterFlowRate:flow,seepageVelocity:seep,advectiveHeatPotential:heat,heatScore:heat,gradient:gradient,direction:direction};}

  window.updateContourPlot=function(selectedData){try{window.ContourHoldselectedData=selectedData;var dataset=window.datasets&&datasets[selectedData];if(!dataset)return;var   function gvrtRainbow(t){var stops=[[0,[150,0,90]],[.125,[0,0,200]],[.25,[0,100,255]],[.375,[0,220,220]],[.5,[0,180,0]],[.625,[180,220,0]],[.75,[255,170,0]],[.875,[255,50,0]],[1,[160,0,0]]];t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));for(var i=1;i<stops.length;i++)if(t<=stops[i][0]){var a=stops[i-1],b=stops[i],f=(t-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]);return a[1].map(function(v,j){return Math.round(v+(b[1][j]-v)*f);});}return stops[stops.length-1][1];}
  function gvrtBuildColorbar(min,max,unit){var c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=180;c.height=520;var x=c.getContext('2d');x.fillStyle='white';x.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);for(var y=30;y<470;y++){var t=1-(y-30)/440,col=gvrtRainbow(t);x.fillStyle='rgb('+col.join(',')+')';x.fillRect(18,y,42,1);}x.strokeStyle='#333';x.strokeRect(18,30,42,440);x.fillStyle='#222';x.font='18px Arial';x.textAlign='left';for(var i=0;i<=5;i++){var yy=30+i*88,val=max-(max-min)*i/5;x.fillText(gvrtTrim(val,false),70,yy+6);}x.font='bold 17px Arial';var label=gvrtIsImperial()?window.GVUnitSystem.displayUnit(unit):unit;x.fillText(label||'',18,500);return c.toDataURL('image/png');}
  function gvrtBuildRaster(key,size){size=size||420;var d=datasets[key],rows=gvrtRows().filter(function(r){return Number.isFinite(Number(r&&r[1]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(r&&r[2]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(r&&r[3]&&r[3][d.Index]));});if(!rows.length)return null;var minLat=Math.min.apply(null,rows.map(function(r){return Number(r[1]);})),maxLat=Math.max.apply(null,rows.map(function(r){return Number(r[1]);})),minLon=Math.min.apply(null,rows.map(function(r){return Number(r[2]);})),maxLon=Math.max.apply(null,rows.map(function(r){return Number(r[2]);}));if(minLat===maxLat){minLat-=.00001;maxLat+=.00001;}if(minLon===maxLon){minLon-=.00001;maxLon+=.00001;}var spec=gvrtDetectSpec(d.unit),vals=rows.map(function(r){var v=Number(r[3][d.Index]);return gvrtIsImperial()&&spec?Number(gvrtToDisplay(v,spec)):v;}),min=Math.min.apply(null,vals),max=Math.max.apply(null,vals);if(min===max){min-=Math.max(1,Math.abs(min)*.01);max+=Math.max(1,Math.abs(max)*.01);}var canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=size;canvas.height=size;var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),img=ctx.createImageData(size,size),px=img.data;for(var y=0;y<size;y++){var lat=maxLat-(y/(size-1))*(maxLat-minLat);for(var x=0;x<size;x++){var lon=minLon+(x/(size-1))*(maxLon-minLon),sum=0,ws=0;for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){var dist=Math.hypot(lon-Number(rows[i][2]),lat-Number(rows[i][1]));if(dist===0){sum=vals[i];ws=1;break;}var w=1/dist;sum+=vals[i]*w;ws+=w;}var v=ws?sum/ws:min,t=(v-min)/(max-min),col=gvrtRainbow(t),o=(y*size+x)*4;px[o]=col[0];px[o+1]=col[1];px[o+2]=col[2];px[o+3]=255;}}ctx.putImageData(img,0,0);var unit=gvrtIsImperial()&&spec?spec.display:d.unit;return{key:key,name:gvrtIsImperial()?gvrtConvertText(d.name):d.name,unit:unit,min:min,max:max,bounds:[[minLat,minLon],[maxLat,maxLon]],image:canvas.toDataURL('image/png'),colorbar:gvrtBuildColorbar(min,max,d.unit)};}
