<script id="gvReportProfileModelSatelliteJS">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.GV_REPORT_PROFILE_MODEL_HIGH_RES_SATELLITE_V1) return;
  window.GV_REPORT_PROFILE_MODEL_HIGH_RES_SATELLITE_V1=true;

  var SAT_NAME='Satellite map overlay';
  var state={tokens:{profiles:0,models:0},cache:new Map(),sessions:new Map(),googleDisabledUntil:0,applying:{profiles:false,models:false}};

  function byId(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
  function plotId(kind){return kind==='profiles'?'plotly-Profile1':'plotly-Model1';}
  function checkboxId(kind){return kind==='profiles'?'gvReportProfileSatellite':'gvReportModelSatellite';}
  function sliderId(kind){return kind==='profiles'?'gvReportProfileSatelliteTransparency':'gvReportModelSatelliteTransparency';}
  function outputId(kind){return sliderId(kind)+'Value';}
  function nextToken(kind){state.tokens[kind]=(state.tokens[kind]||0)+1;return state.tokens[kind];}
  function isChecked(kind){var el=byId(checkboxId(kind));return !el||!!el.checked;}
  function opacity(kind){var raw=Number((byId(sliderId(kind))||{}).value||0);if(!Number.isFinite(raw))raw=0;raw=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,raw));return 1-(raw/100);}

  function validRows(rows){return (rows||[]).filter(function(r){return Array.isArray(r)&&Number.isFinite(Number(r[1]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(r[2]))&&r[3]&&Number.isFinite(Number(r[3][10]));});}
  function boxRows(){try{return validRows((typeof BoxData!=='undefined'&&BoxData&&Array.isArray(BoxData.data))?BoxData.data:[]);}catch(e){return [];}}
  function rowsFor(kind){
    if(kind==='models'){
      try{var model=validRows(typeof ModelBoxData!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(ModelBoxData)?ModelBoxData:[]);if(model.length)return model;}catch(e){}
      return boxRows();
    }
    var all=boxRows();
    if(all.length)return all;
    try{
      var joined=[];
      if(typeof ProfileBoxData!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(ProfileBoxData)) ProfileBoxData.forEach(function(list){if(Array.isArray(list))joined=joined.concat(list);});
      return validRows(joined);
    }catch(e){return [];}
  }
  function pointElevation(r){return Number(r&&r[3]&&r[3][10])||0;}

  function geometry(rows){
    rows=validRows(rows);if(!rows.length)return null;
    var firstLat=Number(rows[0][1]),firstLon=Number(rows[0][2]);
    var xs=rows.map(function(r){return(firstLon-Number(r[2]))*100000;});
    var ys=rows.map(function(r){return(firstLat-Number(r[1]))*100000;});
    var xMin=Math.min.apply(null,xs),xMax=Math.max.apply(null,xs),yMin=Math.min.apply(null,ys),yMax=Math.max.apply(null,ys);
    var xSpan=Math.max(0,xMax-xMin),ySpan=Math.max(0,yMax-yMin);
    var padX=Math.max(55,xSpan*.10),padY=Math.max(55,ySpan*.10);
    xMin-=padX;xMax+=padX;yMin-=padY;yMax+=padY;
    return {xMin:xMin,xMax:xMax,yMin:yMin,yMax:yMax,minLon:firstLon-(xMax/100000),maxLon:firstLon-(xMin/100000),minLat:firstLat-(yMax/100000),maxLat:firstLat-(yMin/100000),firstLat:firstLat,firstLon:firstLon};
  }
  function elevationPoints(rows,g){return validRows(rows).map(function(r){return{x:(g.firstLon-Number(r[2]))*100000,y:(g.firstLat-Number(r[1]))*100000,z:pointElevation(r)};});}
  function surfaceElevation(points,x,y,below){
    if(!points.length)return-below;if(points.length===1)return points[0].z-below;
    var numerator=0,denominator=0;
    for(var n=0;n<points.length;n++){var dx=x-points[n].x,dy=y-points[n].y,d2=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(d2<.0001)return points[n].z-below;var w=1/d2;numerator+=points[n].z*w;denominator+=w;}
    return(denominator?numerator/denominator:points[0].z)-below;
  }
  function lin(a,b,count){var out=[],step=(b-a)/Math.max(1,count-1);for(var n=0;n<count;n++)out.push(a+step*n);return out;}
  function lonToTileX(lon,z){return((Number(lon)+180)/360)*Math.pow(2,z);}
  function latToTileY(lat,z){var c=Math.max(-85.05112878,Math.min(85.05112878,Number(lat))),rad=c*Math.PI/180;return(1-Math.log(Math.tan(rad)+1/Math.cos(rad))/Math.PI)/2*Math.pow(2,z);}
  function tileXToLon(x,z){return(Number(x)/Math.pow(2,z))*360-180;}
  function tileYToLat(y,z){var n=Math.PI-(2*Math.PI*Number(y))/Math.pow(2,z);return(180/Math.PI)*Math.atan(Math.sinh(n));}
  function tilePlans(g){
    var out=[];
    for(var z=21;z>=14;z--){var x0=Math.floor(lonToTileX(g.minLon,z)),x1=Math.floor(lonToTileX(g.maxLon,z)),y0=Math.floor(latToTileY(g.maxLat,z)),y1=Math.floor(latToTileY(g.minLat,z)),cols=x1-x0+1,rows=y1-y0+1;if(cols>0&&rows>0&&cols<=6&&rows<=6&&cols*rows<=30)out.push({z:z,x0:x0,x1:x1,y0:y0,y1:y1,cols:cols,rows:rows});if(out.length>=4)break;}
    return out;
  }
  function googleKey(){
    try{if(window.GeoVueGoogleMapsKey)return window.GeoVueGoogleMapsKey;if(window.GEOVUE_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY)return window.GEOVUE_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY;if(window.AAC)return window.AAC;if(typeof AAC!=='undefined')return AAC||'';}catch(e){}
    return'';
  }
  function locale(){var language=(navigator.language||'en-US').replace('_','-'),parts=language.split('-');return{language:language,region:(parts[1]&&/^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(parts[1]))?parts[1].toUpperCase():'US'};}
  async function googleSession(){
    var key=googleKey();if(!key)throw new Error('Google Maps API key is unavailable.');if(Date.now()<state.googleDisabledUntil)throw new Error('Google tile access is temporarily unavailable.');
    var sk='satellite-hybrid-hidpi2x',existing=state.sessions.get(sk);if(existing&&existing.value&&(!existing.expiry||Date.now()<existing.expiry-60000))return existing.value;if(existing&&existing.promise)return existing.promise;
    var loc=locale();
    var promise=(async function(){
      var response=await fetch('https://tile.googleapis.com/v1/createSession?key='+encodeURIComponent(key),{method:'POST',mode:'cors',credentials:'omit',cache:'no-store',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({mapType:'satellite',language:loc.language,region:loc.region,layerTypes:['layerRoadmap'],overlay:false,scale:'scaleFactor2x',highDpi:true,imageFormat:'jpeg'})});
      if(!response.ok){var detail='';try{detail=(await response.text()).slice(0,240);}catch(e){}throw new Error('Google Maps tile session failed ('+response.status+'). '+detail);}
      var data=await response.json();if(!data||!data.session)throw new Error('Google Maps tile session response was invalid.');
      var value={session:data.session,key:key,tileWidth:Number(data.tileWidth)||512,tileHeight:Number(data.tileHeight)||512};var expiry=Number(data.expiry);state.sessions.set(sk,{value:value,expiry:Number.isFinite(expiry)?expiry*1000:(Date.now()+12*60*60*1000)});return value;
    })();
    state.sessions.set(sk,{promise:promise});try{return await promise;}catch(error){state.sessions.delete(sk);state.googleDisabledUntil=Date.now()+5*60*1000;throw error;}
  }
  async function bitmap(url){
    var response=await fetch(url,{method:'GET',mode:'cors',credentials:'omit',cache:'force-cache'});if(!response.ok)throw new Error('Tile request failed ('+response.status+').');
    var type=(response.headers.get('content-type')||'').toLowerCase();if(type&&type.indexOf('image/')!==0)throw new Error('Tile service returned '+type+' instead of imagery.');
    var blob=await response.blob();if(!blob.size)throw new Error('Tile response was empty.');if(typeof createImageBitmap==='function')return createImageBitmap(blob);
    return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){var objectUrl=URL.createObjectURL(blob),img=new Image();img.onload=function(){URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);resolve(img);};img.onerror=function(){URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);reject(new Error('Tile image could not be decoded.'));};img.src=objectUrl;});
  }
  async function googleTile(z,x,y,c){var n=Math.pow(2,z),wrapped=((x%n)+n)%n;if(y<0||y>=n)throw new Error('Google satellite tile is outside the Web Mercator range.');return bitmap('https://tile.googleapis.com/v1/2dtiles/'+z+'/'+wrapped+'/'+y+'?session='+encodeURIComponent(c.session)+'&key='+encodeURIComponent(c.key));}
  async function esriTile(z,x,y){var n=Math.pow(2,z),wrapped=((x%n)+n)%n;if(y<0||y>=n)throw new Error('Esri satellite tile is outside the Web Mercator range.');return bitmap('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/'+z+'/'+y+'/'+wrapped);}
  function pixelStats(pixels){var count=0,sum=0,sumSq=0,nearWhite=0,colourful=0,stride=Math.max(4,Math.floor(pixels.length/(4*5000))*4);for(var i=0;i<pixels.length;i+=stride){var r=pixels[i],g=pixels[i+1],b=pixels[i+2],a=pixels[i+3];if(a<32)continue;var l=.2126*r+.7152*g+.0722*b,c=Math.max(r,g,b)-Math.min(r,g,b);count++;sum+=l;sumSq+=l*l;if(r>238&&g>238&&b>238)nearWhite++;if(c>18)colourful++;}var mean=count?sum/count:0,v=count?Math.max(0,(sumSq/count)-(mean*mean)):0;return{count:count,std:Math.sqrt(v),nearWhite:count?nearWhite/count:1,colourful:count?colourful/count:0};}
  function pixelsUseful(s){return!!(s&&s.count>=20&&!(s.nearWhite>.90&&s.std<24)&&!(s.std<4&&s.colourful<.01));}
  async function googleStatic(g,size){
    var key=googleKey();if(!key)throw new Error('Google Maps API key is unavailable.');var logical=640,scale=2,errors=[];
    for(var z=21;z>=14;z--){var wx0=lonToTileX(g.minLon,z)*256,wx1=lonToTileX(g.maxLon,z)*256,wy0=latToTileY(g.maxLat,z)*256,wy1=latToTileY(g.minLat,z)*256,ww=wx1-wx0,wh=wy1-wy0;if(!(ww>0&&wh>0&&ww<=logical-24&&wh<=logical-24))continue;var cx=(wx0+wx1)/2,cy=(wy0+wy1)/2,clon=tileXToLon(cx/256,z),clat=tileYToLat(cy/256,z);var url='https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/staticmap?center='+encodeURIComponent(clat.toFixed(7)+','+clon.toFixed(7))+'&zoom='+z+'&size='+logical+'x'+logical+'&scale='+scale+'&maptype=hybrid&format=png32&key='+encodeURIComponent(key),img=null;try{img=await bitmap(url);var aw=Number(img.width)||1280,ah=Number(img.height)||1280,xs=aw/logical,ys=ah/logical,cropX=(wx0-(cx-logical/2))*xs,cropY=(wy0-(cy-logical/2))*ys,cropW=ww*xs,cropH=wh*ys;if(cropX<0||cropY<0||cropX+cropW>aw||cropY+cropH>ah)throw new Error('Google Static Maps crop exceeded the returned image.');var sample=document.createElement('canvas');sample.width=size;sample.height=size;var ctx=sample.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});if(!ctx)throw new Error('Canvas sampling is unavailable.');ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;ctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';ctx.drawImage(img,cropX,cropY,cropW,cropH,0,0,size,size);var pixels=ctx.getImageData(0,0,size,size).data,stats=pixelStats(pixels);if(!pixelsUseful(stats))throw new Error('Google Static Maps returned a blank or low-detail image at zoom '+z+'.');return{size:size,pixels:pixels,zoom:z,provider:'google-static',attribution:'Google Maps satellite imagery'};}catch(error){errors.push(error);}finally{try{if(img&&typeof img.close==='function')img.close();}catch(e){}}}
    throw new Error('Google Static Maps imagery could not be loaded. '+(errors[0]?errors[0].message:''));
  }
  async function buildTexture(g,size,provider){
    var plans=tilePlans(g);if(!plans.length)throw new Error('Could not determine a satellite tile zoom level.');var context=provider==='google'?await googleSession():null,errors=[];
    for(var pi=0;pi<plans.length;pi++){var p=plans[pi],tw=context?context.tileWidth:256,th=context?context.tileHeight:256,canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=p.cols*tw;canvas.height=p.rows*th;var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});if(!ctx)throw new Error('Canvas is unavailable for satellite imagery.');var loaded=0,jobs=[];
      for(let ty=p.y0;ty<=p.y1;ty++)for(let tx=p.x0;tx<=p.x1;tx++){var load=provider==='google'?googleTile(p.z,tx,ty,context):esriTile(p.z,tx,ty);jobs.push(Promise.resolve(load).then(function(img){try{ctx.drawImage(img,(tx-p.x0)*tw,(ty-p.y0)*th,tw,th);loaded++;}finally{try{if(img&&typeof img.close==='function')img.close();}catch(e){}}}).catch(function(error){errors.push(error);}));}
      await Promise.all(jobs);if(loaded<p.cols*p.rows)continue;var cropX0=lonToTileX(g.minLon,p.z)*tw-p.x0*tw,cropX1=lonToTileX(g.maxLon,p.z)*tw-p.x0*tw,cropY0=latToTileY(g.maxLat,p.z)*th-p.y0*th,cropY1=latToTileY(g.minLat,p.z)*th-p.y0*th,cropW=Math.max(1,cropX1-cropX0),cropH=Math.max(1,cropY1-cropY0),sample=document.createElement('canvas');sample.width=size;sample.height=size;var sctx=sample.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});if(!sctx)throw new Error('Canvas sampling is unavailable.');sctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;sctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';sctx.drawImage(canvas,cropX0,cropY0,cropW,cropH,0,0,size,size);var pixels=sctx.getImageData(0,0,size,size).data,stats=pixelStats(pixels);if(!pixelsUseful(stats)){errors.push(new Error((provider==='google'?'Google':'Esri')+' returned a blank or low-detail image at zoom '+p.z+'.'));continue;}return{size:size,pixels:pixels,zoom:p.z,provider:provider,attribution:provider==='google'?'Google Maps satellite imagery':'Esri World Imagery'};
    }
    throw new Error((provider==='google'?'Google Maps':'Esri')+' satellite imagery could not be loaded. '+(errors[0]?errors[0].message:''));
  }
  function texture(g,size){
    var key=['report-sat-v1',g.minLon,g.maxLon,g.minLat,g.maxLat,size].map(function(v){return typeof v==='number'?Number(v).toFixed(7):v;}).join('|');if(state.cache.has(key))return state.cache.get(key);
    var promise=(async function(){if(navigator.onLine===false)throw new Error('Satellite imagery is unavailable offline.');var errors=[];if(googleKey()){try{return await buildTexture(g,size,'google');}catch(e){errors.push(e);console.warn('Google Map Tiles overlay fallback:',e);}try{return await googleStatic(g,size);}catch(e){errors.push(e);console.warn('Google Static Maps overlay fallback:',e);}}try{return await buildTexture(g,size,'esri');}catch(e){errors.push(e);}throw new Error(errors.map(function(e){return e&&e.message?e.message:String(e);}).join(' '));})();
    state.cache.set(key,promise);promise.catch(function(){state.cache.delete(key);});return promise;
  }
  function hex(pixels,index){function h(v){var s=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(v))).toString(16);return s.length<2?'0'+s:s;}return'#'+h(pixels[index])+h(pixels[index+1])+h(pixels[index+2]);}
  function textureSize(){var width=Math.max(document.documentElement.clientWidth||0,window.innerWidth||0),memory=Number(navigator.deviceMemory||8),ua=navigator.userAgent||'',platform=navigator.platform||'',ios=/iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(ua)||(platform==='MacIntel'&&navigator.maxTouchPoints>1);if(ios)return memory<=4?96:128;if(width<700)return memory<=4?144:176;if(memory<=4)return 192;return 256;}
  function meshTrace(g,t,rows,kind){
    var cells=t.size,vertices=cells+1,xs=lin(g.xMin,g.xMax,vertices),ys=lin(g.yMin,g.yMax,vertices),eps=elevationPoints(rows,g),elevs=eps.map(function(p){return p.z;}),span=elevs.length?Math.max.apply(null,elevs)-Math.min.apply(null,elevs):0,below=Math.max(.25,Math.min(1.25,span*.01||.35)),x=[],y=[],z=[];
    for(var row=0;row<vertices;row++)for(var col=0;col<vertices;col++){var xv=xs[col],yv=ys[row];x.push(xv);y.push(yv);z.push(surfaceElevation(eps,xv,yv,below));}
    var ii=[],jj=[],kk=[],face=[];for(var r=0;r<cells;r++)for(var c=0;c<cells;c++){var nw=r*vertices+c,ne=nw+1,sw=(r+1)*vertices+c,se=sw+1,sourceCol=cells-1-c,pixelIndex=(r*cells+sourceCol)*4,colour=hex(t.pixels,pixelIndex);ii.push(nw,nw);jj.push(sw,se);kk.push(se,ne);face.push(colour,colour);}
    return{type:'mesh3d',name:SAT_NAME,meta:{gvReportSatellite:true},x:x,y:y,z:z,i:ii,j:jj,k:kk,facecolor:face,flatshading:true,showscale:false,showlegend:false,hoverinfo:'skip',opacity:opacity(kind),lighting:{ambient:1,diffuse:0,specular:0,roughness:1,fresnel:0},lightposition:{x:0,y:0,z:100000}};
  }
  function satelliteIndices(el){var out=[];(el&&el.data||[]).forEach(function(t,i){if(t&&(t.name===SAT_NAME||(t.meta&&t.meta.gvReportSatellite)))out.push(i);});return out;}
  async function deleteSatellite(el){if(!el||!el.data)return;var indices=satelliteIndices(el).sort(function(a,b){return b-a;});for(var n=0;n<indices.length;n++){try{await Plotly.deleteTraces(el,indices[n]);}catch(e){}}}
  function annotation(text,error){return{text:text,xref:'paper',yref:'paper',x:1,y:0,xanchor:'right',yanchor:'bottom',showarrow:false,font:{size:9,color:error?'#9a4d00':'#444'},bgcolor:error?'rgba(255,239,210,.95)':'rgba(255,255,255,.88)',bordercolor:error?'rgba(154,77,0,.45)':'rgba(0,0,0,.18)',borderwidth:1,borderpad:4};}
  async function setAnnotation(el,text,error){if(!el||!el.layout)return;var arr=Array.isArray(el.layout.annotations)?el.layout.annotations.slice():[];arr=arr.filter(function(a){var s=String(a&&a.text||'');return !/satellite imagery|World Imagery|Satellite map/i.test(s);});if(text)arr.push(annotation(text,error));try{await Plotly.relayout(el,{annotations:arr});}catch(e){}}
  function setTopographyHidden(el,hidden){if(!el||!el.data||!window.Plotly)return;var ids=[];el.data.forEach(function(t,i){if(t&&String(t.name||'').toLowerCase()==='topography')ids.push(i);});if(ids.length)try{Plotly.restyle(el,{visible:hidden?false:true},ids);}catch(e){} }

  async function apply(kind){
    var el=byId(plotId(kind));if(!el||!el.data||!window.Plotly)return;if(!isChecked(kind)){await remove(kind);return;}var rows=rowsFor(kind);if(!rows.length)return;
    var token=nextToken(kind);state.applying[kind]=true;if(kind==='models')setTopographyHidden(el,true);
    try{await deleteSatellite(el);var g=geometry(rows);if(!g)return;var size=textureSize(),t=await texture(g,size);if(token!==state.tokens[kind]||!isChecked(kind)||!el.data)return;await Plotly.addTraces(el,meshTrace(g,t,rows,kind));if(token!==state.tokens[kind])return;await setAnnotation(el,t.attribution+' HD (z'+t.zoom+', '+t.size+' px)',false);}catch(error){console.warn('Satellite map overlay could not be rendered:',error);if(kind==='models')setTopographyHidden(el,false);if(token===state.tokens[kind])await setAnnotation(el,'Satellite imagery unavailable - check Google Maps API/network access',true);}finally{state.applying[kind]=false;}
  }
  async function remove(kind){var el=byId(plotId(kind));nextToken(kind);if(!el||!el.data)return;await deleteSatellite(el);await setAnnotation(el,'',false);if(kind==='models')setTopographyHidden(el,false);}
  function updateOpacity(kind){var el=byId(plotId(kind));if(!el||!el.data)return;var ids=satelliteIndices(el);if(ids.length){try{Plotly.restyle(el,{opacity:opacity(kind)},ids);}catch(e){}}else if(isChecked(kind))apply(kind);}

  function createControls(kind){
    if(byId(checkboxId(kind)))return;
    var host=document.createElement('div');host.className='gv-report-satellite-settings';host.id=kind==='profiles'?'gvReportProfileSatelliteControls':'gvReportModelSatelliteControls';
    var heading=kind==='profiles'?'<div class="heading-container gv-report-satellite-heading"><h4>Profile Settings :</h4></div>':'';
    var prefix=kind==='profiles'?'Profile':'Model';
    host.innerHTML=heading+'<div class="gv-report-satellite-check-row"><input type="checkbox" id="'+checkboxId(kind)+'"><label for="'+checkboxId(kind)+'">Show Map</label></div><div class="gv-report-satellite-range-row"><label for="'+sliderId(kind)+'">Map overlay transparency:</label><input type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="0" id="'+sliderId(kind)+'" aria-label="'+prefix+' map overlay transparency"><output id="'+outputId(kind)+'">0%</output></div>';
    if(kind==='models'){
      var mh=Array.prototype.find.call(document.querySelectorAll('h4'),function(h){return/^\s*Model Settings\s*:/i.test(h.textContent||'');});var ma=mh&&(mh.closest('.heading-container')||mh);if(ma)ma.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',host);else{var mp=byId(plotId(kind));if(mp)mp.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',host);}
    }else{
      var ph=Array.prototype.find.call(document.querySelectorAll('h4'),function(h){return/Create Site Profile Views/i.test(h.textContent||'');});var pa=ph&&(ph.closest('.heading-container')||ph);if(pa)pa.insertAdjacentElement('beforebegin',host);else{var pp=byId(plotId(kind));if(pp)pp.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',host);}
    }
    var check=byId(checkboxId(kind)),range=byId(sliderId(kind)),out=byId(outputId(kind));if(check)check.addEventListener('change',function(){if(check.checked)apply(kind);else remove(kind);});if(range)range.addEventListener('input',function(){if(out)out.value=range.value+'%';updateOpacity(kind);});
  }
  function scheduleApply(kind,delay){setTimeout(function(){if(isChecked(kind))apply(kind);else remove(kind);},delay||0);}
  function hookPlotly(){
    if(!window.Plotly||Plotly.__gvReportSatelliteHooked)return!!window.Plotly;Plotly.__gvReportSatelliteHooked=true;
    ['newPlot','react'].forEach(function(name){var original=Plotly[name];if(typeof original!=='function')return;Plotly[name]=function(gd){var result=original.apply(this,arguments),el=typeof gd==='string'?byId(gd):gd,id=el&&el.id;if(id===plotId('profiles')||id===plotId('models')){var kind=id===plotId('profiles')?'profiles':'models';Promise.resolve(result).then(function(){scheduleApply(kind,40);});}return result;};});
    return true;
  }
  function init(){createControls('profiles');createControls('models');hookPlotly();var tries=0,timer=setInterval(function(){tries++;hookPlotly();var p=byId(plotId('profiles')),m=byId(plotId('models'));if(p&&p.data)scheduleApply('profiles',20);if(m&&m.data)scheduleApply('models',20);if(tries>=20||((p&&p.data)&&(m&&m.data)))clearInterval(timer);},500);}
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();
</script>

<script id="gvReportDualLogOverlayJS">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.GV_REPORT_DUAL_LOG_OVERLAY_V13) return;
  window.GV_REPORT_DUAL_LOG_OVERLAY_V13=true;

  var FALLBACK_LITH_TYPES=['Unclassified','Soil','Sediment','Volcanic','Conglomerate','Sedimentary','Igneous','Salt','Mafic','Metamorphic','Ultra Mafic'];
  var FALLBACK_AQUIFER_TYPES=['Unclassified','Hard','Hard','Hard','Hard','Hard','Hard','Hard','Hard','Conglomerate','Conglomerate','Consolidated','Consolidated','Consolidated','Consolidated','Dual Porosity','Unconsolidated','Saturated'];
  var FALLBACK_LITH_COLORS=['LightGrey','Brown','Yellow','Silver','Green','Orange','MediumGray','Cream','Gray','DarkGrey','Black'];
  var FALLBACK_AQUIFER_COLORS=['LightGrey','Teal','Teal','Teal','Teal','Teal','Teal','Teal','Teal','SkyBlue','SkyBlue','SkyBlue','SkyBlue','SkyBlue','SkyBlue','Blue','Navy','Aqua'];

  function byId(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
  function lithTypes(){try{return typeof LithType!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(LithType)?LithType:FALLBACK_LITH_TYPES;}catch(e){return FALLBACK_LITH_TYPES;}}
  function aquiferTypes(){try{return typeof AquiferType!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(AquiferType)?AquiferType:FALLBACK_AQUIFER_TYPES;}catch(e){return FALLBACK_AQUIFER_TYPES;}}
  function lithColors(){try{return typeof LithTypeColor!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(LithTypeColor)?LithTypeColor:FALLBACK_LITH_COLORS;}catch(e){return FALLBACK_LITH_COLORS;}}
  function aquiferColors(){try{return typeof AquiferTypeColor!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(AquiferTypeColor)?AquiferTypeColor:FALLBACK_AQUIFER_COLORS;}catch(e){return FALLBACK_AQUIFER_COLORS;}}
  function cssColor(color){
    var map={lightgrey:'#D3D3D3',lightgray:'#D3D3D3',teal:'#008080',skyblue:'#87CEEB',blue:'#0000FF',navy:'#000080',aqua:'#00FFFF',brown:'#A52A2A',yellow:'#FFFF00',silver:'#C0C0C0',green:'#008000',orange:'#FFA500',mediumgray:'#808080',mediumgrey:'#808080',cream:'#FFFDD0',gray:'#808080',grey:'#808080',darkgrey:'#A9A9A9',darkgray:'#A9A9A9',black:'#000000'};
    var key=String(color||'LightGrey').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'');
    return map[key]||color||'#D3D3D3';
  }
  function classIndex(value,max){var n=Math.trunc(Number(value));return Number.isFinite(n)&&n>=0&&n<max?n:0;}
  function validRows(rows){return (rows||[]).filter(function(row){return Array.isArray(row)&&Number.isFinite(Number(row[1]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(row[2]))&&row[3]&&Number.isFinite(Number(row[3][10]))&&Array.isArray(row[6]);});}
  function boxRows(){try{return validRows(typeof BoxData!=='undefined'&&BoxData&&Array.isArray(BoxData.data)?BoxData.data:[]);}catch(e){return [];}}
  function uniqueRows(rows){
    var seen={},out=[];
    (rows||[]).forEach(function(row){
      if(!row)return;
      var key=String(row[0])+'|'+String(row[1])+'|'+String(row[2]);
      if(seen[key])return;
      seen[key]=true;out.push(row);
    });
    return out;
  }
  function rowsFor(kind){
    if(kind==='sections'){
      try{var section=validRows(typeof SectionBoxData!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(SectionBoxData)?SectionBoxData:[]);if(section.length)return section;}catch(e){}
      return boxRows();
    }
    if(kind==='models'){
      try{var model=validRows(typeof ModelBoxData!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(ModelBoxData)?ModelBoxData:[]);if(model.length)return model;}catch(e){}
      return boxRows();
    }
    // Match the app profile selection rule exactly: Profile One is the primary
    // selection, and when it is empty the complete point set forms the primary
    // profile before Profile Two and Profile Three are added.
    try{
      var all=boxRows(),p1=[],p2=[],p3=[];
      if(typeof ProfileBoxData!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(ProfileBoxData)){
        p1=validRows(Array.isArray(ProfileBoxData[0])?ProfileBoxData[0]:[]);
        p2=validRows(Array.isArray(ProfileBoxData[1])?ProfileBoxData[1]:[]);
        p3=validRows(Array.isArray(ProfileBoxData[2])?ProfileBoxData[2]:[]);
      }
      var joined=uniqueRows((p1.length?p1:all).concat(p2,p3));
      if(joined.length)return joined;
    }catch(e){}
    return boxRows();
  }
  function originRowsFor(kind,rows){
    if(kind==='profiles'){
      var all=boxRows();
      if(all.length)return all;
    }
    return rows;
  }
  function pointElevation(row){return Number(row&&row[3]&&row[3][10])||0;}
  function normalizedLayers(row){
    var lt=lithTypes(),at=aquiferTypes();
    var source=(row&&Array.isArray(row[6])?row[6]:[]).map(function(layer,index){
      var from=Number(layer&&layer[0]),to=Number(layer&&layer[1]);
      if(!Number.isFinite(from)||!Number.isFinite(to))return null;
      if(to<from){var swap=from;from=to;to=swap;}
      if(to<=from)return null;
      return{source:layer,index:index,from:from,to:to,lith:classIndex(layer&&layer[2],lt.length),aquifer:classIndex(layer&&layer[3],at.length)};
    }).filter(Boolean).sort(function(a,b){return a.from-b.from||a.to-b.to||a.index-b.index;});
    if(!source.length)return[];
    var bounds=[source[0].from],i;
    for(i=1;i<source.length;i++)bounds.push((source[i-1].to+source[i].from)/2);
    bounds.push(source[source.length-1].to);
    for(i=1;i<bounds.length;i++)if(!Number.isFinite(bounds[i])||bounds[i]<=bounds[i-1])bounds[i]=bounds[i-1]+.0001;
    return source.map(function(layer,n){return{source:layer.source,index:layer.index,from:bounds[n],to:bounds[n+1],lith:layer.lith,aquifer:layer.aquifer};});
  }
  function median(values){
    var sorted=(values||[]).filter(function(v){return Number.isFinite(v)&&v>0;}).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
    if(!sorted.length)return null;
    var m=Math.floor(sorted.length/2);return sorted.length%2?sorted[m]:(sorted[m-1]+sorted[m])/2;
  }
  function radians(deg){return Number(deg)*Math.PI/180;}
  function distanceMeters(lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2){
    var R=6371000,a1=radians(lat1),a2=radians(lat2),da=a2-a1,do2=radians(lon2)-radians(lon1);
    var a=Math.sin(da/2)*Math.sin(da/2)+Math.cos(a1)*Math.cos(a2)*Math.sin(do2/2)*Math.sin(do2/2);
    return R*2*Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a),Math.sqrt(1-a));
  }
  function sectionDistances(rows){
    var out=[],total=0;
    if(!rows.length)return out;
    var prevLat=Number(rows[0][1]),prevLon=Number(rows[0][2]);
    rows.forEach(function(row){
      total+=distanceMeters(prevLat,prevLon,Number(row[1]),Number(row[2]));
      out.push(total);prevLat=Number(row[1]);prevLon=Number(row[2]);
    });
    return out;
  }
  function sectionTraces(rows){
    var distances=sectionDistances(rows),finite=distances.filter(Number.isFinite).slice().sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}),diffs=[],i;
    for(i=1;i<finite.length;i++){var d=finite[i]-finite[i-1];if(d>.0001)diffs.push(d);}
    var span=finite.length?Math.max(1,finite[finite.length-1]-finite[0]):20;
    var spacing=median(diffs)||Math.max(8,span*.15);
    var pairWidth=Math.max(1,Math.min(12,spacing*.12));
    var groups={};
    function add(kind,index,x0,x1,y0,y1){
      var types=kind==='lith'?lithTypes():aquiferTypes(),colors=kind==='lith'?lithColors():aquiferColors(),key=kind+':'+index;
      if(!groups[key])groups[key]={kind:kind,index:index,label:types[index]||'Unclassified',color:cssColor(colors[index]||'LightGrey'),x:[],y:[]};
      var g=groups[key];g.x.push(x0,x1,x1,x0,x0,null);g.y.push(y0,y0,y1,y1,y0,null);
    }
    rows.forEach(function(row,n){
      var center=Number(distances[n]);if(!Number.isFinite(center))return;
      var elevation=pointElevation(row);
      normalizedLayers(row).forEach(function(layer){
        var top=elevation-layer.from,bottom=elevation-layer.to;
        add('lith',layer.lith,center-pairWidth/2,center,top,bottom);
        add('aquifer',layer.aquifer,center,center+pairWidth/2,top,bottom);
      });
    });
    return Object.keys(groups).map(function(key){
      var g=groups[key];
      return{type:'scatter',mode:'none',x:g.x,y:g.y,fill:'toself',fillcolor:g.color,line:{color:'rgba(0,0,0,0)',width:0},name:(g.kind==='lith'?'Lithology: ':'Aquifer Type: ')+g.label,showlegend:false,hoverinfo:'name',connectgaps:false,meta:{gvReportLogOverlay:true}};
    });
  }
  function pointKey(value){return String(value==null?'':value).replace(/^\s*point\s*/i,'').trim().toLowerCase();}
  function renderedPointGeometry(plotData){
    var map={},points=[];
    (Array.isArray(plotData)?plotData:[]).forEach(function(trace){
      if(!trace||String(trace.type||'').toLowerCase()!=='scatter3d')return;
      var mode=String(trace.mode||'').toLowerCase(),text=Array.isArray(trace.text)?trace.text:[];
      if(mode.indexOf('text')<0||!text.length||!Array.isArray(trace.x)||!Array.isArray(trace.y)||!Array.isArray(trace.z))return;
      var count=Math.min(text.length,trace.x.length,trace.y.length,trace.z.length);
      for(var i=0;i<count;i++){
        var x=Number(trace.x[i]),y=Number(trace.y[i]),z=Number(trace.z[i]);
        if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y)||!Number.isFinite(z))continue;
        var key=pointKey(text[i]);
        if(!key)continue;
        var point={x:x,y:y,z:z,key:key};
        if(!map[key])map[key]=point;
        points.push(point);
      }
    });
    return{map:map,points:points};
  }
  function rowGeometry(row,firstLat,firstLon,rendered){
    var key=pointKey(row&&row[0]),match=rendered&&rendered.map&&rendered.map[key];
    if(match)return{x:match.x,y:match.y,z:match.z};
    return{x:(firstLon-Number(row&&row[2]))*100000,y:(firstLat-Number(row&&row[1]))*100000,z:pointElevation(row)};
  }
  function spacing3d(rows,firstLat,firstLon,rendered){
    var pts=(rows||[]).map(function(row){return rowGeometry(row,firstLat,firstLon,rendered);}).filter(function(p){return Number.isFinite(p.x)&&Number.isFinite(p.y);}),nearest=[];
    for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
      var best=Infinity;
      for(var j=0;j<pts.length;j++){if(i===j)continue;var d=Math.hypot(pts[i].x-pts[j].x,pts[i].y-pts[j].y);if(d>.000000001&&d<best)best=d;}
      if(Number.isFinite(best))nearest.push(best);
    }
    return median(nearest)||null;
  }
  function appSpacing3d(rows,firstLat,firstLon){
    var pts=(rows||[]).map(function(row){
      return{x:(firstLon-Number(row&&row[2]))*100000,y:(firstLat-Number(row&&row[1]))*100000};
    }).filter(function(p){return Number.isFinite(p.x)&&Number.isFinite(p.y);}),nearest=[];
    for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
      var best=Infinity;
      for(var j=0;j<pts.length;j++){if(i===j)continue;var d=Math.hypot(pts[i].x-pts[j].x,pts[i].y-pts[j].y);if(d>.001&&d<best)best=d;}
      if(Number.isFinite(best))nearest.push(best);
    }
    return median(nearest)||18;
  }
  function reportLogCoordinateScale(rows,firstLat,firstLon,rendered){
    var renderedSpacing=spacing3d(rows,firstLat,firstLon,rendered);
    var appSpacing=appSpacing3d(rows,firstLat,firstLon);
    if(Number.isFinite(renderedSpacing)&&renderedSpacing>0&&Number.isFinite(appSpacing)&&appSpacing>0)return renderedSpacing/appSpacing;
    return 1;
  }
  function reportLogUpdateRange(value,range){
    var isList=Array.isArray(value)||(typeof ArrayBuffer!=='undefined'&&ArrayBuffer.isView&&ArrayBuffer.isView(value));
    if(isList){
      for(var i=0;i<value.length;i++)reportLogUpdateRange(value[i],range);
      return;
    }
    var number=Number(value);
    if(!Number.isFinite(number))return;
    if(number<range.min)range.min=number;
    if(number>range.max)range.max=number;
  }
  function reportLogPlotSpans(plotData,rendered){
    // Keep only running minima and maxima. The Model plot contains large 3D
    // coordinate arrays; collecting them and passing them to Math.min/apply
    // could exceed the JavaScript argument limit before any meshes or legends
    // were created. This produces the same spans without allocating copies.
    var xr={min:Infinity,max:-Infinity},yr={min:Infinity,max:-Infinity};
    (Array.isArray(plotData)?plotData:[]).forEach(function(trace){
      if(!trace||(trace.meta&&trace.meta.gvReportLogOverlay))return;
      var type=String(trace.type||'').toLowerCase();
      if(type!=='scatter3d'&&type!=='mesh3d'&&type!=='surface'&&type!=='volume'&&type!=='isosurface'&&type!=='cone'&&type!=='streamtube')return;
      reportLogUpdateRange(trace.x,xr);
      reportLogUpdateRange(trace.y,yr);
    });
    if((!Number.isFinite(xr.min)||!Number.isFinite(xr.max)||!Number.isFinite(yr.min)||!Number.isFinite(yr.max))&&rendered&&Array.isArray(rendered.points)){
      rendered.points.forEach(function(point){
        reportLogUpdateRange(point&&point.x,xr);
        reportLogUpdateRange(point&&point.y,yr);
      });
    }
    var xSpan=Number.isFinite(xr.min)&&Number.isFinite(xr.max)?xr.max-xr.min:0;
    var ySpan=Number.isFinite(yr.min)&&Number.isFinite(yr.max)?yr.max-yr.min:0;
    if(!(xSpan>0)&&ySpan>0)xSpan=ySpan;
    if(!(ySpan>0)&&xSpan>0)ySpan=xSpan;
    if(!(xSpan>0))xSpan=1;
    if(!(ySpan>0))ySpan=1;
    return{xSpan:xSpan,ySpan:ySpan};
  }
  function reportLogSquareDimensions(columnWidth,plotData,rendered){
    var spans=reportLogPlotSpans(plotData,rendered);
    // V5 used the same coordinate side on both horizontal axes. In report
    // scenes whose X and Y ranges differ greatly, Plotly's automatic cube
    // aspect made that coordinate-square appear as a very wide, thin slab.
    // Measure the old apparent long side as a fraction of the scene and make
    // the new square one quarter of that apparent width on both axes.
    var previousCoordinateSide=Math.max(1e-12,Math.abs(Number(columnWidth)||0)*.5);
    var previousXFraction=previousCoordinateSide/spans.xSpan;
    var previousYFraction=previousCoordinateSide/spans.ySpan;
    var targetFraction=Math.max(previousXFraction,previousYFraction)*.25;
    // Protect degenerate or nearly collinear report geometry while retaining
    // the requested compact, app-like proportions.
    targetFraction=Math.max(.001,Math.min(.04,targetFraction));
    return{xSide:spans.xSpan*targetFraction,ySide:spans.ySpan*targetFraction};
  }
  function addCuboid(group,x0,x1,y0,y1,zTop,zBottom,hover){
    var b=group.x.length;
    group.x.push(x0,x1,x1,x0,x0,x1,x1,x0);
    group.y.push(y0,y0,y1,y1,y0,y0,y1,y1);
    group.z.push(zTop,zTop,zTop,zTop,zBottom,zBottom,zBottom,zBottom);
    var faces=[[0,1,2],[0,2,3],[4,6,5],[4,7,6],[0,4,5],[0,5,1],[1,5,6],[1,6,2],[2,6,7],[2,7,3],[3,7,4],[3,4,0]];
    faces.forEach(function(face){group.i.push(b+face[0]);group.j.push(b+face[1]);group.k.push(b+face[2]);});
    for(var n=0;n<8;n++)group.text.push(hover);
  }
  function traces3d(rows,originRows,plotData){
    var origin=originRows&&originRows.length?originRows:rows;
    if(!rows.length||!origin.length)return[];
    var firstLat=Number(origin[0][1])||0,firstLon=Number(origin[0][2])||0,rendered=renderedPointGeometry(plotData);
    // Use the exact point coordinates and ground elevations already supplied to
    // the report plot wherever available. This keeps the report logs aligned
    // with the model/profile geometry even after report-specific processing.
    // Calculate the physical width in the app's metre-like coordinate system first,
    // then convert it into the report plot's rendered coordinate units. Applying
    // the app clamp before conversion prevents degree-based report plots from
    // producing oversized log blocks.
    var appSpacing=appSpacing3d(origin,firstLat,firstLon);
    var appColumnWidth=Math.max(.8,Math.min(9,appSpacing*.085));
    var columnWidth=appColumnWidth*reportLogCoordinateScale(origin,firstLat,firstLon,rendered);
    // Calculate the compact square once per plot. Re-scanning the full Model
    // volume for every well could interrupt the direct Model render before the
    // overlay traces and legends were supplied to Plotly.
    var square=reportLogSquareDimensions(columnWidth,plotData,rendered),groups={};
    function getGroup(kind,index){
      var types=kind==='lith'?lithTypes():aquiferTypes(),colors=kind==='lith'?lithColors():aquiferColors(),key=kind+':'+index;
      if(!groups[key])groups[key]={kind:kind,index:index,label:types[index]||'Unclassified',color:cssColor(colors[index]||'LightGrey'),x:[],y:[],z:[],i:[],j:[],k:[],text:[]};
      return groups[key];
    }
    rows.forEach(function(row){
      var position=rowGeometry(row,firstLat,firstLon,rendered),x=position.x,y=position.y,elevation=position.z;
      if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y)||!Number.isFinite(elevation))return;
      var layers=normalizedLayers(row);if(!layers.length)return;
      // Keep Lithology and Aquifer Type front-to-back inside one shared
      // visually square footprint. X and Y coordinate widths are calculated
      // separately so Plotly scene-range differences cannot stretch the logs
      // into wide slabs. The visible square side is one quarter of the former
      // apparent long side, matching the compact proportions used in the app.
      var halfX=square.xSide/2,halfY=square.ySide/2;
      var x0=x-halfX,x1=x+halfX,y0=y-halfY,ym=y,y1=y+halfY;
      layers.forEach(function(layer){
        var zTop=elevation-layer.from,zBottom=elevation-layer.to,point=String(row[0]==null?'':row[0]),lithLabel=lithTypes()[layer.lith]||'Unclassified',aquiferLabel=aquiferTypes()[layer.aquifer]||'Unclassified';
        addCuboid(getGroup('lith',layer.lith),x0,x1,y0,ym,zTop,zBottom,'<b>Point '+point+'</b><br>Lithology: '+lithLabel+'<br>Depth: '+layer.from.toFixed(2)+'-'+layer.to.toFixed(2)+' mbgl');
        addCuboid(getGroup('aquifer',layer.aquifer),x0,x1,ym,y1,zTop,zBottom,'<b>Point '+point+'</b><br>Aquifer Type: '+aquiferLabel+'<br>Depth: '+layer.from.toFixed(2)+'-'+layer.to.toFixed(2)+' mbgl');
      });
    });
    return Object.keys(groups).map(function(key){
      var g=groups[key];
      return{type:'mesh3d',x:g.x,y:g.y,z:g.z,i:g.i,j:g.j,k:g.k,color:g.color,opacity:1,flatshading:true,name:(g.kind==='lith'?'Lithology: ':'Aquifer Type: ')+g.label,showlegend:false,showscale:false,hovertext:g.text,hovertemplate:'%{hovertext}<extra></extra>',lighting:{ambient:1,diffuse:0,roughness:1,specular:0,fresnel:0},lightposition:{x:0,y:0,z:100000},meta:{gvReportLogOverlay:true,gvReportLogGeometryVersion:'compact-square-v11'}};
    });
  }
  function enabled(kind){
    var id=kind==='sections'?'show-sectionlogs-checkbox':kind==='models'?'show-logs-checkbox':'gv-report-profile-logs-checkbox';
    var checkbox=byId(id);if(checkbox)return!!checkbox.checked;
    try{if(kind==='sections'&&typeof SectionLogsState!=='undefined')return Number(SectionLogsState)===1;if(kind==='models'&&typeof LogState!=='undefined')return Number(LogState)===1;}catch(e){}
    return kind==='profiles';
  }
  function metrics(width){var w=Math.max(320,Number(width)||Number(window.innerWidth)||1100);if(w<=520)return{width:110,margin:185};if(w<=760)return{width:145,margin:225};return{width:170,margin:270};}
  function cloneLayout(layout){
    var out=Object.assign({},layout||{});out.margin=Object.assign({},layout&&layout.margin||{});
    if(layout&&layout.scene)out.scene=Object.assign({},layout.scene);
    if(layout&&Array.isArray(layout.annotations))out.annotations=layout.annotations.slice();
    return out;
  }
  function colorbarForLogs(trace){
    if(!trace||!trace.colorbar||String(trace.name||'').toLowerCase()==='topography')return trace;
    var copy=Object.assign({},trace);copy.colorbar=Object.assign({},trace.colorbar,{x:1.015,xanchor:'left',y:.5,yanchor:'middle',len:.84,thickness:22,xpad:6});return copy;
  }
  function isOldSectionLog(trace){return!!(trace&&trace.type==='scatter'&&trace.mode==='markers'&&trace.marker&&trace.marker.symbol==='square'&&Number(trace.marker.size)===2);}
  function isOld3dLog(trace){return!!(trace&&trace.type==='scatter3d'&&trace.mode==='markers'&&trace.marker&&trace.marker.symbol==='square'&&Number(trace.marker.size)===2);}
  function transform(kind,data,layout){
    var show=enabled(kind),rows=rowsFor(kind),out=[];
    (Array.isArray(data)?data:[]).forEach(function(trace){
      if(trace&&trace.meta&&trace.meta.gvReportLogOverlay)return;
      if(kind==='sections'&&isOldSectionLog(trace))return;
      if((kind==='profiles'||kind==='models')&&isOld3dLog(trace))return;
      out.push(show?colorbarForLogs(trace):trace);
    });
    if(show&&rows.length){
      var overlay=kind==='sections'?sectionTraces(rows):traces3d(rows,originRowsFor(kind,rows),data);
      out=out.concat(overlay);
    }
    var nextLayout=cloneLayout(layout);
    if(show){var m=metrics(nextLayout.width);nextLayout.margin.r=Math.max(Number(nextLayout.margin.r)||0,m.margin);}
    return{data:out,layout:nextLayout,show:show};
  }
  function legendEntries(types,colors){
    var seen={},out=[];
    for(var i=0;i<Math.max(types.length,colors.length);i++){
      var label=String(types[i]||('Class '+i)),color=cssColor(colors[i]||'LightGrey'),key=label+'|'+color;
      if(seen[key])continue;seen[key]=true;out.push({label:label,color:color});
    }
    return out;
  }
  function setLegends(el,show){
    if(!el)return;
    Array.prototype.slice.call(el.querySelectorAll('.gv-report-log-legends')).forEach(function(node){node.remove();});
    if(!show)return;
    var wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='gv-report-log-legends';wrap.style.width=metrics(el._fullLayout&&el._fullLayout.width||el.clientWidth).width+'px';
    function box(title,entries){
      var section=document.createElement('div');section.className='gv-report-log-legend';
      var heading=document.createElement('div');heading.className='gv-report-log-legend-title';heading.textContent=title;section.appendChild(heading);
      var items=document.createElement('div');items.className='gv-report-log-legend-items';
      entries.forEach(function(entry){var row=document.createElement('div');row.className='gv-report-log-legend-item';var swatch=document.createElement('span');swatch.className='gv-report-log-legend-swatch';swatch.style.backgroundColor=entry.color;var label=document.createElement('span');label.className='gv-report-log-legend-label';label.textContent=entry.label;row.appendChild(swatch);row.appendChild(label);items.appendChild(row);});
      section.appendChild(items);return section;
    }
    wrap.appendChild(box('Lithology',legendEntries(lithTypes(),lithColors())));
    wrap.appendChild(box('Aquifer Type',legendEntries(aquiferTypes(),aquiferColors())));
    el.appendChild(wrap);
  }
  function composeModelLikeApp(data,layout){
    var show=enabled('models'),rows=rowsFor('models'),out=[];
    (Array.isArray(data)?data:[]).forEach(function(trace){
      if(trace&&trace.meta&&trace.meta.gvReportLogOverlay)return;
      if(isOld3dLog(trace))return;
      out.push(show?colorbarForLogs(trace):trace);
    });
    var logTraces=show&&rows.length?traces3d(rows,rows,data):[];
    if(logTraces.length)out=out.concat(logTraces);
    var nextLayout=cloneLayout(layout);
    if(show&&logTraces.length){var m=metrics(nextLayout.width);nextLayout.margin.r=Math.max(Number(nextLayout.margin.r)||0,m.margin);}
    return{data:out,layout:nextLayout,show:show&&logTraces.length>0};
  }
  function renderModelLikeApp(data,layout){
    var el=byId('plotly-Model1');
    if(!el||!window.Plotly||typeof Plotly.newPlot!=='function')return null;
    var changed=composeModelLikeApp(data,layout);
    var result=Plotly.newPlot(el,changed.data,changed.layout);
    Promise.resolve(result).then(function(){setLegends(el,changed.show);});
    return result;
  }
  window.gvReportAppModelLogTraces=traces3d;
  window.gvReportAppRenderModel=renderModelLikeApp;
  function kindFromPlot(gd){
    var el=typeof gd==='string'?byId(gd):gd,id=el&&el.id||String(gd||'');
    if(id==='plotly-Sections')return'sections';if(id==='plotly-Profile1')return'profiles';return'';
  }
  function hookPlotly(){
    if(!window.Plotly||Plotly.__gvReportDualLogOverlayHooked)return!!window.Plotly;
    Plotly.__gvReportDualLogOverlayHooked=true;
    ['newPlot','react'].forEach(function(name){
      var original=Plotly[name];if(typeof original!=='function')return;
      if(name==='react')Plotly.__gvReportDualLogOriginalReact=original;
      Plotly[name]=function(gd,data,layout){
        var kind=kindFromPlot(gd),args=Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments),result;
        if(kind){var changed=transform(kind,data,layout);args[1]=changed.data;args[2]=changed.layout;result=original.apply(this,args);var el=typeof gd==='string'?byId(gd):gd;Promise.resolve(result).then(function(){setLegends(el,changed.show);});return result;}
        return original.apply(this,args);
      };
    });
    return true;
  }
  function renameLabels(){
    var sectionLabel=document.querySelector('label[for="show-sectionlogs-checkbox"]');if(sectionLabel)sectionLabel.textContent='Show logs';
    var modelLabel=document.querySelector('label[for="show-logs-checkbox"]');if(modelLabel)modelLabel.textContent='Show logs';
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.gv-report-satellite-check-row label'),function(label){label.textContent='Show Map';});
  }
  function createProfileControl(){
    if(byId('gv-report-profile-logs-checkbox'))return;
    var row=document.createElement('div');row.className='gv-report-profile-log-row';row.innerHTML='<input type="checkbox" id="gv-report-profile-logs-checkbox"><label for="gv-report-profile-logs-checkbox">Show logs</label>';
    var host=byId('gvReportProfileSatelliteControls');
    if(host){var range=host.querySelector('.gv-report-satellite-range-row');if(range)host.insertBefore(row,range);else host.appendChild(row);}
    else{var plot=byId('plotly-Profile1');if(plot)plot.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',row);}
    var checkbox=byId('gv-report-profile-logs-checkbox');
    if(checkbox)checkbox.addEventListener('change',function(){try{if(typeof updateProfilePlot==='function')updateProfilePlot(typeof ProfileselectedDataHold!=='undefined'?ProfileselectedDataHold:'dataset40');else if(typeof RefreshProfilePlot==='function')RefreshProfilePlot();}catch(e){try{if(typeof RefreshProfilePlot==='function')RefreshProfilePlot();}catch(ignore){}}});
  }
  function updateExistingLegends(){
    ['sections','profiles','models'].forEach(function(kind){var id=kind==='sections'?'plotly-Sections':kind==='profiles'?'plotly-Profile1':'plotly-Model1',el=byId(id);if(el&&el.data)setLegends(el,enabled(kind));});
  }
  function currentModelDataset(){
    try{
      if(typeof selectedDataHold!=='undefined'&&selectedDataHold)return selectedDataHold;
      var select=byId('GeoVueModelDatasetSelect')||document.querySelector('select[onchange*="updateVolumePlot"]');
      if(select&&select.value)return select.value;
    }catch(e){}
    return'dataset40';
  }
  function refreshModelLikeProfile(){
    try{
      if(typeof updateVolumePlot==='function'){
        updateVolumePlot(currentModelDataset());
        return true;
      }
      if(typeof RefreshVolumePlot==='function'){
        RefreshVolumePlot();
        return true;
      }
    }catch(error){console.error('Could not rebuild the Site Model plot with app-style log overlays.',error);}
    return false;
  }
  function bindModelLogControl(){
    var checkbox=byId('show-logs-checkbox');
    if(!checkbox||checkbox.__gvReportModelLogControlBound)return;
    checkbox.__gvReportModelLogControlBound=true;
    try{checkbox.removeAttribute('onchange');checkbox.onchange=null;}catch(e){}
    checkbox.addEventListener('change',function(){
      try{if(typeof LogState!=='undefined')LogState=this.checked?1:0;}catch(e){}
      refreshModelLikeProfile();
    });
  }
  function init(){
    renameLabels();createProfileControl();hookPlotly();bindModelLogControl();
    var tries=0,timer=setInterval(function(){tries++;hookPlotly();renameLabels();createProfileControl();bindModelLogControl();updateExistingLegends();if(tries>=20)clearInterval(timer);},400);
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();

(function(){
  'use strict';
  if (window.GV_REPORT_POINT_INCLUSION_V1) return;
  window.GV_REPORT_POINT_INCLUSION_V1 = true;
  if (!window.BoxData || !Array.isArray(window.BoxData.data)) return;

  var box = window.BoxData;
  var allRows = box.data;
  var excluded = new Set();
  var refreshing = false;
  var refreshTimer = null;
  var startupBypass = false;
  // Keep the complete master dataset visible while the report's original startup handlers run.
  // Filtering is enabled only after window.load so a persisted zero-point selection cannot break initialization.
  var filteringEnabled = document.readyState === 'complete';
  var filteringActivated = false;

  function esc(value){
    return String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(ch){
      return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch];
    });
  }
  function pointKeyFromRow(row){
    return row && row[0] != null && String(row[0]).trim() !== '' ? 'point:' + String(row[0]).trim() : '';
  }
  function isIncludedRow(row){
    var key = pointKeyFromRow(row);
    return !!key && !excluded.has(key);
  }
  function activeRows(){
    return startupBypass ? allRows.slice() : allRows.filter(isIncludedRow);
  }
  function pointFingerprint(){
    var s = allRows.map(function(row){
      return [pointKeyFromRow(row), Number(row && row[1]), Number(row && row[2])].join('@');
    }).join('|');
    var h = 2166136261;
    for (var i=0;i<s.length;i++) {
      h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
      h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
    }
    return (h >>> 0).toString(36);
  }
  function storageKey(){
    var state = box.geovueReportTransferState || {};
    var project = String(state.projectId || state.projectName || box.name || 'report').replace(/\s+/g,'_');
    return 'GeoVueReportPointInclusionV1:' + project + ':' + pointFingerprint();
  }
  function cleanExcludedKeys(keys){
    var valid = new Set(allRows.map(pointKeyFromRow));
    return (Array.isArray(keys) ? keys : []).map(String).filter(function(k){ return valid.has(k); });
  }
  function loadState(){
    var embedded = cleanExcludedKeys(box.geovuePointInclusion && box.geovuePointInclusion.excludedPointKeys);
    var chosen = embedded;
    try {
      var raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey());
      if (raw) {
        var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (parsed && parsed.version === 1 && Array.isArray(parsed.excludedPointKeys)) {
          chosen = cleanExcludedKeys(parsed.excludedPointKeys);
        }
      }
    } catch(e) {}
    excluded = new Set(chosen);
  }
  function syncEmbeddedState(){
    box.geovuePointInclusion = {
      version: 1,
      excludedPointKeys: Array.from(excluded),
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }
  function persistState(){
    syncEmbeddedState();
    try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey(), JSON.stringify(box.geovuePointInclusion)); } catch(e) {}
  }

  loadState();

  try {
    Object.defineProperty(box, 'data', {
      configurable: true,
      enumerable: true,
      get: function(){ return filteringEnabled ? activeRows() : allRows; },
      set: function(value){
        if (value === allRows || !Array.isArray(value)) return;
        // Never let an active/filtered subset replace the master rows. A genuine full-data
        // replacement is still accepted when it contains every existing point key.
        var currentKeys = new Set(allRows.map(pointKeyFromRow).filter(Boolean));
        var incomingKeys = new Set(value.map(pointKeyFromRow).filter(Boolean));
        var containsMaster = true;
        currentKeys.forEach(function(key){ if (!incomingKeys.has(key)) containsMaster = false; });
        if (!filteringEnabled || allRows.length === 0 || containsMaster) {
          allRows = value;
          window.GV_REPORT_ALL_POINTS = allRows;
          excluded = new Set(cleanExcludedKeys(Array.from(excluded)));
        }
      }
    });
  } catch(e) {
    // If an unusual browser refuses the accessor, leave the report untouched rather than delete rows.
    window.GV_REPORT_POINT_INCLUSION_V1 = false;
    return;
  }

  try {
    Object.defineProperty(box, 'toJSON', {
      configurable: true,
      enumerable: false,
      value: function(){
        syncEmbeddedState();
        var out = {};
        Object.keys(box).forEach(function(key){ if (key !== 'data') out[key] = box[key]; });
        out.data = allRows;
        out.geovuePointInclusion = box.geovuePointInclusion;
        return out;
      }
    });
  } catch(e) {}

  window.GV_REPORT_ALL_POINTS = allRows;
  window.GV_REPORT_POINT_IS_INCLUDED = isIncludedRow;

  function fmt(value, decimals){
    var n = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return esc(value);
    return decimals == null ? esc(n) : esc(n.toFixed(decimals));
  }
  function rowValue(row, index){
    return row && Array.isArray(row[3]) ? row[3][index] : '';
  }
  function rerankIncluded(){
    var rows = activeRows().slice();
    rows.sort(function(a,b){
      var ay = Number(rowValue(a,0)), by = Number(rowValue(b,0));
      if (Number.isFinite(ay) && Number.isFinite(by) && ay !== by) return by - ay;
      var ar = Number(rowValue(a,5)), br = Number(rowValue(b,5));
      if (Number.isFinite(ar) && Number.isFinite(br) && ar !== br) return ar - br;
      return String(a && a[0]).localeCompare(String(b && b[0]), undefined, {numeric:true});
    });
    rows.forEach(function(row, index){ row[4] = index + 1; });
  }

  }

  function repopulatePointSelectors(){
    try { if (typeof window.populateTraceDropdown === 'function') window.populateTraceDropdown(); } catch(e) {}
    try { if (typeof window.populateDropdown === 'function') window.populateDropdown(); } catch(e) {}
    try { if (typeof window.populateDropdownEditPoint === 'function') window.populateDropdownEditPoint(); } catch(e) {}
    var rows=activeRows();
    if (!rows.length) {
      clearNode('plotly-Traces');
      clearNode('plotly-Trace');
      var body=document.getElementById('selectedRow'); if(body) body.innerHTML='';
      ['LatInput','LonInput','ElevInput'].forEach(function(id){var el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.value='';});
      return;
    }
    var trace=document.getElementById('PointSelector');
    if(trace && trace.options.length>1){ trace.selectedIndex=1; try{ if(typeof window.selectPoint==='function') window.selectPoint(); }catch(e){} }
    var log=document.getElementById('rowSelector');
    if(log && log.options.length>1){ log.selectedIndex=1; try{ if(typeof window.selectRow==='function') window.selectRow(); }catch(e){} }
    var edit=document.getElementById('rowSelectorEditPoint');
    if(edit && edit.options.length>1){ edit.selectedIndex=1; try{ if(typeof window.selectRowEditPoint==='function') window.selectRowEditPoint(); }catch(e){} }
  }

  function currentSelectValue(needle, fallback){
    var el=document.querySelector('select[onchange*="'+needle+'"]');
    return el && el.value ? el.value : fallback;
  }
  function safeCall(name,args){
    try { if (typeof window[name] === 'function') return window[name].apply(window,args||[]); } catch(e) { console.warn('GeoVue point inclusion refresh:',name,e); }
  }
  function reportContentVisible(){
    var content=document.getElementById('content');
    if (!content) return false;
    try {
      if (window.getComputedStyle) return window.getComputedStyle(content).display !== 'none';
    } catch(e) {}
    return content.style.display !== 'none';
  }
  function leafletMapReady(map){
    return !!(map && typeof map.addLayer === 'function' && typeof map.eachLayer === 'function');
  }
  function refreshVisibleOutputs(){
    if (!reportContentVisible()) return;
    var rows=activeRows();
    if (!rows.length) {
      ['map1','map2','map3','map4','map5','map6','map7','map8'].forEach(function(n){ try{clearMapMarkers(window[n]);}catch(e){} });
      clearSelectionLines();
      ['plotly-contour','plotly-Sections','plotly-Profile1','plotly-Model1'].forEach(clearNode);
      return;
    }
    if (leafletMapReady(window.map1) || leafletMapReady(window.SiteMapmarkersInst)) safeCall('refreshSiteMap',['dataset1']);
    fitMainMap();
    clearSelectionLines();
    if (leafletMapReady(window.map2)) safeCall('updateAquiferMap',['dataset1']);
    if (leafletMapReady(window.map3)) safeCall('updateGWLMap',['dataset2']);
    if (leafletMapReady(window.map4)) safeCall('updateFaultMap',['dataset3']);
    if (leafletMapReady(window.map5)) safeCall('updateLithMap',['dataset4']);
    if (leafletMapReady(window.map6)) safeCall('updateWaterShedMap',['dataset5']);
    if (leafletMapReady(window.map7)) safeCall('updateSalineMap',['dataset6']);
    if (leafletMapReady(window.map8)) safeCall('updateGeothermalMap',['dataset7']);
    // Interpolated/site-section/profile/model plots need at least two active points.
    // With a single included point, keep the point maps/logs/recommendation active and clear
    // only the multi-point plots instead of allowing their original routines to index missing rows.
    if (rows.length >= 2) {
      safeCall('updateContourPlot',[currentSelectValue('updateContourPlot','dataset1')]);
      safeCall('updateSectionPlot',[currentSelectValue('updateSectionPlot','dataset40'),'plotly-Sections']);
      safeCall('updateProfilePlot',[currentSelectValue('updateProfilePlot','dataset40')]);
      safeCall('updateVolumePlot',[currentSelectValue('updateVolumePlot','dataset40')]);
    } else {
      ['plotly-contour','plotly-Sections','plotly-Profile1','plotly-Model1'].forEach(clearNode);
    }
    safeCall('updatePresentationPlot',[]);
  }

  function scheduleSecondaryCalculations(){
    var rows=activeRows();
    if (!rows.length) return;
    setTimeout(function(){
      try { if (typeof window.AutoCalibrateTemperature === 'function') window.AutoCalibrateTemperature(); } catch(e) {}
      if (rows.length < 2) return;
      try {
        if (typeof window.runGradientFlowThermalCalculationsOnLoad === 'function') {
          var result=window.runGradientFlowThermalCalculationsOnLoad();
          if (result && typeof result.catch === 'function') result.catch(function(){});
        }
      } catch(e) {}
    },0);
  }

  function onInclusionChanged(){
    if (refreshing) return;
    if (refreshTimer) clearTimeout(refreshTimer);
    refreshTimer=setTimeout(function(){
      refreshing=true;
      try {
        rerankIncluded();
        persistState();
        renderSurveyPointsTable();
        renderRecommendations();
        // Before the report has finished its own startup, do not expose an empty/filtered
        // BoxData.data to original initialization code. The final filtered refresh runs after load.
        if (!filteringEnabled) return;
        rebuildDerivedPointControls();
        repopulatePointSelectors();
        if (reportContentVisible()) refreshVisibleOutputs();
        scheduleSecondaryCalculations();
        try { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('geovue-report-point-inclusion-change',{detail:{included:activeRows().length,total:allRows.length,excludedPointKeys:Array.from(excluded)}})); } catch(e) {}
      } finally { refreshing=false; }
    },40);
  }

  function installReportStartupGuard(){
    var original=window.showContentAndRunScript;
    if (typeof original!=='function' || original.__gvPointInclusionStartupWrapped) return;
    var wrapped=async function(){
      filteringEnabled=false;
      startupBypass=true;
      try {
        return await original.apply(this,arguments);
      } finally {
        startupBypass=false;
        filteringEnabled=true;
        filteringActivated=true;
        rerankIncluded();
        syncEmbeddedState();
        rebuildDerivedPointControls();
        renderSurveyPointsTable();
        renderRecommendations();
        repopulatePointSelectors();
        if (reportContentVisible()) refreshVisibleOutputs();
        scheduleSecondaryCalculations();
      }
    };
    wrapped.__gvPointInclusionStartupWrapped=true;
    wrapped.__gvPointInclusionStartupOriginal=original;
    window.showContentAndRunScript=wrapped;
  }

  function filterDerivedArrays(){
    try { if (Array.isArray(window.ContourBoxData)) window.ContourBoxData = window.ContourBoxData.filter(isIncludedRow); } catch(e) {}
    try { if (Array.isArray(window.SectionBoxData)) window.SectionBoxData = window.SectionBoxData.filter(isIncludedRow); } catch(e) {}
    try { if (Array.isArray(window.ModelBoxData)) window.ModelBoxData = window.ModelBoxData.filter(isIncludedRow); } catch(e) {}
    try {
      if (Array.isArray(window.ProfileBoxData)) {
        for(var i=0;i<3;i++) if(Array.isArray(window.ProfileBoxData[i])) window.ProfileBoxData[i]=window.ProfileBoxData[i].filter(isIncludedRow);
      }
    } catch(e) {}
  }
  function wrapFunction(name, wrapperFactory){
    var original=window[name];
    if (typeof original!=='function' || original.__gvPointInclusionWrapped) return;
    var wrapped=wrapperFactory(original);
    wrapped.__gvPointInclusionWrapped=true;
    wrapped.__gvPointInclusionOriginal=original;
    window[name]=wrapped;
  }
  function installGuards(){
    ['updateContourPlot','updateSectionPlot','updateProfilePlot','updateVolumePlot'].forEach(function(name){
      wrapFunction(name,function(original){ return function(){
        if (startupBypass) return original.apply(this,arguments);
        filterDerivedArrays();
        if (activeRows().length < 2) {
          var id=name==='updateContourPlot'?'plotly-contour':name==='updateSectionPlot'?'plotly-Sections':name==='updateProfilePlot'?'plotly-Profile1':'plotly-Model1';
          clearNode(id); return;
        }
        return original.apply(this,arguments);
      };});
    });
    wrapFunction('generateSiteMapLines',function(original){ return function(map,data,label){
      if (startupBypass) return original.call(this,map,data,label);
      var filtered=(Array.isArray(data)?data:[]).filter(isIncludedRow);
      return original.call(this,map,filtered,label);
    };});
    wrapFunction('generateSiteMapProfileLines',function(original){ return function(){ if(startupBypass) return original.apply(this,arguments); filterDerivedArrays(); return original.apply(this,arguments); };});
    wrapFunction('refreshSiteMap',function(original){ return function(){ if(!activeRows().length){clearMapMarkers(window.map1);return;} return original.apply(this,arguments); };});
    ['updateSiteMap','updateAquiferMap','updateWaterShedMap','updateGWLMap','updateFaultMap','updateLithMap','updateSalineMap','updateGeothermalMap'].forEach(function(name){
      wrapFunction(name,function(original){ return function(){ if(!activeRows().length) return; return original.apply(this,arguments); };});
    });
    wrapFunction('updateAllMaps',function(original){ return function(){ if(!activeRows().length){['map2','map3','map4','map5','map6','map7','map8'].forEach(function(n){clearMapMarkers(window[n]);});return;} return original.apply(this,arguments); };});
  }

  // Replace table refreshers with exclusion-aware versions. The Survey Points table is intentionally
  // the one place where excluded rows stay visible, so users can re-enable them without deleting data.
  window.refreshdataTable = renderSurveyPointsTable;
  window.refreshRecTable = function(){ rerankIncluded(); renderRecommendations(); };

  function activateFiltering(){
    if (filteringActivated) return;
    filteringActivated = true;
    filteringEnabled = true;
    rerankIncluded();
    syncEmbeddedState();
    rebuildDerivedPointControls();
    renderSurveyPointsTable();
    renderRecommendations();
    repopulatePointSelectors();
    if (reportContentVisible()) refreshVisibleOutputs();
    scheduleSecondaryCalculations();
  }

  ensureStyle();
  installGuards();
  installReportStartupGuard();
  rerankIncluded();
  syncEmbeddedState();
  // The Survey Points control itself can safely reflect persisted selections immediately.
  // Defer exposing the filtered BoxData.data view until all original startup handlers have run.
  renderSurveyPointsTable();
  renderRecommendations();
  if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
    setTimeout(activateFiltering,0);
  } else {
    window.addEventListener('load',function(){ setTimeout(activateFiltering,0); },{once:true});
  }
})();


</script>

(function(){
  'use strict';
  // Legacy PinRT receives measurements and metadata through a single data slot.
  // Its native list may already contain the default All selection; seed embedded
  // selections once before the shared profile engine takes over. Never replace
  // existing native selections or change any measurement row.
  if(window.BoxData&&typeof selectionPointArray!=='undefined'){
    var rows=Array.isArray(window.GV_REPORT_ALL_POINTS)?window.GV_REPORT_ALL_POINTS:(BoxData.data||[]);
    var saved=BoxData.geovueSavedPointSelections||(BoxData.geovueReportTransferState||{}).savedSelections||{};
    var shared=Array.isArray(saved)?saved:(Array.isArray(saved.shared)?saved.shared:[]);
    var byPoint=new Map();rows.forEach(function(row){if(row&&row[0]!=null&&!byPoint.has(String(row[0])))byPoint.set(String(row[0]),row);});
    shared.forEach(function(item){
      if(!item||!item.name||selectionPointArray.some(function(s){return s.name===item.name;}))return;
      var points=Array.isArray(item.points)&&item.points.length?item.points.map(String):(item.data||[]).map(function(i){return Array.isArray(i)?String(i[0]):(rows[Number(i)]?String(rows[Number(i)][0]):'');}).filter(Boolean);
      var path=Array.isArray(item.pathPoints)&&item.pathPoints.length?item.pathPoints.map(String):points;
      var order=Array.from(new Set(path.filter(function(p){return points.indexOf(p)>=0;}).concat(points)));
      var resolved=order.map(function(p){return byPoint.get(p);}).filter(Boolean);
      if(resolved.length)selectionPointArray.push(Object.assign({},item,{data:resolved}));
    });
  }
  // Add controls at runtime so all original template insertion slots stay in place.
  var checkbox=document.getElementById('ShowLines-checkbox');
  if(!checkbox)return;
  var host=checkbox.closest('div');

    var actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='gv-report-profile-actions';

    actions.appendChild(button);host.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',actions);

    status.textContent='Show saved groups and lines on the map, or create profiles from the included project points.';
    actions.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',status);
  }
  // The new control replaces the old algorithm; do not offer both entry points.
  document.querySelectorAll('button[onclick="AutoLineCreate()"]') .forEach(function(button){button.hidden=true;button.style.display='none';});
  document.querySelectorAll('button[onclick="DeleteSelectionAll()"]') .forEach(function(button){if(button.textContent.trim()==='Delete All Lines')button.textContent='Delete All Selections';});
})();

<script id="gvTemplateNativeReportBridge">(function gvReportIntegrationRuntime() {

				setCheckSilent('correct-chart-checkbox',controlValue('gvResProfileCorrect'));

				setCheckSilent('show-orthographic-checkbox',controlValue('gvResOrtho'));

				setValSilent('isomax-slider',controlValue('gvResIsoMax'));
				setValSilent('DepthsliceSlider',controlValue('gvResDepthSlice'));

			function installLoadHook(){
				var original=window.showContentAndRunScript;
				if(typeof original!=='function')return false;
				if(original.__gvAppStateLoadBridge)return true;
				var wrapped=async function(){
					var controls=applyStateSilent();
					var desired={
						contour:controls&&controls.contour?String(controls.contour.value||''):null,
						section:controls&&controls.section?String(controls.section.value||''):null,
						profile:controls&&controls.profile?String(controls.profile.value||''):null,
						model:controls&&controls.model?String(controls.model.value||''):null
					};
					var originals={};
					function wrapPlot(name,key){
						var fn=window[name]; if(typeof fn!=='function')return;
						originals[name]=fn;
						window[name]=function(){var args=Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments);if(desired[key])args[0]=desired[key];return fn.apply(this,args);};
					}
					wrapPlot('updateContourPlot','contour');
					wrapPlot('updateSectionPlot','section');
					wrapPlot('updateProfilePlot','profile');
					wrapPlot('updateVolumePlot','model');
					var autoCalibrate=window.AutoCalibrateTemperature;
					if(typeof autoCalibrate==='function'){
						originals.AutoCalibrateTemperature=autoCalibrate;
						window.AutoCalibrateTemperature=function(){var result=autoCalibrate.apply(this,arguments);applyTemperatureSilent();return result;};
					}
					try{
						return await original.apply(this,arguments);
					}finally{
						Object.keys(originals).forEach(function(name){window[name]=originals[name];});
						applyStateSilent();
						schedulePlotViews();
						window.GV_APP_NATIVE_REPORT_STATE_APPLIED=true;
					}
				};
				wrapped.__gvAppStateLoadBridge=true;
				wrapped.__gvAppStateOriginal=original;
				window.showContentAndRunScript=wrapped;
				return true;
			}

			function nativeSavedSelections(){
                if(window.GV_REPORT_PROFILES_V5)return window.GV_REPORT_PROFILES_V5.captureSelections();
                var items=[];try{if(typeof selectionPointArray!=='undefined')items=selectionPointArray||[];}catch(e){}
                var rows=window.BoxData&&Array.isArray(BoxData.data)?BoxData.data:[],previous=reportState().savedSelections||{shared:[]};
                var shared=items.map(function(item,idx){
                    var indexes=[],points=[];
                    (item&&Array.isArray(item.data)?item.data:[]).forEach(function(row){
                        var point=row&&row[0];if(point!=null&&points.indexOf(String(point))<0)points.push(String(point));
                        var at=rows.findIndex(function(r){return String(r&&r[0])===String(point);});if(at>=0&&indexes.indexOf(at)<0)indexes.push(at);
                    });
                    var name=String(item&&item.name||('Selection '+(idx+1)));
                    var old=(previous.shared||[]).find(function(s){return s.name===name;});
                    var unchanged=old&&Array.isArray(old.points)&&old.points.length===points.length&&points.every(function(p){return old.points.map(String).indexOf(p)>=0;});
                    return Object.assign({},old||{},{name:name,data:indexes,points:points,pathPoints:points.slice(),source:unchanged?old.source:'report',savedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
                }).filter(function(item){return item.data.length;});
                return Object.assign({},previous,{shared:shared});
            }

            async function saveReportWithState(){
                try{
                    if(!window.GV_REPORT_PROFILES_V5)throw new Error('Profile controls have not finished loading.');
                    // Save with the bundled code, not a potentially older remote template.
                    return window.GV_REPORT_PROFILES_V5.saveReport();
                }catch(error){
                    console.error('Error saving report with GeoVue app state:',error);
                    alert('Unable to save the report: '+(error&&error.message?error.message:error));
                }
            }
			function installSaveOverride(){var btn=byId('fetchButton');if(!btn||btn.dataset.gvAppStateSaveBridge==='1')return false;btn.dataset.gvAppStateSaveBridge='1';btn.addEventListener('click',function(ev){ev.preventDefault();ev.stopImmediatePropagation();saveReportWithState();},true);return true;}
			window.GV_CAPTURE_REPORT_STATE=captureCurrentState;
			function install(){ installSaveOverride(); installLoadHook(); }
			install();
			if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',install,{once:true});
		})();</script>
