<script id="gvCartographicMapsJS">
/* GeoVue cartographic map export. No survey measurements or database schema are changed. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.GV_CARTO)return;
  const SVG_NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const HTML_NS='http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml';
  const esc=s=>String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const natural=(a,b)=>String(a).localeCompare(String(b),undefined,{numeric:true,sensitivity:'base'});
  const validColor=c=>/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(String(c||''));
  const palette=['#ffca3a','#42d4f4','#f58231','#b8ef4d','#e675e4','#779dff','#ff686b','#4fffc0','#c8a2ff','#fff2ac','#fa94b8','#00b8cc','#bacc35','#dca56b','#c8edf0','#f55bb5','#65b96f','#b9bbff','#e5dc8b','#e87553','#67a7b0','#d4f7c5','#bb779c','#83c7f8'];
  function hash(s){let h=2166136261;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){h^=s.charCodeAt(i);h=Math.imul(h,16777619);}return h>>>0;}
  function hslHex(h,s,l){s/=100;l/=100;const a=s*Math.min(l,1-l),f=n=>{const k=(n+h/30)%12;return Math.round(255*(l-a*Math.max(-1,Math.min(k-3,9-k,1)))).toString(16).padStart(2,'0');};return '#'+f(0)+f(8)+f(4);}
  function colorDistance(a,b){let sum=0;for(let i=1;i<=5;i+=2){const d=parseInt(a.slice(i,i+2),16)-parseInt(b.slice(i,i+2),16);sum+=d*d;}return sum;}
  function classify(item){
    if(!item||typeof item!=='object')return '';
    const source=String(item.source||'').trim().toLowerCase(),kind=String(item.selectionKind||'').trim().toLowerCase(),name=String(item.name||'').trim();
    const count=Math.max((item.points||[]).length,(item.data||[]).length);
    if(source==='auto-group'||kind==='group')return 'group';
    if(source==='auto-line')return 'line';
    if(kind==='area')return '';
    if(kind==='line'||item.manualLine===true||item.reportLine===true)return count>=2?'line':'';
    if(/^group\s+\d+$/i.test(name))return 'group';
    if(count<2||!name||/^all(?:\s+points)?$/i.test(name))return '';
    if(item.profileKind==='path'||/^line(?:\b|\d)/i.test(name))return 'line';
    if(/^(?:sections?|profiles?(?:one|two|three)?|manual-line|line)$/.test(source))return 'line';
    return /^(?:shared|report|manual|selection)?$/.test(source)?'line':'';
  }
  // Preserve previously allocated colours. Resolve duplicates, and only allocate
  // colours to new selections. App and report use the same optional metadata.
  function ensureColors(items,kindFn){
    let changed=false;const used=new Set();kindFn=kindFn||classify;
    const entries=(items||[]).map((item,index)=>({item,index,kind:kindFn(item)})).filter(e=>e.kind);
    entries.sort((a,b)=>natural(a.kind+'|'+a.item.name,b.kind+'|'+b.item.name)||a.index-b.index);
    const todo=[];
    entries.forEach(e=>{const c=String(e.item.mapColor||'').toLowerCase();if(validColor(c)&&!used.has(c)){used.add(c);}else todo.push(e);});
    todo.forEach(e=>{
      const seed=hash(e.kind+'|'+String(e.item.name||''));let choices=palette.filter(c=>!used.has(c));
      if(!choices.length){choices=Array.from({length:180},(_,i)=>hslHex((seed%360+i*137.508)%360,65+(i%3)*10,54+(i%4)*7)).filter(c=>!used.has(c));}
      let best=choices[seed%Math.max(1,choices.length)],score=-1;
      choices.forEach((c,i)=>{const min=used.size?Math.min(...Array.from(used,u=>colorDistance(c,u))):1;const s=min+(hash(c+'|'+seed)%997)/1000;if(s>score){score=s;best=c;}});
      // Exact uniqueness is also enforced for unusually large selection lists.
      if(!best){let n=seed&0xffffff;do{n=(n+9973)&0xffffff;best='#'+n.toString(16).padStart(6,'0');}while(used.has(best));}
      e.item.mapColor=best;used.add(best);changed=true;
    });
    return changed;
  }
  function payloadEntries(payload){return (payload.groups||[]).map(s=>({name:s.name,kind:'group',color:s.color||s.mapColor})).concat((payload.lines||[]).map(s=>({name:s.name,kind:'line',color:s.color||s.mapColor})));}
  const legends=new WeakMap();
  function clearLegend(map){const old=map&&legends.get(map);if(old){old.element.remove();legends.delete(map);}}
  function showLegend(map,payload){
    if(!map||!map.getContainer)return;
    const entries=payloadEntries(payload);if(!entries.length){clearLegend(map);return;}
    const host=map.getContainer();let record=legends.get(map);
    if(!record){const element=document.createElement('section');element.className='gv-carto-legend';element.setAttribute('aria-label','Groups and lines legend');host.appendChild(element);record={element,entries:[]};legends.set(map,record);
      if(window.L&&L.DomEvent){L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(element);if(L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation)L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(element);}
    }
    record.entries=entries.map(e=>Object.assign({},e));
    record.element.innerHTML='<div class="gv-carto-legend-heading">Groups &amp; lines <span>'+entries.length+'</span></div><div class="gv-carto-legend-list">'+entries.map(e=>'<div class="gv-carto-legend-row"><svg width="30" height="18" viewBox="0 0 30 18" aria-hidden="true">'+(e.kind==='group'?'<rect x="3" y="3" width="23" height="12" fill="'+esc(e.color)+'" fill-opacity=".30" stroke="'+esc(e.color)+'" stroke-width="2"/>':'<path d="M2 9H26M21 4L26 9 21 14" fill="none" stroke="'+esc(e.color)+'" stroke-width="2.5"/>')+'</svg><span>'+esc(e.name)+'</span></div>').join('')+'</div>';
  }
  function plain(s){const d=document.createElement('div');d.innerHTML=String(s||'');return (d.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();}
  function mapContext(map){
    if(typeof window.GV_GET_CARTOGRAPHIC_CONTEXT==='function'){const c=window.GV_GET_CARTOGRAPHIC_CONTEXT(map);if(c)return c;}
    if(window.GV_REPORT_PROFILES_V5){
      const api=window.GV_REPORT_PROFILES_V5,bd=window.BoxData||{},state=bd.geovueReportTransferState||{};
      const points=api.getData().filter(r=>r&&r[1]!=null&&r[2]!=null&&String(r[1]).trim()&&String(r[2]).trim()&&Number.isFinite(Number(r[1]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(r[2]))&&Math.abs(Number(r[1]))<=90&&Math.abs(Number(r[2]))<=180).filter(r=>typeof window.GV_REPORT_POINT_IS_INCLUDED!=='function'||GV_REPORT_POINT_IS_INCLUDED(r)).map(r=>({point:String(r[0]),lat:Number(r[1]),lon:Number(r[2])}));
      return {name:state.projectName||bd.projectName||bd.name||document.title||'GeoVue survey',points};
    }
    return {name:'GeoVue survey',points:[]};
  }
  function activeMap(button){
    const match=button&&String(button.id||'').match(/^download-btn(\d+)$/);
    if(match&&window['map'+match[1]])return window['map'+match[1]];
    const parent=button&&button.closest('.leaflet-container');
    const candidates=[window.map,window.map1,window.map2,window.map3,window.map4,window.map5,window.map6,window.map7,window.map8];
    return candidates.find(m=>m&&typeof m.getContainer==='function'&&(!parent||m.getContainer()===parent))||null;
  }
  function rectObject(r){return {left:r.left,top:r.top,width:r.width,height:r.height,right:r.right,bottom:r.bottom};}
  function intersects(a,b){return a.right>b.left+.5&&a.left<b.right-.5&&a.bottom>b.top+.5&&a.top<b.bottom-.5;}
  function opacityTo(node,root){let value=1;for(let p=node;p&&p.nodeType===1;p=p.parentElement){const s=getComputedStyle(p);if(s.display==='none'||s.visibility==='hidden'||s.visibility==='collapse')return 0;value*=Number(s.opacity||1);if(p===root)break;}return value;}
  function chrome(el){return el.matches('.gv-carto-legend,.gv-report-map-camera,.leaflet-control-zoom,.leaflet-control-layers,.leaflet-control-scale,.leaflet-control-attribution,.leaflet-draw,.leaflet-bar,#gvmtSnapshotButton,#gvmtProfileOverlayButton,#gvmtExpandButton,#gvmtMenuButton,[data-gv-carto-ignore]');}
  const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));
  async function waitReady(map){
    const started=Date.now();
    while(Date.now()-started<18000){let waiting=false;map.eachLayer(l=>{if(typeof l.isLoading==='function'&&l.isLoading())waiting=true;});if(!waiting)break;await sleep(100);}
    let stillLoading=false;map.eachLayer(l=>{if(typeof l.isLoading==='function'&&l.isLoading())stillLoading=true;});
    if(stillLoading)throw new Error('Map imagery is still loading. Wait for the map to finish, then export again.');
    await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(r)));
    const el=map.getContainer(),r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const missing=Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('img.leaflet-tile')).filter(i=>opacityTo(i,el)>.01&&intersects(i.getBoundingClientRect(),r)&&(!i.complete||!i.naturalWidth));
    if(missing.length)throw new Error(missing.length+' visible map tile(s) are not loaded. Wait for the imagery to load, then export again. No incomplete image has been downloaded.');
  }
  function makeCanvas(w,h){const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(w));c.height=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(h));if(!c.getContext('2d'))throw new Error('This browser could not allocate the map image. Select a smaller export size.');return c;}
  function imageFromURL(url,referrerPolicy){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const img=new Image();const timer=setTimeout(()=>{img.src='';reject(new Error('Timed out loading an image needed for the map export.'));},15000);img.onload=()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve(img);};img.onerror=()=>{clearTimeout(timer);reject(new Error('An image needed for the map export could not be loaded.'));};if(!/^(data:|blob:)/i.test(url))img.crossOrigin='anonymous';if(referrerPolicy)img.referrerPolicy=referrerPolicy;img.src=url;});}
  function resourceLabel(url){try{const u=new URL(url,document.baseURI);return u.protocol==='data:'?'embedded image':u.hostname||'local image';}catch(e){return 'map image';}}
  function resourceSession(){
    const cache=new Map();let running=0;const queue=[];
    function limit(fn){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{queue.push({fn,resolve,reject});pump();});}
    function pump(){while(running<6&&queue.length){const t=queue.shift();running++;Promise.resolve().then(t.fn).then(t.resolve,t.reject).finally(()=>{running--;pump();});}}
    return {url(src,original){
      const url=new URL(src,document.baseURI).href;if(/^data:/i.test(url))return Promise.resolve(url);
      if(!cache.has(url))cache.set(url,limit(async()=>{
        if(original&&original.complete&&original.naturalWidth){try{const copy=makeCanvas(original.naturalWidth,original.naturalHeight);copy.getContext('2d').drawImage(original,0,0);const data=copy.toDataURL('image/png');copy.width=copy.height=1;return data;}catch(e){/* Retry with CORS rather than silently omitting the already visible tile. */}}
        try{const im=await imageFromURL(url,original&&original.referrerPolicy),c=makeCanvas(im.naturalWidth,im.naturalHeight);c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im,0,0);const data=c.toDataURL('image/png');c.width=c.height=1;return data;}
        catch(e){throw new Error('The visible image from '+resourceLabel(url)+' cannot be exported (image loading or cross-origin permission failure). The map has not been saved with this layer missing.');}
      }));cache.get(url).catch(()=>{});return cache.get(url);
    }};
  }
  // Inline all computed styles: labels, arrows, CSS gradients, borders and custom
  // legends must not depend on stylesheets outside the exported SVG document.
  function styledClone(node,session){
    const pending=[];
    function clone(n){
      if(n.nodeType===3)return document.createTextNode(n.nodeValue);
      if(n.nodeType!==1)return document.createTextNode('');
      if(/^(SCRIPT|IFRAME|OBJECT|EMBED)$/.test(n.tagName))throw new Error('A visible embedded frame/plugin cannot be flattened safely. Export that overlay through its provider instead.');
      let out;
      if(n.tagName==='CANVAS'||n.tagName==='VIDEO'){
        out=document.createElement('img');try{let c=n;if(n.tagName==='VIDEO'){c=makeCanvas(n.videoWidth,n.videoHeight);c.getContext('2d').drawImage(n,0,0);}out.src=c.toDataURL('image/png');}catch(e){throw new Error('A visible canvas/video layer blocked image export. No layer has been silently omitted.');}
      }else out=n.cloneNode(false);
      const cs=getComputedStyle(n);
      for(let i=0;i<cs.length;i++){const prop=cs[i];if(/^(animation|transition)/.test(prop))continue;try{out.style.setProperty(prop,cs.getPropertyValue(prop));}catch(e){}}
      out.style.setProperty('animation','none','important');out.style.setProperty('transition','none','important');
      out.removeAttribute('id');out.removeAttribute('srcset');out.removeAttribute('sizes');out.removeAttribute('loading');
      if(n.tagName==='IMG'){
        pending.push(session.url(n.currentSrc||n.src,n).then(url=>{out.src=url;}));
      }else if(n.namespaceURI===SVG_NS&&n.tagName.toLowerCase()==='image'){
        const href=n.getAttribute('href')||n.getAttributeNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink','href');
        if(href)pending.push(session.url(href).then(url=>{out.setAttribute('href',url);out.setAttributeNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink','href',url);}));
      }
      const bg=cs.backgroundImage;
      if(bg&&/url\(/i.test(bg)){
        const matches=Array.from(bg.matchAll(/url\(["']?([^"')]+)["']?\)/g));
        pending.push(Promise.all(matches.map(m=>session.url(m[1]))).then(values=>{let b=bg;matches.forEach((m,i)=>{b=b.replace(m[0],'url("'+values[i]+'")');});out.style.backgroundImage=b;}));
      }
      if(!/^(IMG|CANVAS|VIDEO)$/.test(n.tagName))Array.from(n.childNodes).forEach(ch=>out.appendChild(clone(ch)));
      // Tooltip pointers and CSS-only marker decorations are generated content.
      if(n.namespaceURI!==SVG_NS&&!/^(IMG|CANVAS|VIDEO)$/.test(n.tagName))['::before','::after'].forEach(pseudo=>{
        const ps=getComputedStyle(n,pseudo),content=ps.content;
        if(ps.display==='none'||!content||content==='none'||content==='normal')return;
        const p=document.createElement('span');for(let i=0;i<ps.length;i++){const prop=ps[i];if(prop!=='content')try{p.style.setProperty(prop,ps.getPropertyValue(prop));}catch(e){}}
        p.textContent=content==='""'||content==="''"?'':content.replace(/^["']|["']$/g,'');if(pseudo==='::before')out.insertBefore(p,out.firstChild);else out.appendChild(p);
      });
      return out;
    }
    const copy=clone(node);
    return {copy,ready:()=>Promise.all(pending)};
  }
  async function rasterNode(item,scale,symbolScale){
    if(item.kind==='image')return imageFromURL(await item.resource);
    if(item.kind==='canvas')return imageFromURL(item.data);
    const {copy,ready}=item.clone;await ready();const w=item.rect.width,h=item.rect.height;
    copy.style.setProperty('position','static','important');copy.style.setProperty('margin','0','important');copy.style.setProperty('transform','none','important');copy.style.setProperty('opacity','1','important');copy.style.setProperty('max-width','none','important');copy.style.setProperty('max-height','none','important');
    let xml;
    if(item.kind==='svg'){
      if(Number.isFinite(symbolScale)&&symbolScale>0){[copy,...copy.querySelectorAll('*')].forEach(n=>{const width=parseFloat(n.style.strokeWidth);if(Number.isFinite(width)&&width>0)n.style.setProperty('stroke-width',String(width*symbolScale),'important');});}
      copy.setAttribute('xmlns',SVG_NS);copy.style.setProperty('width',w*scale+'px','important');copy.style.setProperty('height',h*scale+'px','important');copy.setAttribute('width',String(w*scale));copy.setAttribute('height',String(h*scale));if(!copy.getAttribute('viewBox'))copy.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 '+w+' '+h);xml=new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(copy);
    }else{
      copy.setAttribute('xmlns',HTML_NS);copy.style.setProperty('width',w+'px','important');copy.style.setProperty('height',h+'px','important');copy.style.setProperty('box-sizing','border-box','important');
      xml='<svg xmlns="'+SVG_NS+'" width="'+Math.ceil(w*scale)+'" height="'+Math.ceil(h*scale)+'" viewBox="0 0 '+w+' '+h+'"><foreignObject x="0" y="0" width="'+w+'" height="'+h+'">'+new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(copy)+'</foreignObject></svg>';
    }
    return imageFromURL('data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,'+encodeURIComponent(xml));
  }
  function collectMap(map,session,options){
    options=options||{};
    const el=map.getContainer(),rootRect=rectObject(el.getBoundingClientRect()),items=[],nodeLayers=new WeakMap();
    map.eachLayer(layer=>{if(layer&&typeof layer.getLatLng==='function'){const node=typeof layer.getElement==='function'?layer.getElement():layer._icon||layer._container;if(node&&node.nodeType===1)nodeLayers.set(node,layer);}});
    function capture(node,kind){
      const rect=rectObject(node.getBoundingClientRect()),opacity=opacityTo(node,el);
      if(rect.width<.1||rect.height<.1||opacity<.001||!intersects(rect,rootRect))return;
      const layer=nodeLayers.get(node),anchor=layer?map.latLngToContainerPoint(layer.getLatLng()):null;
      const item={kind,rect,opacity,legend:isLegendNode(node),control:node.matches('.leaflet-control'),symbol:node.matches('.leaflet-marker-icon,.leaflet-tooltip,.leaflet-popup'),tooltip:node.matches('.leaflet-tooltip'),anchor,description:node.className&&node.className.baseVal||node.className||node.tagName};
      if(kind==='image'){if(!node.complete||!node.naturalWidth)throw new Error('A visible map image is not loaded. Wait for the map to finish loading.');item.resource=session.url(node.currentSrc||node.src,node);}
      else if(kind==='canvas'){try{item.data=node.toDataURL('image/png');}catch(e){throw new Error('A visible canvas layer is not exportable because its image source does not permit export.');}}
      else item.clone=styledClone(node,session);
      items.push(item);
    }
    function walk(node){
      if(node.nodeType!==1||chrome(node))return;
      const cs=getComputedStyle(node);if(cs.display==='none'||cs.visibility==='hidden'||Number(cs.opacity)===0)return;
      if((node.matches('.leaflet-control')&&isLegendNode(node))||node.matches(legendSelector)){if(options.includeLegend!==false)capture(node,'html');return;}
      const tag=node.tagName.toLowerCase();
      if(/^(iframe|object|embed|video)$/.test(tag)&&opacityTo(node,el)>.001&&intersects(node.getBoundingClientRect(),rootRect))throw new Error('A visible '+tag+' map overlay cannot be captured safely. Export stopped rather than omitting this layer.');
      if(tag==='img'){capture(node,'image');return;}
      if(tag==='canvas'){capture(node,'canvas');return;}
      if(tag==='svg'){capture(node,'svg');return;}
      if(node.matches('.leaflet-marker-icon,.leaflet-tooltip,.leaflet-popup')){capture(node,'html');return;}
      if(node.matches('.leaflet-control')){
        // UI actions are not data. Custom non-interactive legend controls are data.
        if(node.querySelector('button,input,select'))return;
        capture(node,'html');return;
      }
      if(node!==el&&!node.classList.contains('leaflet-pane')&&(!node.children.length&&node.textContent.trim()||cs.backgroundImage!=='none')){capture(node,'html');return;}
      Array.from(node.children).map((child,i)=>({child,i,z:parseFloat(getComputedStyle(child).zIndex)||0})).sort((a,b)=>a.z-b.z||a.i-b.i).forEach(e=>walk(e.child));
    }
    walk(el);return {rootRect,items};
  }
  function niceStep(value){if(!(value>0))return 1;const mag=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(value))),f=value/mag;return (f<=1?1:f<=2?2:f<=5?5:10)*mag;}
  function niceFloor(value){if(!(value>0))return 1;const mag=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(value))),f=value/mag;return (f>=5?5:f>=2?2:1)*mag;}
  function degree(value,isLat,step){const v=isLat?value:((value+180)%360+360)%360-180,dec=Math.min(7,Math.max(0,-Math.floor(Math.log10(step))+1));return Math.abs(v).toFixed(dec)+'\u00b0'+(Math.abs(v)<1e-9?'':isLat?(v>0?'N':'S'):(v>0?'E':'W'));}
  function gridFor(map,rect){
    const b=map.getBounds(),w=rect.width,h=rect.height,south=b.getSouth(),north=b.getNorth(),west=b.getWest();let east=b.getEast();if(east<west)east+=360;
    const lonStep=niceStep((east-west)/6),latStep=niceStep((north-south)/5),lines=[];
    for(let lon=Math.ceil(west/lonStep)*lonStep,n=0;lon<east&&n<24;lon+=lonStep,n++){const p=map.latLngToContainerPoint([map.getCenter().lat,lon]);if(p.x>1&&p.x<w-1)lines.push({axis:'x',pixel:p.x,label:degree(lon,false,lonStep)});}
    for(let lat=Math.ceil(south/latStep)*latStep,n=0;lat<north&&n<24;lat+=latStep,n++){const p=map.latLngToContainerPoint([lat,map.getCenter().lng]);if(p.y>1&&p.y<h-1)lines.push({axis:'y',pixel:p.y,label:degree(lat,true,latStep)});}
    const a=map.containerPointToLatLng([w*.25,h*.5]),c=map.containerPointToLatLng([w*.75,h*.5]);
    return {lines,bounds:{south,north,west,east},metresPerPixel:map.distance(a,c)/(w*.5),projection:map.options&&map.options.crs&&map.options.crs.code||'Map CRS not specified'};
  }
  function pointInventory(map,context,rootRect){
    const markers=[],labels=[];
    function textMatch(text,point){const t=plain(text).trim();return t===point||t==='Point '+point;}
    map.eachLayer(layer=>{
      if(!layer||typeof layer.getLatLng!=='function')return;
      const latlng=layer.getLatLng();if(!latlng)return;
      let node=typeof layer.getElement==='function'?layer.getElement():layer._icon||layer._container;
      if(!node||!node.isConnected||opacityTo(node,map.getContainer())<=.001)return;
      if(node.matches('.gv-profile-map-arrow-icon,.gv-report-profile-arrow-icon'))return;
      const p=map.latLngToContainerPoint(latlng);
      if(node.matches('.leaflet-tooltip'))labels.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,text:node.textContent});
      else if(node.matches('.leaflet-marker-icon')||typeof layer.getRadius==='function')markers.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,text:node.textContent||''});
    });
    return (context.points||[]).map(point=>{
      const p=map.latLngToContainerPoint([point.lat,point.lon]);
      return {point:String(point.point),x:p.x,y:p.y,visible:p.x>=0&&p.x<=rootRect.width&&p.y>=0&&p.y<=rootRect.height,
        marker:markers.some(m=>Math.hypot(m.x-p.x,m.y-p.y)<2),label:labels.concat(markers).some(m=>Math.hypot(m.x-p.x,m.y-p.y)<6&&textMatch(m.text,String(point.point)))};
    });
  }
  function wrapText(ctx,text,width){
    const lines=[];String(text==null?'':text).split(/\r?\n/).forEach(paragraph=>{
      let line='';paragraph.split(/\s+/).forEach(word=>{
        if(ctx.measureText(word).width>width){if(line){lines.push(line);line='';}let segment='';Array.from(word).forEach(ch=>{if(ctx.measureText(segment+ch).width>width&&segment){lines.push(segment);segment='';}segment+=ch;});line=segment;}
        else if(line&&ctx.measureText(line+' '+word).width>width){lines.push(line);line=word;}else line+=(line?' ':'')+word;
      });if(line||!paragraph)lines.push(line);
    });return lines;
  }
  function textBlock(ctx,text,x,y,width,font,lineHeight,color){ctx.font=font;ctx.fillStyle=color;const lines=wrapText(ctx,text,width);lines.forEach((line,i)=>ctx.fillText(line,x,y+i*lineHeight));return y+lines.length*lineHeight;}
  function line(ctx,x1,y1,x2,y2,color,width){ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.stroke();}
  function attribution(map){const names=new Set();map.eachLayer(l=>{const a=typeof l.getAttribution==='function'?l.getAttribution():l.options&&l.options.attribution;if(a){const s=plain(a);if(s)names.add(s);}});const el=map.getContainer().querySelector('.leaflet-control-attribution');if(el&&el.textContent.trim())names.add(el.textContent.trim());return Array.from(names).join(' | ')||'Basemap attribution was not supplied by the active layer.';}

  // Fixed page geometry; the Leaflet viewport, not the bitmap, changes aspect.
  // All dimensions below are in output pixels (u is one design-space pixel).
  function pageAspect(layout){
    return {slide4x3:4/3,slide16x9:16/9,a4landscape:297/210,a4portrait:210/297}[layout]||297/210;
  }
  const legendSelector='.gv-map-data-colorbar,.gv-report-map-colorbar,[data-gv-carto-legend],.leaflet-control-legend,.legend,.info.legend,[class*="map-legend"],[class*="mapLegend"],[class*="colorbar"]';
  function isLegendNode(node){
    return !!(node&&node.matches&&(node.matches(legendSelector)||node.querySelector(legendSelector)));
  }
  function overlayHeadings(map){
    const host=map.getContainer(),names=[],seen=new Set(),frame=host.getBoundingClientRect();let imageOverlayVisible=false;
    function add(value){const name=String(value||'').replace(/\s+(?:color|colour)\s*bar\s*$/i,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();if(name&&!/^(?:map data|color bar|colour bar)$/i.test(name)&&!seen.has(name.toLowerCase())){seen.add(name.toLowerCase());names.push(name);}}
    map.eachLayer(layer=>{
      if(!layer)return;const opts=layer.options||{},node=typeof layer.getElement==='function'?layer.getElement():layer._image;
      if(Number(opts.opacity)===0)return;
      if(node&&(!opacityTo(node,host)||!intersects(node.getBoundingClientRect(),frame)))return;
      const image=!!(layer._image||(node&&node.matches&&node.matches('.leaflet-image-layer')));
      if(image)imageOverlayVisible=true;
      if(opts.gvCartoTitle||layer.gvCartoTitle)add(opts.gvCartoTitle||layer.gvCartoTitle);
      else if(image||layer.wmsParams)add(opts.title||opts.name||layer.name);
    });
    // Native app legend gives the actual rendered dataset name, not a stale picker value.
    if(imageOverlayVisible){
      host.querySelectorAll('.gv-map-data-colorbar').forEach(n=>{if(opacityTo(n,host)>0)add(n.getAttribute('aria-label')||n.querySelector('img')?.alt);});
      const sel=document.getElementById(host.id==='map1'?'gvReportMapDataset':'gvMapDataDatasetSelect');
      if(sel&&sel.value&&sel.selectedIndex>=0&&(!names.length||host.id==='map1'))add(sel.options[sel.selectedIndex].textContent);
    }
    host.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-control-layers-overlays input:checked').forEach(input=>add(input.closest('label')?.textContent));
    // The dedicated GIS report maps are data-bearing tile styles, not image overlays.
    if(/^map[2-8]$/.test(host.id)){
      let node=host.previousElementSibling;
      while(node&&!node.classList.contains('map-container')){
        const h=node.matches('h2,h3,h4')?node:node.querySelector('h2,h3,h4');
        if(h){add(h.textContent);break;}node=node.previousElementSibling;
      }
    }
    return names;
  }
  function legendRows(ctx,entries,width,u,columns,fontSize){
    const gap=12*u,cw=(width-(columns-1)*gap)/columns,offset=32*u,lh=(fontSize+3)*u;
    if(cw<=offset+18*u)return null;
    ctx.font=fontSize*u+'px Arial';
    const per=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(entries.length/columns)),heights=new Array(columns).fill(0),rows=[];
    entries.forEach((entry,i)=>{const col=Math.min(columns-1,Math.floor(i/per)),lines=wrapText(ctx,entry.name,cw-offset),h=Math.max(18*u,lines.length*lh)+4*u;rows.push(Object.assign({},entry,{lines,dx:col*(cw+gap),dy:heights[col]}));heights[col]+=h;});
    return {rows,height:Math.max(0,...heights),columns,fontSize:fontSize*u,lineHeight:lh,textOffset:offset};
  }
  function packLegendWidgets(items,maxWidth,u,horizontal){
    const placed=[];let x=0,y=0,rowH=0,totalW=0;
    items.forEach((item,i)=>{
      const scale=Math.min(u,maxWidth/Math.max(1,item.rect.width)),w=item.rect.width*scale,h=item.rect.height*scale;
      if(horizontal&&x&&x+w>maxWidth){y+=rowH+8*u;x=0;rowH=0;}
      placed.push({index:i,dx:x,dy:y,width:w,height:h});rowH=Math.max(rowH,h);totalW=Math.max(totalW,x+w);
      if(horizontal)x+=w+12*u;else{y+=h+10*u;rowH=0;}
    });
    return {items:placed,width:totalW,height:horizontal?y+rowH:Math.max(0,y-10*u)};
  }
  function layoutLegend(ctx,entries,widgets,width,u,portrait,maxHeight){
    if(!entries.length&&!widgets.length)return {rows:[],widgets:[],height:0,columns:0};
    const heading=24*u,widgetPlan=packLegendWidgets(widgets,width,u,portrait);
    let rowsWidth=width,widgetX=0,sideBySide=false;
    if(portrait&&entries.length&&widgets.length&&width-widgetPlan.width-20*u>=260*u){
      rowsWidth=width-widgetPlan.width-20*u;widgetX=rowsWidth+20*u;sideBySide=true;
    }
    let best=null;
    for(const font of [14,13,12,11]){
      const maxColumns=entries.length?Math.min(portrait?6:2,entries.length):1;
      for(let columns=1;columns<=maxColumns;columns++){
        const r=legendRows(ctx,entries,rowsWidth,u,columns,font);if(!r)continue;
        const widgetY=sideBySide?heading:heading+r.height+(entries.length&&widgets.length?10*u:0);
        const height=sideBySide?heading+Math.max(r.height,widgetPlan.height):widgetY+widgetPlan.height;
        if(!best||height<best.height)best=Object.assign({},r,{height,widgetY,widgetX});
        // A narrow landscape column is retained whenever it fits. Portrait tries
        // horizontal columns to minimize the height of the footer legend.
        if(!portrait&&height<=maxHeight)break;
      }
      if(best&&best.height<=maxHeight)break;
    }
    if(!best||best.height>maxHeight+.5)throw new Error('The complete legend does not fit this page. Choose A4 portrait, shorten long selection names, or turn off Include legend. No entries have been dropped.');
    return Object.assign(best,{rows:best.rows.map(r=>Object.assign({},r,{dy:r.dy+heading})),widgets:widgetPlan.items.map(w=>Object.assign({},w,{dx:w.dx+best.widgetX,dy:w.dy+best.widgetY}))});
  }
  function composePlan(width,source,context,entries,grid,sourceText,pointCount,layout,options){
    options=options||{};layout=['slide4x3','slide16x9','a4landscape','a4portrait'].includes(layout)?layout:'a4landscape';
    const pageW=Math.max(1200,Math.min(4960,Math.round(Number(width)||3600))),pageH=Math.round(pageW/pageAspect(layout)),u=pageW/1600,portrait=layout==='a4portrait';
    if(pageW*pageH>36000000)throw new Error('The image is too large for a safe export. Select a smaller output width.');
    const probe=makeCanvas(1,1),ctx=probe.getContext('2d'),includeTitle=options.includeTitle!==false,includeLegend=options.includeLegend!==false;
    const margin=28*u,right=16*u,bottom=26*u,titleY=12*u,titleFont=28*u,subtitleFont=titleFont/2;
    const title=includeTitle?String(options.title||context.name||'Survey project'):'';
    ctx.font='bold '+titleFont+'px Arial';const titleLines=title?wrapText(ctx,title,pageW-margin-right):[];
    const subtitle=includeTitle?(options.overlayHeadings||[]).join(' | '):'';
    ctx.font=subtitleFont+'px Arial';const subtitleLines=subtitle?wrapText(ctx,subtitle,pageW-margin-right):[];
    const subtitleY=titleY+titleLines.length*32*u+(subtitleLines.length?3*u:0),headerEnd=subtitleLines.length?subtitleY+subtitleLines.length*18*u:titleY+titleLines.length*32*u;
    const mapY=headerEnd+(includeTitle?6*u:0)+22*u,mapBottom=pageH-bottom,contentH=mapBottom-mapY;
    entries=includeLegend?entries:[];const widgets=includeLegend?(options.legendItems||[]):[],hasLegend=entries.length>0||widgets.length>0;
    const gap=20*u,rail=hasLegend&&!portrait?190*u:0; // half the former 380-unit rail
    let legendX=0,legendY=0,legendW=0,legend={rows:[],widgets:[],height:0,columns:0};
    let mapW=pageW-margin-right,mapH=contentH;
    if(hasLegend){
      legendW=portrait?mapW:rail;
      legend=layoutLegend(ctx,entries,widgets,legendW,u,portrait,portrait?contentH*.40:contentH);
      if(portrait){legendX=margin;legendY=mapBottom-legend.height;mapH=legendY-26*u-mapY;}
      else{mapW-=rail+gap;legendX=margin+mapW+gap;legendY=mapY;}
    }
    if(mapW<200*u||mapH<200*u)throw new Error('Too little space remains for the map. Shorten the heading or hide the legend.');
    probe.width=probe.height=1;
    return {width:pageW,height:pageH,u,margin,titleY,titleLines,titleFont,subtitleY,subtitleLines,subtitleFont,mapX:margin,mapY,mapW,mapH,legendX,legendY,legendW,legendRows:legend.rows,legendWidgets:legend.widgets,legendH:legend.height,legendColumns:legend.columns,legendFont:legend.fontSize||14*u,legendLineHeight:legend.lineHeight||17*u,legendTextOffset:legend.textOffset||32*u,portrait,layout,includeTitle,includeLegend};
  }
  function roundedRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r,fill,stroke){
    r=Math.max(0,Math.min(r,Math.min(w,h)/2));ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);ctx.closePath();if(fill)ctx.fill();if(stroke)ctx.stroke();
  }
  function drawScaleOverlay(ctx,x,y,maxWidth,metresPerPixel,exportScale,u){
    const metres=niceFloor(metresPerPixel*maxWidth/exportScale),bar=metres/metresPerPixel*exportScale;
    // Do not clamp the displayed bar length independently of its distance label.
    const bx=x+10*u,by=y-31*u;ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.88)';ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(26,46,61,.35)';ctx.lineWidth=u;roundedRect(ctx,x,y-41*u,bar+20*u,41*u,5*u,true,true);
    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){ctx.fillStyle=i%2?'#fff':'#142d40';ctx.fillRect(bx+bar*i/4,by,bar/4,8*u);ctx.strokeStyle='#142d40';ctx.lineWidth=.8*u;ctx.strokeRect(bx+bar*i/4,by,bar/4,8*u);}
    ctx.font=11*u+'px Arial';ctx.fillStyle='#21394a';ctx.textBaseline='top';ctx.fillText('0',bx,by+12*u);const unit=metres>=1000?'km':'m',value=metres>=1000?metres/1000:metres,label=Number(value.toPrecision(4))+' '+unit;ctx.fillText(label,bx+bar-ctx.measureText(label).width,by+12*u);ctx.restore();return {metres,pixels:bar};
  }
  function drawNorthOverlay(ctx,x,y,u){
    const left=x-34*u,top=y-64*u,cx=x-17*u;ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.88)';ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(26,46,61,.35)';ctx.lineWidth=u;roundedRect(ctx,left,top,34*u,64*u,5*u,true,true);ctx.font='bold '+14*u+'px Arial';ctx.fillStyle='#142d40';ctx.textBaseline='top';ctx.fillText('N',cx-5*u,top+5*u);const tip=top+23*u,base=top+54*u;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,tip);ctx.lineTo(cx-8*u,base);ctx.lineTo(cx,base-7*u);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,tip);ctx.lineTo(cx+8*u,base);ctx.lineTo(cx,base-7*u);ctx.closePath();ctx.strokeStyle='#142d40';ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
  }
  async function composeLegend(ctx,plan,items){
    const u=plan.u;if(!plan.legendH)return;
    ctx.fillStyle='#142d40';ctx.font='bold '+13*u+'px Arial';ctx.fillText('LEGEND',plan.legendX,plan.legendY);
    for(const e of plan.legendRows){
      const x=plan.legendX+e.dx,y=plan.legendY+e.dy,sy=y+2*u;
      ctx.fillStyle='#263b4a';ctx.fillRect(x,sy,24*u,16*u);ctx.lineWidth=2*u;ctx.fillStyle=e.color;ctx.strokeStyle=e.color;
      if(e.kind==='group'){ctx.globalAlpha=.30;ctx.fillRect(x+2*u,sy+2*u,20*u,12*u);ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.strokeRect(x+2*u,sy+2*u,20*u,12*u);}
      else{line(ctx,x+2*u,sy+8*u,x+22*u,sy+8*u,e.color,2*u);line(ctx,x+16*u,sy+3*u,x+22*u,sy+8*u,e.color,2*u);line(ctx,x+16*u,sy+13*u,x+22*u,sy+8*u,e.color,2*u);}
      ctx.fillStyle='#223a4a';ctx.font=plan.legendFont+'px Arial';e.lines.forEach((t,i)=>ctx.fillText(t,x+plan.legendTextOffset,y+i*plan.legendLineHeight));
    }
    for(const pos of plan.legendWidgets){const item=items[pos.index],image=await rasterNode(item,Math.max(1,pos.width/item.rect.width));ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=item.opacity;ctx.drawImage(image,plan.legendX+pos.dx,plan.legendY+pos.dy,pos.width,pos.height);ctx.restore();}
  }
  async function drawMap(map,snapshot,options,context,onProgress){
    const entries=options.includeLegend!==false&&legends.has(map)?legends.get(map).entries.map(e=>Object.assign({},e)):[];
    const widgets=options.includeLegend!==false?snapshot.items.filter(item=>item.legend):[],body=snapshot.items.filter(item=>!item.legend);
    const grid=gridFor(map,snapshot.rootRect),points=pointInventory(map,context,snapshot.rootRect),sourceText=attribution(map);
    const plan=options._plan||composePlan(options.width||3600,snapshot.rootRect,context,entries,grid,sourceText,points.length,options.layout,Object.assign({},options,{legendItems:widgets}));
    const {width,height,u,mapX,mapY,mapW,mapH}=plan,factor=mapW/snapshot.rootRect.width;
    if(Math.abs(mapH-factor*snapshot.rootRect.height)>Math.max(2,2*u))throw new Error('The map viewport did not resize to the selected layout. Export stopped rather than stretching the map.');
    const out=makeCanvas(width,height),ctx=out.getContext('2d');ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);ctx.textBaseline='top';ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;ctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';
    ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(mapX,mapY,mapW,mapH);ctx.clip();ctx.fillStyle=getComputedStyle(map.getContainer()).backgroundColor||'#c5c8ca';ctx.fillRect(mapX,mapY,mapW,mapH);
    let painted=0;
    async function paint(item){
      const symbol=item.symbol||item.control,renderScale=symbol?u:factor,img=await rasterNode(item,Math.max(1,renderScale),u/factor);
      let x=mapX+(item.rect.left-snapshot.rootRect.left)*factor,y=mapY+(item.rect.top-snapshot.rootRect.top)*factor;
      const dw=item.rect.width*renderScale,dh=item.rect.height*renderScale;
      if(symbol&&item.anchor){x=mapX+item.anchor.x*factor+(item.rect.left-snapshot.rootRect.left-item.anchor.x)*u;y=mapY+item.anchor.y*factor+(item.rect.top-snapshot.rootRect.top-item.anchor.y)*u;}
      else if(item.control){const left=item.rect.left-snapshot.rootRect.left,right=snapshot.rootRect.right-item.rect.right,top=item.rect.top-snapshot.rootRect.top,bottom=snapshot.rootRect.bottom-item.rect.bottom;x=left<right?mapX+left*u:mapX+mapW-right*u-dw;y=top<bottom?mapY+top*u:mapY+mapH-bottom*u-dh;}
      if(item.tooltip){x=Math.max(mapX+3*u,Math.min(x,mapX+mapW-dw-3*u));y=Math.max(mapY+3*u,Math.min(y,mapY+mapH-dh-3*u));}
      ctx.globalAlpha=item.opacity;ctx.drawImage(img,x,y,dw,dh);painted++;if(painted%12===0){if(onProgress)onProgress('Compositing visible map layers ('+painted+' / '+body.length+')...');await sleep(0);}
    }
    const foreground=body.filter(item=>item.symbol||item.control);
    for(const item of body.filter(item=>!item.symbol&&!item.control))await paint(item);ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    grid.lines.forEach(g=>{const x=g.axis==='x'?mapX+g.pixel*factor:mapX,y=g.axis==='y'?mapY+g.pixel*factor:mapY;ctx.setLineDash([4*u,6*u]);line(ctx,x,y,g.axis==='x'?x:mapX+mapW,g.axis==='y'?y:mapY+mapH,'rgba(0,0,0,.30)',1.8*u);line(ctx,x,y,g.axis==='x'?x:mapX+mapW,g.axis==='y'?y:mapY+mapH,'rgba(255,255,255,.55)',.8*u);});ctx.setLineDash([]);
    for(const item of foreground)await paint(item);ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    if(options.points!==false)points.filter(p=>p.visible).forEach(p=>{const x=mapX+p.x*factor,y=mapY+p.y*factor;if(!p.marker){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,4.8*u,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='#142330';ctx.fill();ctx.lineWidth=1.8*u;ctx.strokeStyle='#fff4b3';ctx.stroke();}if(!p.label){ctx.font='bold '+13*u+'px Arial';ctx.lineWidth=3*u;ctx.strokeStyle='#17212b';ctx.strokeText(p.point,x+7*u,y-17*u);ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillText(p.point,x+7*u,y-17*u);}});
    const scaleAudit=drawScaleOverlay(ctx,mapX+10*u,mapY+mapH-10*u,Math.min(mapW*.22,190*u),grid.metresPerPixel,factor,u);drawNorthOverlay(ctx,mapX+mapW-10*u,mapY+mapH-10*u,u);ctx.restore();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#263b4a';ctx.lineWidth=1.2*u;ctx.strokeRect(mapX,mapY,mapW,mapH);ctx.font=11*u+'px Arial';ctx.fillStyle='#263b4a';
    grid.lines.forEach(g=>{if(g.axis==='x'){const x=mapX+g.pixel*factor;line(ctx,x,mapY-4*u,x,mapY,'#263b4a',u);line(ctx,x,mapY+mapH,x,mapY+mapH+4*u,'#263b4a',u);const tw=ctx.measureText(g.label).width,tx=Math.max(mapX,Math.min(x-tw/2,mapX+mapW-tw));ctx.fillText(g.label,tx,mapY-18*u);ctx.fillText(g.label,tx,mapY+mapH+7*u);}else{const y=mapY+g.pixel*factor;line(ctx,mapX-4*u,y,mapX,y,'#263b4a',u);line(ctx,mapX+mapW,y,mapX+mapW+4*u,y,'#263b4a',u);ctx.save();const th=ctx.measureText(g.label).width;ctx.translate(mapX-20*u,Math.max(mapY+th/2,Math.min(y,mapY+mapH-th/2)));ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);ctx.fillText(g.label,-th/2,0);ctx.restore();}});
    ctx.fillStyle='#142d40';ctx.font='bold '+plan.titleFont+'px Arial';plan.titleLines.forEach((t,i)=>ctx.fillText(t,plan.margin,plan.titleY+i*32*u));ctx.font=plan.subtitleFont+'px Arial';ctx.fillStyle='#425b6a';plan.subtitleLines.forEach((t,i)=>ctx.fillText(t,plan.margin,plan.subtitleY+i*18*u));
    await composeLegend(ctx,plan,widgets);ctx.getImageData(0,0,1,1);
    return {canvas:out,audit:{width,height,layout:plan.layout,includeTitle:plan.includeTitle,includeLegend:plan.includeLegend,overlayHeadings:options.overlayHeadings||[],titleFont:plan.titleFont,subtitleFont:plan.subtitleFont,mapFrame:{x:mapX,y:mapY,width:mapW,height:mapH},legendFrame:{x:plan.legendX,y:plan.legendY,width:plan.legendW,height:plan.legendH},layerCount:body.length+widgets.length,legendCount:entries.length,dataLegendCount:widgets.length,legendColumns:plan.legendColumns,projectPoints:points.length,pointsInFrame:points.filter(p=>p.visible).length,extent:options.extent||'view',grid:grid.bounds,projection:grid.projection,attribution:sourceText,scale:scaleAudit}};
  }
  let rasterSupport=null;

  function verifyRasterSupport(){
    if(!rasterSupport)rasterSupport=(async()=>{
      const xml='<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="4" height="4"><foreignObject width="4" height="4"><div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" style="width:4px;height:4px;background:rgb(213,35,76)"></div></foreignObject></svg>';
      const image=await imageFromURL('data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,'+encodeURIComponent(xml)),c=makeCanvas(4,4),ctx=c.getContext('2d');ctx.drawImage(image,0,0);const pixel=ctx.getImageData(2,2,1,1).data;
      if(pixel[3]<250||pixel[0]<200)throw new Error('This browser cannot export HTML/SVG map labels safely. Use a browser with SVG foreignObject canvas support. No incomplete map has been saved.');
    })();return rasterSupport;
  }
  let busy=false;
  function legendMeasurements(map){
    const host=map.getContainer(),frame=host.getBoundingClientRect(),out=[];
    host.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-control,'+legendSelector).forEach(node=>{
      if(chrome(node)||!isLegendNode(node)||out.some(item=>item.node.contains(node)))return;
      const rect=rectObject(node.getBoundingClientRect());if(rect.width>0&&rect.height>0&&opacityTo(node,host)>0&&intersects(rect,frame))out.push({node,rect});
    });return out;
  }
  function resizeViewport(map,plan){
    const el=map.getContainer(),w=plan.mapW/plan.u,h=plan.mapH/plan.u;
    // Keep the live element in its CSS context, so custom markers/labels retain
    // their app/report styling. Only its temporary export size changes.
    const props={width:w+'px',height:h+'px','min-width':w+'px','max-width':w+'px','min-height':h+'px','max-height':h+'px','box-sizing':'border-box',border:'0px',padding:'0px',flex:'none',transition:'none'};
    Object.keys(props).forEach(k=>el.style.setProperty(k,props[k],'important'));
    map.invalidateSize({animate:false,pan:false});
    const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();if(Math.abs(r.width/r.height-w/h)>.005)throw new Error('The page stylesheet prevented the map from resizing for export. No stretched image has been saved.');
  }
  async function exportMap(map,options){
    options=Object.assign({},options||{});
    if(busy)throw new Error('A map export is already running.');
    if(!map||typeof map.getContainer!=='function'||typeof map.invalidateSize!=='function')throw new Error('Open the survey map before exporting.');
    const el=map.getContainer(),rect=el.getBoundingClientRect();if(rect.width<20||rect.height<20)throw new Error('The map must be visible before exporting.');
    const center=map.getCenter(),oldCenter=[center.lat,center.lng],oldZoom=map.getZoom(),oldBounds=map.getBounds(),oldStyle=el.getAttribute('style');
    const oldSnap=map.options.zoomSnap,hadSnap=Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map.options,'zoomSnap'),handlers=[],scrolls=[];
    for(let node=el.parentElement;node;node=node.parentElement)scrolls.push({node,left:node.scrollLeft,top:node.scrollTop});
    const scrollX=window.scrollX,scrollY=window.scrollY,context=options.context||mapContext(map);
    busy=true;window.GV_CARTO_EXPORT_BUSY=true;let resized=false;
    try{
      ['dragging','scrollWheelZoom','doubleClickZoom','boxZoom','keyboard','touchZoom'].forEach(k=>{if(map[k]&&map[k].enabled&&map[k].enabled()){handlers.push(map[k]);map[k].disable();}});
      await verifyRasterSupport();if(map.stop)map.stop();
      if(window.GV_REPORT_PROFILES_V5&&map===window.map1)GV_REPORT_PROFILES_V5.renderOverlay();
      options.overlayHeadings=overlayHeadings(map);
      const entries=options.includeLegend!==false?(legends.get(map)?.entries||[]).map(e=>Object.assign({},e)):[];
      let widgets=options.includeLegend!==false?legendMeasurements(map):[];
      let plan=composePlan(options.width||3600,rect,context,entries,null,'',0,options.layout,Object.assign({},options,{legendItems:widgets}));
      // Fractional fitting avoids unnecessary zoom-level jumps. The original
      // view is contained in the new frame; imagery is neither cropped nor stretched.
      map.options.zoomSnap=0;resized=true;resizeViewport(map,plan);
      const projectExtent=options.extent==='project'&&(context.points||[]).length;
      function fit(){map.fitBounds(projectExtent?context.points.map(p=>[p.lat,p.lon]):oldBounds,{padding:projectExtent?[30,30]:[0,0],animate:false,maxZoom:projectExtent?19:Math.max(19,oldZoom)});}
      fit();if(options.onProgress)options.onProgress('Filling the selected page with map imagery...');await waitReady(map);await sleep(180);
      // The adapted extent may reveal another active overlay. Re-measure its
      // heading and responsive legend controls before fixing the final frame.
      options.overlayHeadings=overlayHeadings(map);
      widgets=options.includeLegend!==false?legendMeasurements(map):[];
      const revised=composePlan(options.width||3600,rect,context,entries,null,'',0,options.layout,Object.assign({},options,{legendItems:widgets}));
      if(Math.abs(revised.mapH-plan.mapH)>plan.u||Math.abs(revised.mapW-plan.mapW)>plan.u){plan=revised;resizeViewport(map,plan);fit();await waitReady(map);await sleep(180);}else plan=revised;
      const session=resourceSession(),snapshot=collectMap(map,session,options);
      if(!snapshot.items.some(item=>!item.legend))throw new Error('No visible map layers were found. Wait for the map to load.');
      await Promise.all(snapshot.items.map(item=>item.resource||item.clone&&item.clone.ready()||Promise.resolve()));
      options._plan=plan;
      const result=await drawMap(map,snapshot,options,context,options.onProgress);window.GV_LAST_CARTO_EXPORT_AUDIT=result.audit;return result;
    }finally{
      try{
        if(resized){if(oldStyle===null)el.removeAttribute('style');else el.setAttribute('style',oldStyle);map.invalidateSize({animate:false,pan:false});map.setView(oldCenter,oldZoom,{animate:false});if(oldStyle===null)el.removeAttribute('style');else el.setAttribute('style',oldStyle);}
      }finally{
        if(hadSnap)map.options.zoomSnap=oldSnap;else delete map.options.zoomSnap;
        handlers.forEach(h=>h.enable());scrolls.forEach(s=>{s.node.scrollLeft=s.left;s.node.scrollTop=s.top;});window.scrollTo(scrollX,scrollY);
        window.GV_CARTO_EXPORT_BUSY=false;busy=false;
      }
    }
  }
  async function download(canvas,title){
    const blob=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{try{canvas.toBlob(b=>b?resolve(b):reject(new Error('The browser could not encode the PNG image.')),'image/png');}catch(e){reject(e);}});
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=String(title||'GeoVue_Map').replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/gi,'_').slice(0,90)+'_Map_'+new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-')+'.png';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),30000);
  }
  function openExport(map,button){
    if(document.getElementById('gvCartoExportDialog'))return;
    if(!map){alert('Open the survey map before exporting.');return;}

<script id="gvReportProfilesV5">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.GV_REPORT_PROFILES_V5)return;

  const clone=value=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  const esc=value=>String(value==null?'':value).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const natural=(a,b)=>String(a).localeCompare(String(b),undefined,{numeric:true,sensitivity:'base'});
  function getResultData(){return Array.isArray(window.GV_REPORT_ALL_POINTS)?window.GV_REPORT_ALL_POINTS:(window.BoxData&&Array.isArray(BoxData.data)?BoxData.data:[]);}
  function boxData(){return window.BoxData||{};}
  function gvIsPointIncluded(row){
    if(typeof window.GV_REPORT_POINT_IS_INCLUDED==='function')return window.GV_REPORT_POINT_IS_INCLUDED(row);
    const excluded=boxData().geovuePointInclusion&&boxData().geovuePointInclusion.excludedPointKeys||[];
    return !!row&&excluded.indexOf('point:'+String(row[0]).trim())<0;
  }
  function nativeSelections(){try{return typeof selectionPointArray!=='undefined'?selectionPointArray:[];}catch(e){return [];}}
  function embeddedStore(){
    const bd=boxData(),state=bd.geovueReportTransferState||{};
    const saved=bd.geovueSavedPointSelections||state.savedSelections||{};
    if(Array.isArray(saved))return {shared:clone(saved)};
    const out=clone(saved);if(!Array.isArray(out.shared))out.shared=[];return out;
  }
  function key(row){return String(row&&row[0]!=null?row[0]:'').trim();}
  function sameMembers(a,b){const x=new Set(a.map(String)),y=new Set(b.map(String));return x.size===y.size&&Array.from(x).every(p=>y.has(p));}
  function namesInNative(item){return (item&&Array.isArray(item.data)?item.data:[]).map(r=>Array.isArray(r)?key(r):'').filter(Boolean);}
  function storedPointNames(item,rows){
    if(item&&Array.isArray(item.points)&&item.points.length)return item.points.map(String);
    return (item&&Array.isArray(item.data)?item.data:[]).map(i=>Array.isArray(i)?key(i):(rows[Number(i)]?key(rows[Number(i)]):'')).filter(Boolean);
  }
  function captureSelections(){
    const saved=embeddedStore(),rows=getResultData(),index=new Map();rows.forEach((r,i)=>{if(!index.has(key(r)))index.set(key(r),i);});
    saved.shared=nativeSelections().map((item,i)=>{
      const name=String(item&&item.name||('Selection '+(i+1))),points=Array.from(new Set(namesInNative(item)));
      const old=saved.shared.find(s=>s.name===name&&sameMembers(storedPointNames(s,rows),points))||saved.shared.find(s=>s.name===name);
      const unchanged=!!old&&sameMembers(storedPointNames(old,rows),points);
      const out=Object.assign({},old||{},item||{});out.name=name;
      out.points=points.slice().sort(natural);out.data=out.points.map(p=>index.get(p)).filter(Number.isInteger);
      const path=Array.isArray(item.pathPoints)&&item.pathPoints.length?item.pathPoints:(unchanged&&old.pathPoints&&old.pathPoints.length?old.pathPoints:points);
      out.pathPoints=Array.from(new Set(path.map(String).filter(p=>points.indexOf(p)>=0)));
      points.forEach(p=>{if(out.pathPoints.indexOf(p)<0)out.pathPoints.push(p);});
      // Never turn a hand-edited line into an automatically replaceable one.
      out.source=(item.manualLine===true||item.selectionKind)?(item.source||'report'):(unchanged?(old.source||item.source||'report'):(item.source||'report'));
      if(unchanged&&old.savedAt)out.savedAt=old.savedAt;
      else if(!out.savedAt)out.savedAt=new Date().toISOString();
      if(!unchanged&&old&&old.source==='auto-line')out.source='report';
      if(gvProfileIsLineSelection(out))out.reportLine=true;
      else if(out.selectionKind==='area')out.reportLine=false;
      return out;
    });
    if(window.GV_CARTO)GV_CARTO.ensureColors(saved.shared,gvProfileSelectionKind);
    return saved;
  }
  function rowsForSelection(item,rows,fallback){
    const rowMap=new Map();rows.forEach(r=>{if(!rowMap.has(key(r)))rowMap.set(key(r),r);});
    (fallback||[]).forEach(r=>{if(Array.isArray(r)&&!rowMap.has(key(r)))rowMap.set(key(r),r);});
    const membership=Array.isArray(item.points)&&item.points.length?item.points.map(String):(item.data||[]).map(i=>rows[i]&&key(rows[i])).filter(Boolean);
    const order=Array.isArray(item.pathPoints)&&item.pathPoints.length?item.pathPoints.map(String):membership;
    const keys=Array.from(new Set(order.filter(p=>membership.indexOf(p)>=0).concat(membership)));
    return keys.map(p=>rowMap.get(p)).filter(Boolean);
  }
  let hydrating=false;
  function syncStore(saved,writeNative){
    // Prepare all copies before touching the live report. No measurements are written.
    const next=clone(saved),transfer=clone(saved),rows=getResultData(),native=nativeSelections();
    const nextNative=writeNative?next.shared.map(s=>{
      const old=native.find(n=>n.name===s.name);
      return Object.assign({},s,{data:rowsForSelection(s,rows,old&&old.data)});
    }):null;
    boxData().geovueSavedPointSelections=next;
    const state=boxData().geovueReportTransferState||(boxData().geovueReportTransferState={version:3});state.savedSelections=transfer;
    if(nextNative){native.length=0;nextNative.forEach(s=>native.push(s));}
    return next;
  }
  function hydrateSelections(){
    hydrating=true;
    try{
      const saved=embeddedStore(),native=nativeSelections(),rows=getResultData();
      if(!native.length&&saved.shared.length)saved.shared.forEach(s=>native.push(Object.assign({},s,{data:rowsForSelection(s,rows)})));
      // The native list is authoritative for manual additions/deletions. Its old
      // row-only format is enriched by matching metadata without dropping it.
      syncStore(captureSelections(),true);
    }finally{hydrating=false;}
  }
  function gvLoadSavedSelections(){return captureSelections();}
  const projectTokens=new WeakMap();let nextProjectToken=0;
  function gvPointSelectionProjectKey(){
    const bd=boxData();if(!projectTokens.has(bd))projectTokens.set(bd,++nextProjectToken);
    return projectTokens.get(bd)+'|'+JSON.stringify(getResultData().map(r=>[key(r),r&&r[1],r&&r[2],gvIsPointIncluded(r)]))+'|'+JSON.stringify(nativeSelections().map(s=>[s.name,namesInNative(s),s.pathPoints||[],s.source||'']));
  }
  function gvProfileMedian(values){const a=(values||[]).filter(function(v){return Number.isFinite(v);}).slice().sort(function(x,y){return x-y;});if(!a.length)return 0;const m=Math.floor(a.length/2);return a.length%2?a[m]:(a[m-1]+a[m])/2;}
  function gvProfileDistance(a,b){const dx=a.x-b.x,dy=a.y-b.y;return Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);}
  function gvProfileProjectPoints(){
    const data=getResultData(); const bd=boxData();
    const raw=[];
    data.forEach(function(row,index){
      if(!row||!gvIsPointIncluded(row,index,bd))return;
      if(row[1]==null||row[2]==null||String(row[1]).trim()===''||String(row[2]).trim()==='')return;
      const lat=Number(row[1]),lon=Number(row[2]);if(!Number.isFinite(lat)||!Number.isFinite(lon)||Math.abs(lat)>90||Math.abs(lon)>180)return;
      raw.push({index:index,point:String(row[0]!=null?row[0]:index+1),lat:lat,lon:lon,row:row});
    });
    if(!raw.length)return [];
    const meanLat=raw.reduce(function(s,p){return s+p.lat;},0)/raw.length;
    const meanLon=raw.reduce(function(s,p){return s+p.lon;},0)/raw.length;
    const metersPerDegLat=111320;
    const metersPerDegLon=Math.max(1000,111320*Math.cos(meanLat*Math.PI/180));
    raw.forEach(function(p){p.x=(p.lon-meanLon)*metersPerDegLon;p.y=(p.lat-meanLat)*metersPerDegLat;});
    return raw;
  }
  function gvProfileNearestDistances(points){
    return points.map(function(p,i){let best=Infinity;points.forEach(function(q,j){if(i===j)return;const d=gvProfileDistance(p,q);if(d>0&&d<best)best=d;});return Number.isFinite(best)?best:0;}).filter(function(v){return v>0;});
  }
  function gvProfileConnectedGroups(points,threshold){
    const seen=new Set(),groups=[];
    for(let i=0;i<points.length;i++){
      if(seen.has(i))continue;
      const stack=[i],component=[];seen.add(i);
      while(stack.length){const at=stack.pop();component.push(points[at]);for(let j=0;j<points.length;j++){if(seen.has(j))continue;if(gvProfileDistance(points[at],points[j])<=threshold){seen.add(j);stack.push(j);}}}
      groups.push(component);
    }
    return groups;
  }
  /* GV_GROUP_SCOPED_EXCLUSIVE_PROFILES_V3_20261002
     Candidate geometry is evaluated separately inside each saved/detected group.
     Final selection and persistence enforce one generated line per point.
     Measurements and saved group definitions are never modified. */
  function gvProfileFitAxis(points){
    const n=points.length;
    if(n<2)return null;
    let x=0,y=0;points.forEach(function(p){x+=p.x;y+=p.y;});x/=n;y/=n;
    let xx=0,xy=0,yy=0;
    points.forEach(function(p){const dx=p.x-x,dy=p.y-y;xx+=dx*dx;xy+=dx*dy;yy+=dy*dy;});
    const angle=.5*Math.atan2(2*xy,xx-yy),ux=Math.cos(angle),uy=Math.sin(angle);
    let sum=0,maxError=0;
    points.forEach(function(p){const e=Math.abs(-(p.x-x)*uy+(p.y-y)*ux);sum+=e*e;maxError=Math.max(maxError,e);});
    return {x:x,y:y,ux:ux,uy:uy,angle:(angle*180/Math.PI+180)%180,rms:Math.sqrt(sum/n),maxError:maxError};
  }
  function gvProfileNaturalPointCompare(a,b){return String(a.point).localeCompare(String(b.point),undefined,{numeric:true,sensitivity:'base'})||a.index-b.index;}
  function gvProfileOrientPath(points){
    const path=points.slice();
    if(path.length>1&&gvProfileNaturalPointCompare(path[0],path[path.length-1])>0)path.reverse();
    return path;
  }
  function gvProfilePathSpacing(points){
    const gaps=[];for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){const d=gvProfileDistance(points[i-1],points[i]);if(d>1e-7)gaps.push(d);}
    return gvProfileMedian(gaps)||0;
  }
  function gvProfileDetectLineCandidates(input,baseSpacing,groupThreshold){
    if(!Array.isArray(input)||input.length<3)return [];
    // Deterministic input order. Co-located points share a geometric node but
    // retain all original identities in the final selection.
    const nodes=[],positionMap=new Map();
    input.slice().sort(gvProfileNaturalPointCompare).forEach(function(p){
      if(!Number.isFinite(p.x)||!Number.isFinite(p.y))return;
      const key=p.x.toFixed(6)+','+p.y.toFixed(6);
      let node=positionMap.get(key);
      if(!node){node=Object.assign({},p,{members:[]});nodes.push(node);positionMap.set(key,node);}
      node.members.push(p);
    });
    if(nodes.length<3)return [];
    const n=nodes.length,base=Math.max(1e-5,baseSpacing||gvProfileMedian(gvProfileNearestDistances(nodes))||1);
    const near=[],nn=[];
    // A bounded neighbour list plus one nearest point per direction retains
    // the long axis of rectangular grids without an all-pairs line histogram.
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const list=[],sectors=Array(24).fill(null);
      for(let j=0;j<n;j++)if(i!==j){
        const dx=nodes[j].x-nodes[i].x,dy=nodes[j].y-nodes[i].y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        if(d<=1e-7)continue;
        const q={j:j,d:d},sector=Math.min(23,Math.floor((Math.atan2(dy,dx)+Math.PI)/(2*Math.PI)*24));
        if(!sectors[sector]||d<sectors[sector].d)sectors[sector]=q;
        list.push(q);
      }
      list.sort(function(a,b){return a.d-b.d||a.j-b.j;});nn[i]=list.length?list[0].d:base;
      const selected=list.slice(0,24),ids=new Set(selected.map(function(q){return q.j;}));
      sectors.forEach(function(q){if(q&&!ids.has(q.j)){selected.push(q);ids.add(q.j);}});
      selected.sort(function(a,b){return a.d-b.d||a.j-b.j;});near.push(selected);
    }
    const scales=nodes.map(function(_,i){return gvProfileMedian([nn[i]].concat(near[i].slice(0,4).map(function(q){return nn[q.j];})))||base;});
    const edges=[],edgeKeys=new Set(),adj=nodes.map(function(){return [];});
    const edgeKey=function(a,b){return a<b?a+':'+b:b+':'+a;};
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++)near[i].forEach(function(q){
      const j=q.j,key=edgeKey(i,j);if(edgeKeys.has(key))return;
      const o=nodes[i],end=nodes[j],ux=(end.x-o.x)/q.d,uy=(end.y-o.y)/q.d;
      let directionalStep=Infinity;
      [i,j].forEach(function(at){
        near[at].forEach(function(r){
          if(r.j===i||r.j===j)return;
          const dx=nodes[r.j].x-nodes[at].x,dy=nodes[r.j].y-nodes[at].y;
          if(Math.abs(dx*uy-dy*ux)<=Math.max(scales[at]*.23,r.d*.06))directionalStep=Math.min(directionalStep,r.d);
        });
      });
      const maxStep=4.25*Math.max(scales[i],scales[j],Number.isFinite(directionalStep)?directionalStep:0);
      if(q.d>maxStep)return;
      // Close parallel traverses can be nearer across the tracks than along
      // them. Retain a supported along-track edge in that case, but not grid
      // diagonals or links that skip a station on the same track.
      let blocked=false,blockerSide=0;
      for(const r of near[i]){
        if(r.d>=q.d*(1-1e-8))break;
        const endDistance=gvProfileDistance(nodes[r.j],end);
        if(r.j!==j&&endDistance<q.d*(1-1e-8)){
          const normal=Math.abs((nodes[r.j].x-o.x)*uy-(nodes[r.j].y-o.y)*ux);
          const parallelSupport=Number.isFinite(directionalStep)&&directionalStep<=q.d*1.6&&
            normal>Math.min(scales[i],scales[j])*.23&&Math.min(r.d,endDistance)<q.d*.68;
          const signed=(nodes[r.j].x-o.x)*uy-(nodes[r.j].y-o.y)*ux;
          const side=signed>0?1:-1;
          if(!parallelSupport||(blockerSide&&blockerSide!==side)){blocked=true;break;}
          blockerSide=side;
        }
      }
      if(blocked)return;
      edgeKeys.add(key);const e={a:i,b:j,d:q.d,id:edges.length};edges.push(e);adj[i].push(e);adj[j].push(e);
    });
    // Pair opposite directions independently at each node, so rows, columns
    // and crossing profiles continue THROUGH a junction instead of stopping.
    const turns=nodes.map(function(){return new Map();});
    function other(e,i){return e.a===i?e.b:e.a;}
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const pairs=[];
      for(let a=0;a<adj[i].length;a++)for(let b=a+1;b<adj[i].length;b++){
        const e=adj[i][a],f=adj[i][b],p=nodes[other(e,i)],q=nodes[other(f,i)],o=nodes[i];
        const cos=((p.x-o.x)*(q.x-o.x)+(p.y-o.y)*(q.y-o.y))/(e.d*f.d);
        const bend=Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,-cos)))*180/Math.PI;
        if(bend<=35)pairs.push({e:e,f:f,bend:bend});
      }
      pairs.sort(function(a,b){return a.bend-b.bend||a.e.id-b.e.id||a.f.id-b.f.id;});
      pairs.forEach(function(p){if(!turns[i].has(p.e.id)&&!turns[i].has(p.f.id)){turns[i].set(p.e.id,p.f);turns[i].set(p.f.id,p.e);}});
    }
    const visited=new Set(),chains=[];
    function walk(start,first){
      const path=[start],seen=new Set(path);let at=start,e=first;
      while(e&&!visited.has(e.id)){
        visited.add(e.id);const next=other(e,at);if(seen.has(next))break;
        path.push(next);seen.add(next);const following=turns[next].get(e.id);at=next;e=following;
      }
      if(path.length>=2)chains.push(path.map(function(i){return nodes[i];}));
    }
    edges.forEach(function(e){if(!turns[e.a].has(e.id))walk(e.a,e);else if(!turns[e.b].has(e.id))walk(e.b,e);});
    edges.forEach(function(e){if(!visited.has(e.id))walk(e.a,e);});
    const localScale=new Map(nodes.map(function(p,i){return [p.index,scales[i]];}));
    const localIndex=new Map(nodes.map(function(p,i){return [p.index,i];}));
    const signature=function(path){return path.map(function(p){return p.index;}).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}).join(',');};
    const candidates=[],candidateKeys=new Set();
    function tolerance(path){return Math.max(1e-5,gvProfileMedian(path.map(function(p){return localScale.get(p.index)||base;}))*.23);}
    function splitGaps(path,expected){
      if(path.length<2)return [path];
      const gaps=[];for(let i=1;i<path.length;i++)gaps.push(gvProfileDistance(path[i-1],path[i]));
      const typical=gvProfileMedian(gaps)||expected||base;
      const limit=4.25*Math.max(expected||0,Math.min(typical,(expected||typical)*2));
      const parts=[];let part=[path[0]];
      for(let i=1;i<path.length;i++){if(gaps[i-1]>limit){parts.push(part);part=[];}part.push(path[i]);}parts.push(part);return parts;
    }
    function addStraight(seed,recovery){
      let fit=gvProfileFitAxis(seed);if(!fit)return;
      const tol=tolerance(seed),expected=gvProfilePathSpacing(seed)||base;
      if(seed.length>2&&fit.maxError>tol*1.65)return;
      let selected=seed.slice(),last='';
      for(let pass=0;pass<4;pass++){
        let inliers=nodes.filter(function(p){return Math.abs(-(p.x-fit.x)*fit.uy+(p.y-fit.y)*fit.ux)<=tol;});
        inliers.sort(function(a,b){return (a.x-b.x)*fit.ux+(a.y-b.y)*fit.uy;});
        const anchor=new Set(selected.map(function(p){return p.index;}));
        const parts=splitGaps(inliers,expected);
        parts.sort(function(a,b){return b.filter(function(p){return anchor.has(p.index);}).length-a.filter(function(p){return anchor.has(p.index);}).length||b.length-a.length;});
        selected=parts[0]||[];if(selected.length<3)return;
        fit=gvProfileFitAxis(selected);const sig=signature(selected);if(sig===last)break;last=sig;
      }
      if(selected.length<3||!fit||fit.maxError>tol*1.65||fit.rms>tol)return;
      selected.sort(function(a,b){return (a.x-b.x)*fit.ux+(a.y-b.y)*fit.uy;});
      // Reject a sideways jump between offset parallel rows masquerading as
      // a gap in one profile. Use local tangents rather than point numbering.
      for(let i=1;i<selected.length;i++){
        const gap=gvProfileDistance(selected[i-1],selected[i]);
        if(gap<=1.7*expected)continue;
        const link=unit(selected[i-1],selected[i]);
        const before=selected.slice(Math.max(0,i-3),i),after=selected.slice(i,i+3);
        const limit=Math.max(12,Math.atan2(tol*2,gap)*180/Math.PI);
        if(before.length>=2&&deviation(unit(before[0],before[before.length-1]),link)>limit)return;
        if(after.length>=2&&deviation(link,unit(after[0],after[after.length-1]))>limit)return;
      }
      const span=gvProfileDistance(selected[0],selected[selected.length-1]);if(span<1.5*(gvProfileMedian(selected.map(function(p){return localScale.get(p.index)||base;}))||base))return;
      const sig=signature(selected);if(candidateKeys.has(sig))return;
      let supported=0;
      for(let i=1;i<selected.length;i++)if(edgeKeys.has(edgeKey(localIndex.get(selected[i-1].index),localIndex.get(selected[i].index))))supported++;
      // A lone accidental edge must not create an entire diagonal across a grid.
      let paired=0;
      for(let i=1;i<selected.length-1;i++){
        const a=localIndex.get(selected[i-1].index),b=localIndex.get(selected[i].index),c=localIndex.get(selected[i+1].index);
        const e=adj[b].find(function(e){return other(e,b)===a;}),f=adj[b].find(function(e){return other(e,b)===c;});
        if(e&&f&&turns[b].get(e.id)===f)paired++;
      }
      if(recovery===true){
        const ids=new Set(selected.map(function(p){return p.index;}));let explainedLength=0;
        candidates.forEach(function(c){if(c.path.some(function(p){return ids.has(p.index);}))explainedLength=Math.max(explainedLength,c.path.length);});
        if(selected.length<5||selected.length<explainedLength*1.6)return;
      }else if(supported<Math.max(1,Math.ceil((selected.length-1)*.45))||paired<Math.max(1,Math.ceil((selected.length-2)*.30)))return;
      candidateKeys.add(sig);candidates.push({path:gvProfileOrientPath(selected),fit:fit,kind:'straight',support:recovery===true?1:supported/(selected.length-1)});
    }
    // Full-chain fitting supplies long-baseline directions immune to small GPS
    // errors. Individual edges recover interrupted rows and sparse grid columns.
    chains.slice().sort(function(a,b){return b.length-a.length;}).forEach(function(path){addStraight(path);});
    edges.forEach(function(e){addStraight([nodes[e.a],nodes[e.b]]);});
    // A densely spaced set of parallel tracks can have only across-track
    // neighbours in its proximity graph. Recover a much longer supported row
    // instead of mistaking that small neighbour graph for the survey direction.
    const longestAt=new Map();
    candidates.forEach(function(c){c.path.forEach(function(p){longestAt.set(p.index,Math.max(longestAt.get(p.index)||0,c.path.length));});});
    nodes.forEach(function(p,i){
      if((longestAt.get(p.index)||0)>=5)return;
      near[i].slice(0,16).forEach(function(q){addStraight([p,nodes[q.j]],true);});
    });
    // Preserve long smooth road-style chains, even where no single straight
    // line can fit them. No requirement that a component has degree <= 2.
    let paths=chains.filter(function(path){return path.length>=3;}).map(function(path){return gvProfileOrientPath(path);});
    function unit(a,b){const d=gvProfileDistance(a,b);return d>1e-7?{x:(b.x-a.x)/d,y:(b.y-a.y)/d}:null;}
    function deviation(a,b){return a&&b?Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y)))*180/Math.PI:180;}
    // Join endpoints only when BOTH tangents agree with the connecting segment.
    // This bridges missed stations but does not jump sideways into parallel rows.
    let joined=true;
    while(joined){
      joined=false;let best=null;
      for(let i=0;i<paths.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<paths.length;j++){
        const ids=new Set(paths[i].map(function(p){return p.index;}));
        if(paths[j].some(function(p){return ids.has(p.index);}))continue;
        for(let flipA=0;flipA<2;flipA++)for(let flipB=0;flipB<2;flipB++){
          const a=flipA?paths[i].slice().reverse():paths[i],b=flipB?paths[j].slice().reverse():paths[j];
          const gap=gvProfileDistance(a[a.length-1],b[0]),step=Math.min(gvProfilePathSpacing(a),gvProfilePathSpacing(b));
          if(gap>4.25*step||gap<1e-7)continue;
          const link=unit(a[a.length-1],b[0]),ta=unit(a[Math.max(0,a.length-3)],a[a.length-1]),tb=unit(b[0],b[Math.min(2,b.length-1)]);
          const da=deviation(ta,link),db=deviation(link,tb);if(da>22||db>22)continue;
          const score=da+db+gap/step;
          if(!best||score<best.score)best={i:i,j:j,path:a.concat(b),score:score};
        }
      }
      if(best){paths[best.i]=gvProfileOrientPath(best.path);paths.splice(best.j,1);joined=true;}
    }
    paths.forEach(function(path){
      if(path.length<4)return;
      const fit=gvProfileFitAxis(path),tol=tolerance(path);if(fit&&fit.maxError<=tol){addStraight(path);return;}
      let sum=0,max=0;
      for(let i=1;i<path.length-1;i++){const bend=deviation(unit(path[i-1],path[i]),unit(path[i],path[i+1]));sum+=bend;max=Math.max(max,bend);}
      if(max>40||sum/(path.length-2)>22)return;
      const sig=signature(path);if(candidateKeys.has(sig))return;
      candidateKeys.add(sig);candidates.push({path:path,kind:'path',fit:fit,support:1});
    });
    // Retain alternative candidate directions for the exclusive selector below.
    // Candidates may intersect; final saved lines must never share a point.
    candidates.forEach(function(c){
      c.familyStrength=candidates.filter(function(d){if(c.kind!=='straight'||d.kind!=='straight')return false;let a=Math.abs(c.fit.angle-d.fit.angle)%180;return Math.min(a,180-a)<6;}).length;
    });
    candidates.sort(function(a,b){return b.path.length-a.path.length||b.familyStrength-a.familyStrength||b.support-a.support||((a.fit&&a.fit.rms)||0)-((b.fit&&b.fit.rms)||0);});
    const accepted=[];
    candidates.forEach(function(c){
      const ids=new Set(c.path.map(function(p){return p.index;}));
      if(accepted.some(function(a){const as=new Set(a.path.map(function(p){return p.index;}));return c.path.every(function(p){return as.has(p.index);});}))return;
      // At irregular grid edges a weak diagonal can be fitted through already
      // explained nodes. Keep strong crossing directions, not accidental ones.
      const covered=new Set();accepted.forEach(function(a){a.path.forEach(function(p){covered.add(p.index);});});
      if(c.support<.7&&c.path.filter(function(p){return !covered.has(p.index);}).length<2)return;
      if(c.kind==='straight'){
        const long=accepted.filter(function(a){return a.path.length>=c.path.length*1.8;});
        const explained=c.path.every(function(p){return long.some(function(a){return a.path.some(function(q){return q.index===p.index;});});});
        const directions=long.filter(function(a){return a.kind==='straight'&&a.path.some(function(p){return ids.has(p.index);});}).map(function(a){return a.fit.angle;});
        const apart=function(a,b){let d=Math.abs(a-b)%180;return Math.min(d,180-d);};
        if(explained&&directions.some(function(a){return directions.some(function(b){return apart(a,b)>20;});})&&
          !directions.some(function(a){return apart(a,c.fit.angle)<10;}))return;
      }
      // Once two crossing families already explain a grid, a third direction
      // through exactly those stations is normally an artificial diagonal.
      const fullyGridded=c.path.every(function(p){
        const angles=accepted.filter(function(a){return a.kind==='straight'&&a.path.some(function(q){return q.index===p.index;});}).map(function(a){return a.fit.angle;});
        return angles.some(function(a){return angles.some(function(b){let d=Math.abs(a-b)%180;d=Math.min(d,180-d);return d>25;});});
      });
      if(fullyGridded)return;
      accepted.push(c);
    });
    return accepted.map(function(c){
      const path=gvProfileOrientPath(c.path),expanded=[];
      path.forEach(function(p){p.members.slice().sort(gvProfileNaturalPointCompare).forEach(function(q){expanded.push(q.index);});});
      return {indexes:expanded,angle:c.fit?c.fit.angle:null,rms:c.fit?c.fit.rms:null,kind:c.kind,support:c.support,detectorVersion:3};
    }).sort(function(a,b){
      const ap=input.find(function(p){return p.index===a.indexes[0];}),bp=input.find(function(p){return p.index===b.indexes[0];});
      return gvProfileNaturalPointCompare(ap,bp)||(a.angle||0)-(b.angle||0)||b.indexes.length-a.indexes.length;
    });
  }
  /* GV_MANUAL_SELECTION_MAP_LINES_V1_20261003
     Classification is independent of a user's saved name. Old report/shared
     selections have no type, so named multi-point selections remain usable.
     No stored measurements, selection names or automatic ownership are changed. */
  function gvProfileSelectionKind(item){
    if(!item||typeof item!=='object')return '';
    const source=String(item.source||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    const kind=String(item.selectionKind||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    const name=String(item.name||'').trim();
    const count=Math.max(Array.isArray(item.points)?item.points.length:0,Array.isArray(item.data)?item.data.length:0);
    if(source==='auto-group'||kind==='group')return 'group';
    if(source==='auto-line')return 'line';
    if(kind==='area')return '';
    if(kind==='line'||item.manualLine===true||item.reportLine===true)return count>=2?'line':'';
    if(/^group\s+\d+$/i.test(name))return 'group';
    // All is the report's built-in full-project selection, not a survey line.
    if(count<2||!name||/^all(?:\s+points)?$/i.test(name))return '';
    if(item.profileKind==='path'||/^line(?:\b|\d)/i.test(name))return 'line';
    if(/^(?:sections?|profiles?(?:one|two|three)?|manual-line|line)$/.test(source))return 'line';
    if(/^(?:shared|report|manual|selection)?$/.test(source)){
      return 'line';
    }
    return '';
  }
  function gvProfileIsGroupSelection(item){return gvProfileSelectionKind(item)==='group';}
  function gvProfileIsLineSelection(item){return gvProfileSelectionKind(item)==='line';}
  function gvProfilePointKey(point){return String(point.point==null?point.index:point.point).trim();}
  function gvProfileSelectionIndexes(item,data){
    const names=Array.isArray(item&&item.points)?item.points.map(function(p){return String(p).trim();}).filter(Boolean):[];
    let indexes=[];
    if(names.length){
      const wanted=new Set(names);
      data.forEach(function(row,i){if(row&&wanted.has(String(row[0]).trim()))indexes.push(i);});
    }else indexes=(Array.isArray(item&&item.data)?item.data:[]).map(Number).filter(function(i){return Number.isInteger(i)&&i>=0&&i<data.length&&data[i];});
    return Array.from(new Set(indexes));
  }
  function gvProfileGroupDefinitions(store,data){
    const seen=new Set(),groups=[];
    (store.shared||[]).filter(gvProfileIsGroupSelection).forEach(function(item){
      const indexes=gvProfileSelectionIndexes(item,data).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}),signature=indexes.join(',');
      if(!indexes.length||seen.has(signature))return;
      seen.add(signature);groups.push({name:item.name,indexes:indexes,members:new Set(indexes)});
    });
    return groups;
  }
  function gvProfileReservedPointKeys(store,data,includeAutomatic){
    const keys=new Set();
    (store.shared||[]).filter(gvProfileIsLineSelection).forEach(function(item){
      if(!includeAutomatic&&item.source==='auto-line')return;
      gvProfileSelectionIndexes(item,data).forEach(function(i){keys.add(String(data[i][0]).trim());});
    });
    return keys;
  }
  function gvProfileResolveGroupScopes(points,detectedGroups,store,data,threshold){
    // Saved group membership is authoritative: never re-cluster two saved
    // groups into a larger line-search domain merely because they are close.
    const definitions=gvProfileGroupDefinitions(store,data),byIndex=new Map(points.map(function(p){return [p.index,p];}));
    // Even excluded stations can define the displayed saved-group boundary.
    // Project their coordinates in the same frame used by the included points.
    const boundaryByIndex=new Map(byIndex),anchor=points.find(function(p){return Number.isFinite(p.lat)&&Number.isFinite(p.lon);});
    if(anchor){
      const valid=points.filter(function(p){return Number.isFinite(p.lat);}),meanLat=valid.reduce(function(n,p){return n+p.lat;},0)/Math.max(1,valid.length);
      const sx=Math.max(1000,111320*Math.cos(meanLat*Math.PI/180));
      data.forEach(function(row,index){
        if(boundaryByIndex.has(index)||!row||row[1]==null||row[2]==null||row[1]===''||row[2]==='')return;
        const lat=Number(row[1]),lon=Number(row[2]);if(!Number.isFinite(lat)||!Number.isFinite(lon))return;
        boundaryByIndex.set(index,{index:index,point:String(row[0]),lat:lat,lon:lon,x:anchor.x+(lon-anchor.lon)*sx,y:anchor.y+(lat-anchor.lat)*111320});
      });
    }
    const memberships=new Map(),counts=new Map();
    data.forEach(function(row){if(row){const key=String(row[0]).trim();counts.set(key,(counts.get(key)||0)+1);}});
    definitions.forEach(function(group,g){group.indexes.forEach(function(i){if(!memberships.has(i))memberships.set(i,[]);memberships.get(i).push(g);});});
    const ambiguous=new Set(),scopes=[],groupsToAdd=[];
    points.forEach(function(p){if((memberships.get(p.index)||[]).length>1||counts.get(gvProfilePointKey(p))>1)ambiguous.add(p.index);});
    definitions.forEach(function(group){
      const available=group.indexes.map(function(i){return byIndex.get(i);}).filter(Boolean);
      scopes.push({name:group.name,groupIndexes:group.indexes.slice(),boundaryPoints:group.indexes.map(function(i){return boundaryByIndex.get(i);}).filter(Boolean),points:available.filter(function(p){return !ambiguous.has(p.index);})});
    });
    const free=points.filter(function(p){return !memberships.has(p.index)&&!ambiguous.has(p.index);});
    const newGroups=definitions.length?gvProfileConnectedGroups(free,threshold).filter(function(g){return g.length>=2;}):detectedGroups;
    newGroups.forEach(function(group){
      const available=group.filter(function(p){return byIndex.has(p.index)&&!ambiguous.has(p.index);});
      if(available.length<2)return;
      groupsToAdd.push(available);
      scopes.push({name:'',groupIndexes:available.map(function(p){return p.index;}),boundaryPoints:available,points:available});
    });
    return {scopes:scopes,groupsToAdd:groupsToAdd,ambiguousCount:ambiguous.size};
  }
  function gvProfileBoundaryPolygon(input){
    const seen=new Set(),points=[];
    input.forEach(function(p){if(!Number.isFinite(p.x)||!Number.isFinite(p.y))return;const key=p.x+','+p.y;if(!seen.has(key)){seen.add(key);points.push(p);}});
    if(!points.length)return [];
    const cross=function(o,a,b){return (a.x-o.x)*(b.y-o.y)-(a.y-o.y)*(b.x-o.x);};
    points.sort(function(a,b){return a.x-b.x||a.y-b.y;});
    const lower=[],upper=[];
    points.forEach(function(p){while(lower.length>=2&&cross(lower[lower.length-2],lower[lower.length-1],p)<=0)lower.pop();lower.push(p);});
    points.slice().reverse().forEach(function(p){while(upper.length>=2&&cross(upper[upper.length-2],upper[upper.length-1],p)<=0)upper.pop();upper.push(p);});
    const hull=lower.slice(0,-1).concat(upper.slice(0,-1));
    if(hull.length>=3)return hull;
    // Match the map's visible envelope for a two-point or collinear group.
