    const a=points[0],b=points[points.length-1],length=gvProfileDistance(a,b);
    if(length<1e-7)return [{x:a.x-5,y:a.y-5},{x:a.x+5,y:a.y-5},{x:a.x+5,y:a.y+5},{x:a.x-5,y:a.y+5}];
    const ux=(b.x-a.x)/length,uy=(b.y-a.y)/length,width=Math.max(3,Math.min(20,length*.12)),cap=Math.min(10,width*.65);
    return [
      {x:a.x-ux*cap-uy*width,y:a.y-uy*cap+ux*width},{x:b.x+ux*cap-uy*width,y:b.y+uy*cap+ux*width},
      {x:b.x+ux*cap+uy*width,y:b.y+uy*cap-ux*width},{x:a.x-ux*cap+uy*width,y:a.y-uy*cap-ux*width}
    ];
  }
  function gvProfileBoundaryContains(p,polygon){
    if(polygon.length<3)return false;
    let sign=0;
    for(let i=0;i<polygon.length;i++){
      const a=polygon[i],b=polygon[(i+1)%polygon.length],cross=(b.x-a.x)*(p.y-a.y)-(b.y-a.y)*(p.x-a.x);
      if(Math.abs(cross)<=1e-7)continue;
      const next=cross>0?1:-1;if(sign&&sign!==next)return false;sign=next;
    }
    return true;
  }
  function gvProfileSegmentCrossesBoundary(a,b,polygon){
    if(polygon.length<3)return false;
    if(gvProfileBoundaryContains(a,polygon)||gvProfileBoundaryContains(b,polygon))return true;
    function cross(p,q,r){return (q.x-p.x)*(r.y-p.y)-(q.y-p.y)*(r.x-p.x);}
    function on(p,q,r){return r.x>=Math.min(p.x,q.x)-1e-7&&r.x<=Math.max(p.x,q.x)+1e-7&&r.y>=Math.min(p.y,q.y)-1e-7&&r.y<=Math.max(p.y,q.y)+1e-7;}
    for(let i=0;i<polygon.length;i++){
      const c=polygon[i],d=polygon[(i+1)%polygon.length],abC=cross(a,b,c),abD=cross(a,b,d),cdA=cross(c,d,a),cdB=cross(c,d,b);
      if(((abC>1e-7&&abD< -1e-7)||(abC< -1e-7&&abD>1e-7))&&((cdA>1e-7&&cdB< -1e-7)||(cdA< -1e-7&&cdB>1e-7)))return true;
      if((Math.abs(abC)<=1e-7&&on(a,b,c))||(Math.abs(abD)<=1e-7&&on(a,b,d))||(Math.abs(cdA)<=1e-7&&on(c,d,a))||(Math.abs(cdB)<=1e-7&&on(c,d,b)))return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  /* GV_COVERAGE_SEQUENCE_PARALLEL_PROFILES_V4_20261002
     Numbering is a preference, not geometry: gaps, group boundaries, unique
     ownership, and non-crossing segments remain mandatory. No data is changed. */
  function gvProfileAngleApart(a,b){const d=Math.abs(a-b)%180;return Math.min(d,180-d);}
  function gvProfileBend(a,b,c){
    const u=gvProfileDistance(a,b),v=gvProfileDistance(b,c);
    if(u<1e-7||v<1e-7)return 0;
    return Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,((b.x-a.x)*(c.x-b.x)+(b.y-a.y)*(c.y-b.y))/(u*v))))*180/Math.PI;
  }
  function gvProfileSegmentsIntersect(a,b,c,d){
    const eps=1e-6;
    if(Math.max(a.x,b.x)+eps<Math.min(c.x,d.x)||Math.max(c.x,d.x)+eps<Math.min(a.x,b.x)||
       Math.max(a.y,b.y)+eps<Math.min(c.y,d.y)||Math.max(c.y,d.y)+eps<Math.min(a.y,b.y))return false;
    const cross=function(p,q,r){return (q.x-p.x)*(r.y-p.y)-(q.y-p.y)*(r.x-p.x);};
    const sign=function(v,t){return v>t?1:v< -t?-1:0;};
    const t1=eps*Math.max(1,gvProfileDistance(a,b)),t2=eps*Math.max(1,gvProfileDistance(c,d));
    const ac=sign(cross(a,b,c),t1),ad=sign(cross(a,b,d),t1),ca=sign(cross(c,d,a),t2),cb=sign(cross(c,d,b),t2);
    const on=function(p,q,r){return r.x>=Math.min(p.x,q.x)-eps&&r.x<=Math.max(p.x,q.x)+eps&&r.y>=Math.min(p.y,q.y)-eps&&r.y<=Math.max(p.y,q.y)+eps;};
    return (ac*ad<0&&ca*cb<0)||(!ac&&on(a,b,c))||(!ad&&on(a,b,d))||(!ca&&on(c,d,a))||(!cb&&on(c,d,b));
  }
  function gvProfileSequenceModel(points){
    const numbers=new Map(),diffs=[];
    points.forEach(function(p){
      const text=String(p.point==null?'':p.point).trim(),match=text.match(/^(.*?)(\d+)$/);
      if(match&&Number.isSafeInteger(Number(match[2])))numbers.set(p.index,{prefix:match[1].toLowerCase(),value:Number(match[2])});
    });
    const series=new Map();numbers.forEach(function(n){if(!series.has(n.prefix))series.set(n.prefix,[]);series.get(n.prefix).push(n.value);});
    const steps=new Map();series.forEach(function(values,prefix){
      values.sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});const counts=new Map();
      for(let i=1;i<values.length;i++){const d=values[i]-values[i-1];if(d>0){counts.set(d,(counts.get(d)||0)+1);diffs.push(d);}}
      const ranked=Array.from(counts).sort(function(a,b){return b[1]-a[1]||a[0]-b[0];});steps.set(prefix,ranked.length?ranked[0][0]:1);
    });
    function affinity(a,b){
      const x=numbers.get(a.index),y=numbers.get(b.index);if(!x||!y||x.prefix!==y.prefix)return 0;
      const d=Math.abs(x.value-y.value)/(steps.get(x.prefix)||1);
      return d>0?1/Math.pow(Math.max(1,d),1.25):0;
    }
    const ordered=new Map(),ranks=new Map();
    points.forEach(function(p){const n=numbers.get(p.index);if(!n)return;if(!ordered.has(n.prefix))ordered.set(n.prefix,[]);ordered.get(n.prefix).push(p);});
    ordered.forEach(function(items){items.sort(gvProfileNaturalPointCompare);items.forEach(function(p,i){ranks.set(p.index,i);});});
    function direction(a,b){const x=numbers.get(a.index),y=numbers.get(b.index);return x&&y&&x.prefix===y.prefix?Math.sign(y.value-x.value):0;}
    function gap(a,b){const x=numbers.get(a.index),y=numbers.get(b.index);return x&&y&&x.prefix===y.prefix?Math.abs(y.value-x.value)/(steps.get(x.prefix)||1):Infinity;}
    return {affinity:affinity,number:function(p){return numbers.get(p.index);},direction:direction,gap:gap,
      adjacent:function(a,b){return !!direction(a,b)&&Math.abs(ranks.get(a.index)-ranks.get(b.index))===1;},
      score:function(path){let s=0;for(let i=1;i<path.length;i++)s+=affinity(path[i-1],path[i]);return path.length>1?s/(path.length-1):0;}};
  }
  /* GV_SEQUENCE_FIRST_CONTINUOUS_PROFILES_V5
     Collection order is the primary path evidence inside each group. A bend
     alone is not a break. Geometry still vetoes remote jumps, survey-row
     resets, occupied stations, intersections and foreign group boundaries. */
  function gvProfileSequenceRoutes(ctx){
    const model=ctx.sequence,series=new Map(),routes=[],cuts=new Set(),links=new Set();
    const key=function(a,b){return a.index<b.index?a.index+':'+b.index:b.index+':'+a.index;};
    ctx.points.forEach(function(p){const n=model.number(p);if(!n)return;
      if(!series.has(n.prefix))series.set(n.prefix,[]);series.get(n.prefix).push(p);
    });
    function direction(a,b){const d=gvProfileDistance(a,b);return d>1e-7?{x:(b.x-a.x)/d,y:(b.y-a.y)/d}:null;}
    function dot(a,b){return a&&b?a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y:0;}
    const linkLimits=new Map(),supportedReach=new Map();
    // Closely spaced parallel rows may be much nearer than the next station
    // along the row. Existing multi-station geometry supplies an independent
    // spacing estimate, rather than letting cross-row spacing veto sequence.
    (ctx.geometryCandidates||[]).forEach(function(candidate){
      const path=(candidate.indexes||[]).map(function(i){return ctx.byIndex.get(i);}).filter(Boolean);
      if(path.length<3)return;const expected=gvProfilePathSpacing(path);
      for(let i=1;i<path.length;i++){
        const a=path[i-1],b=path[i],d=gvProfileDistance(a,b);
        if(expected>1e-7&&d<=expected*4.25)supportedReach.set(key(a,b),d*1.1);
      }
    });
    series.forEach(function(ordered){
      ordered.sort(gvProfileNaturalPointCompare);
      const localSteps=[];
      for(let i=1;i<ordered.length;i++){
        const a=ordered[i-1],b=ordered[i],d=gvProfileDistance(a,b);
        if(model.adjacent(a,b)&&d>1e-7&&d<=ctx.limit(a,b))localSteps.push(d/Math.min(3,Math.max(1,model.gap(a,b))));
      }
      const spacing=gvProfileMedian(localSteps)||ctx.base;
      function limit(a,b){
        // A few missing numbers/stations may stretch a link, but an isolated
        // point must not enlarge the search radius for the rest of the group.
        return Math.max(ctx.limit(a,b),supportedReach.get(key(a,b))||0,Math.min(6*Math.max(ctx.local(a),ctx.local(b)),spacing*4.5));
      }
      function validPair(a,b){return model.adjacent(a,b)&&model.gap(a,b)<=12&&gvProfileDistance(a,b)<=limit(a,b);}
      function windowDirection(first,last){
        if(first<0||last>=ordered.length||last-first<2)return null;
        const dir=direction(ordered[first],ordered[last]);if(!dir)return null;
        for(let i=first+1;i<=last;i++){
          if(cuts.has(key(ordered[i-1],ordered[i]))||!model.adjacent(ordered[i-1],ordered[i])||model.gap(ordered[i-1],ordered[i])>12||dot(dir,direction(ordered[i-1],ordered[i]))<.90)return null;
        }
        return dir;
      }
      for(let i=1;i<ordered.length;i++){
        const a=ordered[i-1],b=ordered[i],edge=key(a,b);linkLimits.set(edge,limit(a,b));
        if(!validPair(a,b))continue;
        // Only an evidenced lane reset splits a short numbered connection.
        // Two established parallel runs that reverse direction, with a
        // transverse end connector, indicate the next serpentine grid row.
        // A single elbow, same-direction dogleg or gradual curve is retained.
        const before=windowDirection(i-3,i-1),after=windowDirection(i,i+2),bridge=direction(a,b);
        if(before&&after&&bridge&&dot(before,after)<-.88&&Math.abs(dot(before,bridge))<.96){
          const left=ordered[i-3],right=ordered[i+2];
          const reachA=gvProfileDistance(left,a),reachB=gvProfileDistance(b,right),gap=gvProfileDistance(a,b);
          if(Math.min(reachA,reachB)>gap*.60){cuts.add(edge);continue;}
        }
        // Same-direction row numbering normally jumps back to the next row's
        // start. Distinguish that reset from a real continuing bent path.
        if(before&&after&&bridge&&dot(before,after)>.90&&dot(before,bridge)<-.55){cuts.add(edge);continue;}
        links.add(edge);
      }
      // Short two-station grid rows need repeated return-pattern evidence;
      // one sharp bend by itself is still not a reason to split a path.
      const shortReturns=[];
      for(let i=2;i+1<ordered.length;i++){
        const a=ordered[i-1],b=ordered[i];if(!validPair(a,b))continue;
        const before=direction(ordered[i-2],a),after=direction(b,ordered[i+1]),bridge=direction(a,b);
        if(before&&after&&bridge&&validPair(ordered[i-2],a)&&validPair(b,ordered[i+1])&&
          dot(before,after)<-.95&&Math.abs(dot(before,bridge))<.35){shortReturns.push({a:a,b:b,bridge:bridge});}
      }
      shortReturns.forEach(function(reset){
        if(shortReturns.filter(function(other){return Math.abs(dot(reset.bridge,other.bridge))>.96;}).length>=2){
          const edge=key(reset.a,reset.b);cuts.add(edge);links.delete(edge);
        }
      });
      let run=[];
      function flush(){if(run.length>=2)routes.push(run);run=[];}
      ordered.forEach(function(p){if(run.length&&!links.has(key(run[run.length-1],p)))flush();run.push(p);});flush();
    });
    routes.sort(function(a,b){return b.length-a.length||gvProfileNaturalPointCompare(a[0],b[0]);});
    function canJoin(path){
      if(path.length<2)return false;let sign=0;
      for(let i=1;i<path.length;i++){
        const a=path[i-1],b=path[i],s=model.direction(a,b);
        if(!s||(sign&&s!==sign)||!links.has(key(a,b)))return false;sign=s;
      }
      return true;
    }
    return {routes:routes,linked:function(a,b){return links.has(key(a,b));},cut:function(a,b){return cuts.has(key(a,b));},
      limit:function(a,b){return linkLimits.get(key(a,b))||ctx.limit(a,b);},canJoin:canJoin};
  }
  function gvProfileCoverageContext(points,baseSpacing,threshold){
    const byIndex=new Map(points.map(function(p){return [p.index,p];})),near=new Map(),nn=new Map();
    points.forEach(function(p){
      const list=points.filter(function(q){return q.index!==p.index;}).map(function(q){return {p:q,d:gvProfileDistance(p,q)};})
        .sort(function(a,b){return a.d-b.d||gvProfileNaturalPointCompare(a.p,b.p);});
      near.set(p.index,list.slice(0,16));const first=list.find(function(q){return q.d>1e-7;});nn.set(p.index,first?first.d:0);
    });
    const base=Math.max(1e-5,gvProfileMedian(Array.from(nn.values()).filter(function(v){return v>0;}))||baseSpacing||1),scales=new Map();
    points.forEach(function(p){
      // An isolated point's own large nearest-neighbour distance must not
      // inflate its permitted reach. Estimate reach from nearby stations.
      const values=(near.get(p.index)||[]).slice(0,4).map(function(q){return nn.get(q.p.index);}).filter(function(v){return v>0;});
      scales.set(p.index,Math.max(1e-5,Math.min(base*2.5,gvProfileMedian(values)||base)));
    });
    function limit(a,b){return 3.5*Math.max(scales.get(a.index)||base,scales.get(b.index)||base);}
    return {points:points,byIndex:byIndex,near:near,base:base,scales:scales,sequence:gvProfileSequenceModel(points),limit:limit,
      local:function(p){return scales.get(p.index)||base;},
      isolated:function(p){return !(near.get(p.index)||[]).some(function(q){return q.d<=limit(p,q.p);});}};
  }
  function gvProfileCoverageCandidates(candidates,ctx){
    const points=ctx.points,output=[],signatures=new Set();
    function add(path,kind,support){
      if(path.length<2)return;
      path=gvProfileOrientPath(path);const sig=path.map(function(p){return p.index;}).slice().sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}).join(',');
      if(signatures.has(sig))return;
      if(!path.some(function(p){return gvProfileDistance(p,path[0])>1e-7;}))return;
      signatures.add(sig);const fit=gvProfileFitAxis(path);
      output.push({path:path,kind:kind||'straight',angle:fit?fit.angle:0,rms:fit?fit.rms:0,support:support||1,sequence:ctx.sequence.score(path)});
    }
    candidates.forEach(function(c){add((c.indexes||[]).map(function(i){return ctx.byIndex.get(i);}).filter(Boolean),c.kind,c.support);});
    // Keep bends intact in numbered candidates. The sequence-first pass below
    // assigns these routes before competing straight-axis candidates.
    const numbered=points.slice().sort(gvProfileNaturalPointCompare);
    (ctx.sequenceRoutes||gvProfileSequenceRoutes(ctx)).routes.forEach(function(run){
      const fit=gvProfileFitAxis(run);add(run,fit&&fit.maxError<=ctx.base*.4?'straight':'path',1);
    });
    // Recover short and slightly noisy grid rows in the strongest observed
    // directions. Unlike the old detector this accepts two-station sections.
    const headings=[];
    output.filter(function(c){return c.kind==='straight';}).forEach(function(c){headings.push({angle:c.angle,weight:(c.path.length-1)*(1+ctx.sequence.score(c.path)*2)});});
    for(let i=1;i<numbered.length;i++){
      const a=numbered[i-1],b=numbered[i],d=gvProfileDistance(a,b),s=ctx.sequence.affinity(a,b);
      if(s>=.35&&d>1e-7&&d<=ctx.limit(a,b))headings.push({angle:(Math.atan2(b.y-a.y,b.x-a.x)*180/Math.PI+180)%180,weight:s*2});
    }
    if(!headings.length)points.forEach(function(p){(ctx.near.get(p.index)||[]).slice(0,2).forEach(function(q){if(q.d>1e-7&&q.d<=ctx.limit(p,q.p))headings.push({angle:(Math.atan2(q.p.y-p.y,q.p.x-p.x)*180/Math.PI+180)%180,weight:1});});});
    headings.sort(function(a,b){return b.weight-a.weight||a.angle-b.angle;});
    const families=[];
    headings.forEach(function(h){let f=families.find(function(f){return gvProfileAngleApart(f.angle,h.angle)<9;});if(!f){f={angle:h.angle,weight:0};families.push(f);}f.weight+=h.weight;});
    families.sort(function(a,b){return b.weight-a.weight||a.angle-b.angle;});
    families.slice(0,4).forEach(function(f){
      const ux=Math.cos(f.angle*Math.PI/180),uy=Math.sin(f.angle*Math.PI/180),tol=ctx.base*.38;
      const sorted=points.slice().sort(function(a,b){return (-a.x*uy+a.y*ux)-(-b.x*uy+b.y*ux)||gvProfileNaturalPointCompare(a,b);});
      const lanes=[];let lane=[],sum=0;
      sorted.forEach(function(p){const t=-p.x*uy+p.y*ux;
        if(lane.length&&Math.abs(t-sum/lane.length)>tol){lanes.push(lane);lane=[];sum=0;}lane.push(p);sum+=t;
      });if(lane.length)lanes.push(lane);
      lanes.forEach(function(lane){
        lane.sort(function(a,b){return (a.x-b.x)*ux+(a.y-b.y)*uy;});let part=[];
        function save(){if(part.length>=2){const fit=gvProfileFitAxis(part);if(fit&&fit.maxError<=ctx.base*.6)add(part,'straight',.85);}part=[];}
        lane.forEach(function(p){
          if(part.length){const q=part[part.length-1];if(gvProfileDistance(p,q)>ctx.limit(p,q)||(part.length>1&&gvProfileBend(part[part.length-2],q,p)>48))save();}
          part.push(p);
        });save();
      });
    });
    return output;
  }
  function gvProfileSavedLinePaths(store,data,points,includeAutomatic){
    if(!points.length)return [];
    const anchor=points.find(function(p){return Number.isFinite(p.lat)&&Number.isFinite(p.lon);});if(!anchor)return [];
    const meanLat=points.reduce(function(s,p){return s+p.lat;},0)/points.length,sx=Math.max(1000,111320*Math.cos(meanLat*Math.PI/180));
    const byIndex=new Map(points.map(function(p){return [p.index,p];}));
    data.forEach(function(row,index){if(byIndex.has(index)||!row||row[1]==null||row[2]==null||row[1]===''||row[2]==='')return;
      const lat=Number(row[1]),lon=Number(row[2]);if(Number.isFinite(lat)&&Number.isFinite(lon))byIndex.set(index,{index:index,point:String(row[0]),lat:lat,lon:lon,x:anchor.x+(lon-anchor.lon)*sx,y:anchor.y+(lat-anchor.lat)*111320});});
    return (store.shared||[]).filter(function(s){return gvProfileIsLineSelection(s)&&(includeAutomatic||s.source!=='auto-line');}).map(function(s){
      let path=gvProfileSelectionIndexes(s,data).map(function(i){return byIndex.get(i);}).filter(Boolean);
      if(Array.isArray(s.pathPoints)&&s.pathPoints.length){const rank=new Map(s.pathPoints.map(function(p,i){return [String(p).trim(),i];}));path.sort(function(a,b){return (rank.get(gvProfilePointKey(a))??1e12)-(rank.get(gvProfilePointKey(b))??1e12)||gvProfileNaturalPointCompare(a,b);});}
      else {const fit=gvProfileFitAxis(path);if(fit)path.sort(function(a,b){return (a.x-b.x)*fit.ux+(a.y-b.y)*fit.uy;});}
      return path;
    }).filter(function(path){return path.length>=2;});
  }
  function gvProfileSelectExclusiveLines(candidates,points,reservedKeys,foreignBoundaries,options){
    options=options||{};
    const ctx=gvProfileCoverageContext(points,options.baseSpacing,options.threshold),sequence=ctx.sequence;
    const boundaries=foreignBoundaries||[],reserved=new Set(reservedKeys||[]),occupied=new Set(reserved),result=[];
    const fixedPaths=(options.reservedPaths||[]).filter(function(path){return path.length>=2;});
    const blocked=new Set(points.filter(function(p){return boundaries.some(function(poly){return gvProfileBoundaryContains(p,poly);});}).map(function(p){return p.index;}));
    ctx.geometryCandidates=candidates;
    const continuity=gvProfileSequenceRoutes(ctx);ctx.sequenceRoutes=continuity;
    const alternatives=gvProfileCoverageCandidates(candidates,ctx);
    function segmentSafe(a,b,ignore){
      if(continuity.cut(a,b))return false;
      if(boundaries.some(function(poly){return gvProfileSegmentCrossesBoundary(a,b,poly);}))return false;
      const paths=fixedPaths.concat(result.filter(function(_,i){return !ignore||!ignore.has(i);}).map(function(r){return r.path;}));
      for(const path of paths)for(let i=1;i<path.length;i++)if(gvProfileSegmentsIntersect(a,b,path[i-1],path[i]))return false;
      return true;
    }
    function pathSafe(path,ignore){
      if(path.length<2||!path.some(function(p){return gvProfileDistance(p,path[0])>1e-7;}))return false;
      const keys=new Set();
      for(const p of path){const key=gvProfilePointKey(p);if(keys.has(key)||blocked.has(p.index)||reserved.has(key))return false;keys.add(key);}
      const distinct=[];path.forEach(function(p){if(!distinct.length||gvProfileDistance(p,distinct[distinct.length-1])>1e-7)distinct.push(p);});
      for(let i=1;i<distinct.length;i++){
        if(!segmentSafe(distinct[i-1],distinct[i],ignore))return false;
        for(let j=1;j<i-1;j++)if(gvProfileSegmentsIntersect(distinct[i-1],distinct[i],distinct[j-1],distinct[j]))return false;
      }
      // A connector cannot jump through an occupied point, or through an
      // unassigned station on the same segment without including that station.
      for(const p of points){
        if(keys.has(gvProfilePointKey(p)))continue;
        for(let i=1;i<path.length;i++)if(gvProfileDistance(path[i-1],path[i])>1e-7&&gvProfileSegmentsIntersect(path[i-1],path[i],p,p))return false;
      }
      return true;
    }
    function describe(path,kind){const fit=gvProfileFitAxis(path);return {path:gvProfileOrientPath(path),kind:kind||(fit&&fit.maxError<=ctx.base*.4?'straight':'path'),angle:fit?fit.angle:0,rms:fit?fit.rms:0};}
    function mark(){occupied.clear();reserved.forEach(function(k){occupied.add(k);});result.forEach(function(r){r.path.forEach(function(p){occupied.add(gvProfilePointKey(p));});});}
    function add(path,kind){if(path.some(function(p){return occupied.has(gvProfilePointKey(p));})||!pathSafe(path))return false;result.push(describe(path,kind));path.forEach(function(p){occupied.add(gvProfilePointKey(p));});return true;}
    function free(){return points.filter(function(p){return !occupied.has(gvProfilePointKey(p))&&!blocked.has(p.index);}).sort(gvProfileNaturalPointCompare);}
    function fragments(line){
      const parts=[];let path=[];
      function flush(){if(path.length>=2&&path.some(function(p){return gvProfileDistance(p,path[0])>1e-7;}))parts.push(Object.assign({},line,{path:path}));path=[];}
      line.path.forEach(function(p){
        if(occupied.has(gvProfilePointKey(p))||blocked.has(p.index)){flush();return;}
        const expected=line.path.length>=3?gvProfilePathSpacing(line.path):0;
        if(path.length&&(!segmentSafe(path[path.length-1],p)||gvProfileDistance(path[path.length-1],p)>Math.max(ctx.limit(path[path.length-1],p)*1.25,expected*4.25)))flush();
        path.push(p);
      });flush();return parts;
    }
    let dominant=null;
    // Assign complete, geographically plausible collection runs first. No
    // straightness or global-axis test is used for a supported numbered path.
    // Occupied stations and unsafe edges break only the affected run; never
    // discard both safe portions of a long line because of one bad connector.
    continuity.routes.forEach(function(route){
      let part=[];
      function save(){
        if(part.length>=2){
          if(!add(part)){
            let safe=[];
            part.forEach(function(p){
              const trial=safe.concat([p]);
              if(trial.length>=2&&!pathSafe(trial)){if(safe.length>=2)add(safe);safe=[p];}
              else safe=trial;
            });
            if(safe.length>=2)add(safe);
          }
        }
        part=[];
      }
      route.forEach(function(p){
        if(occupied.has(gvProfilePointKey(p))||blocked.has(p.index)){save();return;}
        if(part.length&&!segmentSafe(part[part.length-1],p))save();part.push(p);
      });save();
    });
    if(result.length){
      const headings=result.filter(function(r){return r.kind==='straight';}).sort(function(a,b){return b.path.length-a.path.length;});
      if(headings.length)dominant=headings[0].angle;
    }
    // Parallel families compete on coverage and collection-sequence support,
    // not just longest-path length. Commit a family before its crossing rival.
    for(let iteration=0;iteration<points.length;iteration++){
      const choices=[];alternatives.forEach(function(line){fragments(line).forEach(function(part){choices.push(part);});});
      if(!choices.length)break;
      choices.sort(function(a,b){return (a.kind===b.kind?0:a.kind==='straight'?-1:1)||a.angle-b.angle||b.path.length-a.path.length;});
      const families=[];
      choices.forEach(function(line){let f=line.kind==='straight'?families.find(function(f){return f.kind==='straight'&&gvProfileAngleApart(f.angle,line.angle)<10;}):null;
        if(!f){f={angle:line.angle,kind:line.kind,keys:new Set(),sum:0,seq:0,squares:0};families.push(f);}
        line.path.forEach(function(p){f.keys.add(gvProfilePointKey(p));});const w=line.path.length-1;
        f.sum+=w;f.seq+=sequence.score(line.path)*w;f.squares+=line.path.length*line.path.length;line.family=f;
      });
      families.forEach(function(f){f.score=f.keys.size*(1+.55*f.seq/Math.max(1,f.sum))+
        Math.min(f.keys.size*.1,f.squares/Math.max(1,f.sum)*.15)+
        (dominant!=null&&f.kind==='straight'?f.keys.size*.35*Math.max(0,1-gvProfileAngleApart(f.angle,dominant)/25):0);});
      choices.sort(function(a,b){return b.family.score-a.family.score||b.path.length-a.path.length||sequence.score(b.path)-sequence.score(a.path)||a.rms-b.rms||gvProfileNaturalPointCompare(a.path[0],b.path[0]);});
      let found=false;
      for(const choice of choices){if(add(choice.path,choice.kind)){if(dominant==null&&choice.kind==='straight'&&choice.path.length>=3)dominant=choice.angle;found=true;break;}}
      if(!found)break;
    }
    function changedPathSafe(path,i){return pathSafe(path,new Set([i]));}
    // Attach missed/end stations first. Interior insertion replaces an edge;
    // it never reorders the existing geographical path by point number.
    function attachPass(relaxed){
      let count=0;
      for(const p of free()){
        if(ctx.isolated(p))continue;
        const proposals=[];
        result.forEach(function(r,i){
          const path=r.path,step=Math.max(ctx.local(p),gvProfilePathSpacing(path)||ctx.base),angleLimit=relaxed?(path.length===2?130:105):48;
          for(const front of [true,false]){
            const end=front?path[0]:path[path.length-1],next=front?path[1]:path[path.length-2],d=gvProfileDistance(p,end);
            const route=front?[p].concat(path):path.concat([p]),sequential=continuity.canJoin(route);
            if(d>(sequential?continuity.limit(p,end):ctx.limit(p,end))||(!sequential&&d>step*(relaxed?2.4:3.5)))continue;
            const bend=gvProfileBend(p,end,next);if(!sequential&&bend>angleLimit)continue;
            const fit=r.kind==='straight'?gvProfileFitAxis(path):null;
            if(!sequential&&!relaxed&&fit&&Math.abs(-(p.x-fit.x)*fit.uy+(p.y-fit.y)*fit.ux)>step*.65)continue;
            proposals.push({i:i,path:route,score:d/step+(sequential?bend/180-5:bend/40)-sequence.affinity(p,end)*2});
          }
          for(let k=1;k<path.length;k++){
            const a=path[k-1],b=path[k],ab=gvProfileDistance(a,b),ap=gvProfileDistance(a,p),pb=gvProfileDistance(p,b);
            if(ab<1e-7||ap>ctx.limit(a,p)||pb>ctx.limit(p,b))continue;
            const projection=((p.x-a.x)*(b.x-a.x)+(p.y-a.y)*(b.y-a.y))/(ab*ab);
            const lateral=Math.abs((p.x-a.x)*(b.y-a.y)-(p.y-a.y)*(b.x-a.x))/ab;
            if(projection<-.05||projection>1.05||lateral>step*(relaxed?1.05:.55)||(ap+pb-ab)>step*(relaxed?1.1:.55))continue;
            const route=path.slice(0,k).concat([p],path.slice(k));let maxBend=0;
            for(let j=Math.max(1,k-1);j<=Math.min(route.length-2,k+1);j++)maxBend=Math.max(maxBend,gvProfileBend(route[j-1],route[j],route[j+1]));
            if(maxBend>(relaxed?110:65))continue;
            proposals.push({i:i,path:route,score:(ap+pb-ab)/step+maxBend/55-.4*(sequence.affinity(a,p)+sequence.affinity(p,b))});
          }
        });
        proposals.sort(function(a,b){return a.score-b.score||a.i-b.i;});
        for(const q of proposals){if(changedPathSafe(q.path,q.i)){result[q.i]=describe(q.path);occupied.add(gvProfilePointKey(p));count++;break;}}
      }
      return count;
    }
    attachPass(false);attachPass(false);
    // Short residual sections are useful, even when they have just two points.
    // Prefer sequential, parallel neighbours; crossings are never introduced.
    function pairPass(){
      let count=0;const pool=free(),pairs=[];
      pool.forEach(function(p){(ctx.near.get(p.index)||[]).forEach(function(q){
        if(p.index>=q.p.index||occupied.has(gvProfilePointKey(q.p))||blocked.has(q.p.index)||q.d<1e-7||q.d>ctx.limit(p,q.p))return;
        const angle=(Math.atan2(q.p.y-p.y,q.p.x-p.x)*180/Math.PI+180)%180;
        pairs.push({a:p,b:q.p,score:q.d/Math.max(ctx.local(p),ctx.local(q.p))-.9*sequence.affinity(p,q.p)+(dominant==null?0:gvProfileAngleApart(angle,dominant)/60)});
      });});pairs.sort(function(a,b){return a.score-b.score||gvProfileNaturalPointCompare(a.a,b.a);});
      pairs.forEach(function(q){if(!occupied.has(gvProfilePointKey(q.a))&&!occupied.has(gvProfilePointKey(q.b))&&add([q.a,q.b],'straight'))count+=2;});return count;
    }
    pairPass();attachPass(false);attachPass(true);
    // A lone nearby station can share a short section with an endpoint of a
    // longer profile, provided the shortened original still has >=2 positions.
    // This last resort improves coverage without a zigzag or a crossing.
    for(const p of free()){
      if(ctx.isolated(p))continue;
      const choices=[];
      result.forEach(function(r,i){if(r.path.length<3)return;
        [0,r.path.length-1].forEach(function(k){const q=r.path[k],d=gvProfileDistance(p,q);if(d<1e-7||d>ctx.limit(p,q)||d>ctx.local(p)*2.5)return;
          const keep=k===0?r.path.slice(1):r.path.slice(0,-1),angle=(Math.atan2(q.y-p.y,q.x-p.x)*180/Math.PI+180)%180;
          choices.push({i:i,keep:keep,pair:[q,p],score:d/ctx.local(p)-sequence.affinity(p,q)*2+(continuity.canJoin(r.path)?4:0)+(dominant==null?0:gvProfileAngleApart(angle,dominant)/75)});
        });
      });choices.sort(function(a,b){return a.score-b.score||a.i-b.i;});
      for(const c of choices){
        if(!changedPathSafe(c.keep,c.i)||!changedPathSafe(c.pair,c.i))continue;
        let cross=false;for(let k=1;k<c.keep.length;k++)if(gvProfileSegmentsIntersect(c.pair[0],c.pair[1],c.keep[k-1],c.keep[k]))cross=true;
        if(cross)continue;
        result[c.i]=describe(c.keep);result.push(describe(c.pair,'straight'));mark();break;
      }
    }
    // Last coverage repair: split a long profile at a nearby station and
    // extend one half to the leftover point. Both halves retain >=2 stations.
    // Prefer this over a long hooked detour or silently labelling it isolated.
    for(const p of free()){
      if(ctx.isolated(p))continue;
      const choices=[];
      result.forEach(function(r,i){
        if(r.path.length<4)return;
        for(let k=2;k<=r.path.length-2;k++){
          const left=r.path.slice(0,k),right=r.path.slice(k);
          for(const useLeft of [true,false]){
            const q=useLeft?left[left.length-1]:right[0],near=useLeft?left[left.length-2]:right[1];
            const d=gvProfileDistance(p,q),bend=gvProfileBend(near,q,p);
            if(d<1e-7||d>ctx.limit(p,q)||d>ctx.local(p)*2.5||bend>88)continue;
            const changed=useLeft?left.concat([p]):[p].concat(right),kept=useLeft?right:left;
            choices.push({i:i,changed:changed,kept:kept,score:d/ctx.local(p)+bend/90-sequence.affinity(p,q)*2+(continuity.canJoin(r.path)?4:0)});
          }
        }
      });
      choices.sort(function(a,b){return a.score-b.score||a.i-b.i;});
      for(const c of choices){
        if(!changedPathSafe(c.changed,c.i)||!changedPathSafe(c.kept,c.i))continue;
        let cross=false;for(let i=1;i<c.changed.length;i++)for(let j=1;j<c.kept.length;j++)if(gvProfileSegmentsIntersect(c.changed[i-1],c.changed[i],c.kept[j-1],c.kept[j]))cross=true;
        if(cross)continue;
        result[c.i]=describe(c.changed);result.push(describe(c.kept));mark();break;
      }
    }
    pairPass();attachPass(false);
    // Sequence-backed fragments can join through elbows, kinks and curves.
    // Only unnumbered/weak-sequence joins need the conservative axis tests.
    // Use a fixed upper bound: result.length shrinks after every successful
    // merge, so it must not also shorten the number of remaining iterations.
    const mergeBudget=result.length;
    for(let round=0;round<mergeBudget;round++){
      let best=null;
      for(let i=0;i<result.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<result.length;j++){
        for(let fa=0;fa<2;fa++)for(let fb=0;fb<2;fb++){
          const a=fa?result[i].path.slice().reverse():result[i].path,b=fb?result[j].path.slice().reverse():result[j].path;
          const path=a.concat(b),x=a[a.length-1],y=b[0],d=gvProfileDistance(x,y),sequential=continuity.canJoin(path);
          if(d<1e-7||continuity.cut(x,y)||d>(sequential?continuity.limit(x,y):ctx.limit(x,y)))continue;
          const bendA=gvProfileBend(a[a.length-2],x,y),bendB=gvProfileBend(x,y,b[1]);
          if(!sequential){
            if(gvProfileAngleApart(result[i].angle,result[j].angle)>18||bendA>20||bendB>20)continue;
            const axis=gvProfileFitAxis(a),side=axis?Math.abs(-(y.x-x.x)*axis.uy+(y.y-x.y)*axis.ux):Infinity;
            if(side>Math.max(ctx.local(x),ctx.local(y))*.6)continue;
          }
          const score=d/ctx.base+(sequential?(bendA+bendB)/180-8:(bendA+bendB)/20)-sequence.affinity(x,y)*2;
          if((!best||score<best.score)&&pathSafe(path,new Set([i,j])))best={i:i,j:j,path:path,score:score};
        }
      }
      if(!best)break;result[best.i]=describe(best.path);result.splice(best.j,1);
    }
    mark();
    const output=result.map(function(r){return {indexes:r.path.map(function(p){return p.index;}),angle:r.angle,rms:r.rms,kind:r.kind,detectorVersion:5,sequenceScore:sequence.score(r.path)};})
      .sort(function(a,b){return gvProfileNaturalPointCompare(ctx.byIndex.get(a.indexes[0]),ctx.byIndex.get(b.indexes[0]));});
    output.diagnostics={isolated:[],constrained:[],reserved:[],assigned:[]};
    points.forEach(function(p){const k=gvProfilePointKey(p),name=String(p.point);
      if(reserved.has(k))output.diagnostics.reserved.push(name);
      else if(occupied.has(k))output.diagnostics.assigned.push(name);
      else if(!blocked.has(p.index)&&ctx.isolated(p))output.diagnostics.isolated.push(name);
      else output.diagnostics.constrained.push(name);
    });
    return output;
  }
  function gvProfileDetectGroupLines(scopes,baseSpacing,threshold,reservedKeys,reservedPaths){
    const occupied=new Set(reservedKeys||[]),boundaries=scopes.map(function(scope){return gvProfileBoundaryPolygon(scope.boundaryPoints||scope.points);}),lines=[],paths=(reservedPaths||[]).slice();
    const diagnostics={isolated:[],constrained:[],reserved:[],assigned:[]};
    scopes.forEach(function(scope,g){
      if(!scope.points.length)return;
      const spacing=gvProfileMedian(gvProfileNearestDistances(scope.points))||baseSpacing;
      if(!scope.candidates)scope.candidates=gvProfileDetectLineCandidates(scope.points,spacing,threshold);
      const found=gvProfileSelectExclusiveLines(scope.candidates,scope.points,occupied,boundaries.filter(function(_,j){return j!==g;}),{baseSpacing:spacing,threshold:threshold,reservedPaths:paths});
      const byIndex=new Map(scope.points.map(function(p){return [p.index,p];}));
      found.forEach(function(line){line.groupIndexes=scope.groupIndexes.slice();const path=line.indexes.map(function(i){return byIndex.get(i);});path.forEach(function(p){occupied.add(gvProfilePointKey(p));});paths.push(path);lines.push(line);});
      Object.keys(diagnostics).forEach(function(k){diagnostics[k].push.apply(diagnostics[k],found.diagnostics[k]);});
    });
    Object.keys(diagnostics).forEach(function(k){diagnostics[k]=Array.from(new Set(diagnostics[k]));});lines.diagnostics=diagnostics;
    return lines;
  }
  function gvProfileValidateLineSelections(store,data){
    const groups=gvProfileGroupDefinitions(store,data),owners=new Map(),issues=[],used=gvProfileReservedPointKeys(store,data,false),counts=new Map();
    groups.forEach(function(group,g){group.indexes.forEach(function(i){if(!owners.has(i))owners.set(i,[]);owners.get(i).push(g);});});
    data.forEach(function(row){if(row){const key=String(row[0]).trim();counts.set(key,(counts.get(key)||0)+1);}});
    const geo=[];
    data.forEach(function(row,index){if(!row||row[1]==null||row[2]==null||row[1]===''||row[2]==='')return;const lat=Number(row[1]),lon=Number(row[2]);if(Number.isFinite(lat)&&Number.isFinite(lon))geo.push({index:index,lat:lat,lon:lon});});
    const lat0=geo.length?geo.reduce(function(s,p){return s+p.lat;},0)/geo.length:0,lon0=geo.length?geo.reduce(function(s,p){return s+p.lon;},0)/geo.length:0;
    const sx=Math.max(1000,111320*Math.cos(lat0*Math.PI/180)),byIndex=new Map();
    geo.forEach(function(p){p.x=(p.lon-lon0)*sx;p.y=(p.lat-lat0)*111320;byIndex.set(p.index,p);});
    const boundaries=groups.map(function(group){return gvProfileBoundaryPolygon(group.indexes.map(function(i){return byIndex.get(i);}).filter(Boolean));});
    (store.shared||[]).filter(function(s){return s.source==='auto-line';}).forEach(function(line){
      const indexes=gvProfileSelectionIndexes(line,data),name=String(line.name||'Line');
      const groupIds=indexes.map(function(i){return owners.get(i)||[];});
      if(indexes.length<2||groupIds.some(function(ids){return ids.length!==1;})||groupIds.some(function(ids){return ids[0]!==groupIds[0][0];})){
        issues.push(name+' does not stay within a single unambiguous group.');
      }
      indexes.forEach(function(i){const key=String(data[i][0]).trim();if(used.has(key))issues.push('Point '+key+' occurs in more than one line.');if(counts.get(key)>1)issues.push('Point '+key+' has an ambiguous duplicate identity.');used.add(key);});
      const rank=new Map((line.pathPoints||[]).map(function(p,i){return [String(p).trim(),i];}));
      const ordered=indexes.slice().sort(function(a,b){return (rank.get(String(data[a][0]).trim())??a)-(rank.get(String(data[b][0]).trim())??b);});
      if(ordered.some(function(i){return !byIndex.has(i);})){issues.push(name+' contains a point without valid coordinates.');return;}
      const own=groupIds.length&&groupIds[0].length===1?groupIds[0][0]:-1;
      for(let n=1;n<ordered.length;n++){
        if(boundaries.some(function(poly,g){return g!==own&&gvProfileSegmentCrossesBoundary(byIndex.get(ordered[n-1]),byIndex.get(ordered[n]),poly);})){issues.push(name+' crosses another group boundary.');break;}
      }
    });
    const tracks=(store.shared||[]).filter(gvProfileIsLineSelection).map(function(item){
      const ids=gvProfileSelectionIndexes(item,data),rank=new Map((item.pathPoints||[]).map(function(p,i){return [String(p).trim(),i];}));
      let path=ids.map(function(i){return byIndex.get(i);}).filter(Boolean);
      if(rank.size)path.sort(function(a,b){return (rank.get(String(data[a.index][0]).trim())??1e12)-(rank.get(String(data[b.index][0]).trim())??1e12);});
      else {const fit=gvProfileFitAxis(path);if(fit)path.sort(function(a,b){return (a.x-b.x)*fit.ux+(a.y-b.y)*fit.uy;});}
      const distinct=[];path.forEach(function(p){if(!distinct.length||gvProfileDistance(p,distinct[distinct.length-1])>1e-7)distinct.push(p);});
      return {name:String(item.name||'Line'),path:distinct,isNew:item.source==='auto-line'&&Number(item.detectorVersion)>=4};
    });
    tracks.forEach(function(track,i){
      if(track.isNew){
        if(track.path.length<2)issues.push(track.name+' does not contain two distinct positions.');
        for(let a=1;a<track.path.length;a++)for(let b=1;b<a-1;b++)if(gvProfileSegmentsIntersect(track.path[a-1],track.path[a],track.path[b-1],track.path[b]))issues.push(track.name+' intersects itself.');
      }
      for(let j=0;j<i;j++){
        const other=tracks[j];if(!track.isNew&&!other.isNew)continue;
        for(let a=1;a<track.path.length;a++)for(let b=1;b<other.path.length;b++)if(gvProfileSegmentsIntersect(track.path[a-1],track.path[a],other.path[b-1],other.path[b]))issues.push(track.name+' intersects '+other.name+'.');
      }
    });
    return Array.from(new Set(issues));
  }

  function gvProfileExistingSelectionSignature(item,data){
    let points=Array.isArray(item&&item.points)?item.points.map(String):[];
    if(!points.length)points=(Array.isArray(item&&item.data)?item.data:[]).map(Number).filter(Number.isInteger).map(function(i){return data[i]&&data[i][0]!=null?String(data[i][0]):'';}).filter(Boolean);
    return points.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.localeCompare(b,undefined,{numeric:true,sensitivity:'base'});}).join('|');
  }
  function gvProfileBuildSelectionUpdate(original,groups,lines,data,replaceLines){
    const saved=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(original||{shared:[]}));
    if(!Array.isArray(saved.shared))saved.shared=[];
    const oldLines=saved.shared.filter(function(s){return s.source==='auto-line';});
    if(replaceLines)saved.shared=saved.shared.filter(function(s){return s.source!=='auto-line';});
    const used=new Set(saved.shared.map(function(s){return String(s.name||'').trim().toLowerCase();}));
    const bySignature=new Map();
    oldLines.forEach(function(s){const sig=gvProfileExistingSelectionSignature(s,data);if(!bySignature.has(sig))bySignature.set(sig,s);});
    const signatureFor=function(indexes){return indexes.map(function(i){return String(data[i][0]);}).sort(function(a,b){return a.localeCompare(b,undefined,{numeric:true,sensitivity:'base'});}).join('|');};
    const reserved=new Map();
    if(replaceLines)lines.forEach(function(line){
      const sig=signatureFor(line.indexes),old=bySignature.get(sig),name=old&&String(old.name||'').trim();
      if(name&&!used.has(name.toLowerCase())){used.add(name.toLowerCase());reserved.set(sig,name);}
    });
    function nextName(prefix){let n=1;while(used.has((prefix+' '+n).toLowerCase()))n++;const name=prefix+' '+n;used.add(name.toLowerCase());return name;}
    function order(a,b){return String(data[a][0]).localeCompare(String(data[b][0]),undefined,{numeric:true,sensitivity:'base'})||a-b;}
    const groupSigs=new Set(saved.shared.filter(function(s){return s.source==='auto-group';}).map(function(s){return gvProfileExistingSelectionSignature(s,data);}));
    const lineSigs=new Set(saved.shared.filter(function(s){return s.source==='auto-line';}).map(function(s){return gvProfileExistingSelectionSignature(s,data);}));
    let groupsAdded=0,linesAdded=0;
    groups.forEach(function(group){
      const indexes=group.map(function(p){return p.index;}).sort(order),sig=signatureFor(indexes);
      if(groupSigs.has(sig))return;
      groupSigs.add(sig);groupsAdded++;
      saved.shared.push({name:nextName('Group'),data:indexes,points:indexes.map(function(i){return String(data[i][0]);}),source:'auto-group',savedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
    });
    const groupNames=new Map(saved.shared.filter(gvProfileIsGroupSelection).map(function(item){return [signatureFor(gvProfileSelectionIndexes(item,data)),item.name];}));
    lines.forEach(function(line){
      const indexes=line.indexes.slice().sort(order),sig=signatureFor(indexes);
      if(lineSigs.has(sig))return;
      lineSigs.add(sig);linesAdded++;
      saved.shared.push({name:reserved.get(sig)||nextName('Line'),data:indexes,points:indexes.map(function(i){return String(data[i][0]);}),
        pathPoints:line.indexes.map(function(i){return String(data[i][0]);}),profileKind:line.kind||'straight',detectorVersion:5,profileSequenceScore:Number(line.sequenceScore)||0,
        profileGroup:groupNames.get(signatureFor(line.groupIndexes||[]))||'',
        source:'auto-line',savedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
    });
    // This runs on a clone, before any database/cache write. Never persist a
    // cross-group or duplicate-point automatic line, even in append mode.
    const issues=gvProfileValidateLineSelections(saved,data);
    if(issues.length)throw new Error('Automatic lines were not saved: '+issues[0]+' Rebuild Automatic Lines to replace incompatible older lines.');
    function fingerprint(items){return JSON.stringify(items.map(function(s){return {name:s.name,points:s.points||[],data:s.data||[],pathPoints:s.pathPoints||[],detectorVersion:s.detectorVersion||0,profileGroup:s.profileGroup||''};}).sort(function(a,b){return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);}));}
    const changed=replaceLines&&oldLines.length>0&&fingerprint(oldLines)!==fingerprint(saved.shared.filter(function(s){return s.source==='auto-line';}));
    if(changed){
      if(!Array.isArray(saved.autoLineHistory))saved.autoLineHistory=[];
      saved.autoLineHistory.push({id:'profiles-'+Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8),savedAt:new Date().toISOString(),reason:'Before sequence-first continuous-profile rebuild',lines:oldLines});
    }
    if(replaceLines&&(oldLines.length||lines.length))saved.autoLineRevision='continuous-v5-'+Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8);
    return {store:saved,groupsAdded:groupsAdded,linesAdded:linesAdded,replaced:changed?oldLines.length:0};
  }
  async function gvProfileCommitSelections(saved,target,contextKey){
    if(window.BoxData!==target||gvPointSelectionProjectKey()!==contextKey)throw new Error('The report points or selections changed while the dialog was open. No selections were replaced. Run Create Profiles again.');
    const issues=gvProfileValidateLineSelections(saved,getResultData());
    if(issues.length)throw new Error(issues[0]);
    syncStore(saved,true);
    if(typeof window.RefreshSelectionDropdownLists==='function')window.RefreshSelectionDropdownLists();
    updateStatus('Profile selections updated. Use Save Report to keep these changes in a new HTML file.');
    refreshOverlay();
  }
  function updateStatus(text){const el=byId('gvReportProfilesStatus');if(el)el.textContent=text;}
  function gvResultsShowModal(options){
    return new Promise(resolve=>{
      const previous=document.activeElement,overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.id='gvReportProfilesDialog';overlay.className='gv-report-profiles-modal';
      overlay.setAttribute('role','dialog');overlay.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');overlay.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','gvReportProfilesTitle');
      overlay.innerHTML='<section class="gv-report-profiles-card"><header><h3 id="gvReportProfilesTitle">'+esc(options.title)+'</h3><p>'+esc(options.kicker||'')+'</p></header><div class="gv-report-profiles-body">'+(options.body||'')+'</div><footer></footer></section>';
      let closed=false;const footer=overlay.querySelector('footer');
      function close(value){if(closed)return;closed=true;document.removeEventListener('keydown',onKey,true);overlay.remove();if(previous&&previous.isConnected)previous.focus();resolve(value);}
      (options.buttons||[{label:'Close',value:'close'}]).forEach(item=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=item.label;b.dataset.action=item.value;b.className=item.className||'';b.onclick=()=>close(item.value);footer.appendChild(b);});
      function onKey(e){
        if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();close('cancel');return;}
        if(e.key!=='Tab')return;
        const focusable=Array.from(overlay.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled]),summary,[tabindex="0"]'));const first=focusable[0],last=focusable[focusable.length-1];
        if(e.shiftKey&&(document.activeElement===first||!overlay.contains(document.activeElement))){e.preventDefault();last.focus();}
        else if(!e.shiftKey&&(document.activeElement===last||!overlay.contains(document.activeElement))){e.preventDefault();first.focus();}
      }
      document.body.appendChild(overlay);document.addEventListener('keydown',onKey,true);setTimeout(()=>{const first=footer.querySelector('button');if(first)first.focus();},0);
    });
  }
  async function gvProfileRestorePreviousLines(original,target,key){
    const saved=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(original)),history=saved.autoLineHistory||[],last=history[history.length-1];
    if(!last||!Array.isArray(last.lines)){alert('No previous automatic line selections are available.');return;}
    const current=saved.shared.filter(function(s){return s.source==='auto-line';});
    saved.shared=saved.shared.filter(function(s){return s.source!=='auto-line';});
    const used=new Set(saved.shared.map(function(s){return String(s.name||'').trim().toLowerCase();}));
    last.lines.forEach(function(old){
      const line=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(old));
      if(used.has(String(line.name||'').trim().toLowerCase())){let n=1;while(used.has(('Line '+n).toLowerCase()))n++;line.name='Line '+n;}
      used.add(String(line.name).trim().toLowerCase());saved.shared.push(line);
    });
    const issues=gvProfileValidateLineSelections(saved,getResultData());
    if(issues.length){
      alert('These previous lines cannot be made active because they do not meet the current group-boundary and one-line-per-point rules. '+issues[0]+' The backup has been kept unchanged. Use Rebuild Automatic Lines instead.');
      return;
    }
    saved.autoLineRevision='restore-v5-'+Date.now();
    history.push({id:'profiles-restore-'+Date.now(),savedAt:new Date().toISOString(),reason:'Before restoring previous automatic lines',lines:current});
    await gvProfileCommitSelections(saved,target,key);
    alert('Restored '+last.lines.length+' previous automatic line selections. Groups, manual selections and project measurements were not changed.');
  }
  function gvProfileCoverageReport(points,lines,retainedKeys){
    const assigned=new Set(),retained=new Set(retainedKeys||[]),diagnostics=lines.diagnostics||{};
    const byIndex=new Map(points.map(function(p){return [p.index,p];}));
    lines.forEach(function(line){line.indexes.forEach(function(i){const p=byIndex.get(i);if(p)assigned.add(gvProfilePointKey(p));});});
    const isolated=new Set(diagnostics.isolated||[]),constrained=[],isolatedNames=[];
    let existing=0;const context=gvProfileCoverageContext(points);
    points.forEach(function(p){
      const key=gvProfilePointKey(p);if(assigned.has(key))return;if(retained.has(key)){existing++;return;}
      if(isolated.has(String(p.point))||context.isolated(p))isolatedNames.push(String(p.point));else constrained.push(String(p.point));
    });
    const covered=points.filter(function(p){return assigned.has(gvProfilePointKey(p))||retained.has(gvProfilePointKey(p));}).length;
    function details(title,names){return names.length?'<details class="gv-status-note"><summary>'+esc(title+' ('+names.length+')')+'</summary><div style="max-height:160px;overflow:auto;overflow-wrap:anywhere;padding-top:6px">'+esc(names.join(', '))+'</div></details>':'';}
    return {covered:covered,total:points.length,html:'<div class="gv-status-note"><strong>Line coverage: '+covered+' of '+points.length+' included points with valid coordinates.</strong> '+assigned.size+' assigned to new profiles'+(existing?'; '+existing+' already in retained lines':'')+'.</div>'+
      details('Isolated points - no neighbour within the local spacing limit',isolatedNames)+
      details('Needs review - group, identity, crossing or path constraints',constrained)+
      (constrained.length?'<div class="gv-status-note">These nearby points could not be safely connected without breaking the group, unique-point or non-crossing rules. They are not classified as isolated and their data is unchanged.</div>':'')};
  }
  async function gvCreateProfilesFromCurrentProject(){
    const button=document.getElementById('gvCreateProfiles'),oldText=button&&button.textContent,target=window.BoxData,key=gvPointSelectionProjectKey();
    try{
      const data=getResultData(),points=gvProfileProjectPoints();
      if(points.length<2){alert('At least two included project points with valid coordinates are required to create profiles.');return;}
      if(button){button.disabled=true;button.textContent='Finding Sequential Profiles...';}
      await new Promise(function(resolve){setTimeout(resolve,20);});
      const nearest=gvProfileNearestDistances(points),medianNN=gvProfileMedian(nearest)||25;
      const sortedNN=nearest.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}),q75=sortedNN.length?sortedNN[Math.min(sortedNN.length-1,Math.floor((sortedNN.length-1)*.75))]:medianNN;
      const groupThreshold=Math.max(5,Math.min(3000,Math.max(medianNN*2.75,q75*2.15)));
      let groups=gvProfileConnectedGroups(points,groupThreshold).filter(function(group){return group.length>=2;});
      if(!groups.length)groups=[points.slice()];
      groups.sort(function(a,b){const ap=Math.min.apply(null,a.map(function(p){const n=Number(p.point);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;}));const bp=Math.min.apply(null,b.map(function(p){const n=Number(p.point);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;}));return ap-bp;});
      const original=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(gvLoadSavedSelections())),oldLines=(original.shared||[]).filter(function(s){return s.source==='auto-line';});
      const resolved=gvProfileResolveGroupScopes(points,groups,original,data,groupThreshold);
      let lines=gvProfileDetectGroupLines(resolved.scopes,medianNN,groupThreshold,gvProfileReservedPointKeys(original,data,false),gvProfileSavedLinePaths(original,data,points,false));
      if(gvPointSelectionProjectKey()!==key||window.BoxData!==target)throw new Error('The selected project changed. Please run Create Profiles again.');
      let replace=true;
      if(oldLines.length||(original.autoLineHistory||[]).length){
        const oldIssues=gvProfileValidateLineSelections(original,data);
        const buttons=[{label:'Rebuild Automatic Lines',value:'replace'}];
        if(!oldIssues.length)buttons.push({label:'Add Without Replacing',value:'append'});
        if((original.autoLineHistory||[]).length)buttons.push({label:'Restore Previous Lines',value:'restore',className:'gv-secondary-button'});
        buttons.push({label:'Cancel',value:'cancel',className:'gv-secondary-button'});
        const choice=await gvResultsShowModal({title:'Update Automatic Profiles',kicker:lines.length+' group-contained, sequence-first line profiles detected.',
          body:'<div class="gv-status-note"><strong>Each line stays inside one group. Each point belongs to at most one generated line.</strong> Point-number sequence now takes priority when connecting nearby stations. Bends, kinks and curves do not by themselves split a profile. Clear parallel-row resets remain separate; intersections, occupied points and group boundaries are still protected.</div><div class="gv-status-note">Rebuild replaces only the '+oldLines.length+' previous <strong>automatically generated lines</strong>. Your groups, manually saved selections, point data and measurements are preserved. The previous automatic lines are backed up with this project.</div>'+
            gvProfileCoverageReport(points,lines,gvProfileReservedPointKeys(original,data,false)).html+
            (oldIssues.length?'<div class="gv-status-note"><strong>Older lines violate the new rules:</strong> '+esc(oldIssues[0])+' Rebuild is required; adding alongside them would retain those conflicts.</div>':'<div class="gv-status-note">Add Without Replacing only uses points that are not already assigned to a saved line.</div>')+
            (!lines.length?'<div class="gv-status-note"><strong>No valid new lines were found. Rebuild will remove previous automatic lines from the active selection list, retaining their backup. Cancel to leave everything unchanged.</strong></div>':''),buttons:buttons});
        if(!choice||choice==='cancel')return;
        if(choice==='restore'){await gvProfileRestorePreviousLines(original,target,key);return;}
        replace=choice==='replace';
        if(!replace)lines=gvProfileDetectGroupLines(resolved.scopes,medianNN,groupThreshold,gvProfileReservedPointKeys(original,data,true),gvProfileSavedLinePaths(original,data,points,true));
      }
      const update=gvProfileBuildSelectionUpdate(original,resolved.groupsToAdd,lines,data,replace);
      await gvProfileCommitSelections(update.store,target,key);
      const msg='Created '+update.groupsAdded+' new group selection(s) and '+update.linesAdded+' line selection(s).'+(update.replaced?' Replaced '+update.replaced+' previous automatic line(s); their backup is retained in this project.':'')+' Existing groups and manual selections were preserved.';
      const coverage=gvProfileCoverageReport(points,lines,gvProfileReservedPointKeys(original,data,!replace));
      await gvResultsShowModal({title:'Profiles Created',kicker:'Sequence-first continuous profiles. '+coverage.covered+' / '+coverage.total+' included points covered.',body:'<div class="gv-status-note">'+esc(msg)+'</div>'+coverage.html+'<div class="gv-status-note">Nearby stations are connected primarily in point-number order. Bends, kinks and curves remain continuous; clear changes to another parallel row remain separate. Coordinates define the actual path, and short two-point sections are allowed where needed. New automatic lines never share a point, cross another line or enter another group.</div>'+
        (resolved.ambiguousCount?'<div class="gv-status-note">'+resolved.ambiguousCount+' point(s) were left out of automatic lines because their group membership or point identity is ambiguous. The points and their data were not changed.</div>':'')+
        '<div class="gv-status-note">An isolated point is not forced into a distant line. Any other unassigned point is explicitly listed for review. Existing groups and all measurements are unchanged. Review the group/line map overlay before using inferred profiles. Use Save Report to retain the selections and backup history in a new HTML file.</div>',buttons:[{label:'Close',value:'close'}]});
    }catch(e){console.error('Create Profiles failed',e);alert('Unable to create profile selections: '+(e&&e.message?e.message:e));}
    finally{if(button){button.disabled=false;button.textContent=oldText||'Create Profiles';}}
  }

  let overlayLayer=null,overlayMap=null,overlayTimer=null;
  function clearOverlay(){
    if(window.GV_CARTO)GV_CARTO.clearLegend(overlayMap||window.map1);
    if(overlayLayer){try{overlayLayer.clearLayers();if(overlayMap)overlayMap.removeLayer(overlayLayer);}catch(e){console.warn('Could not clear profile overlays',e);}}
    overlayLayer=null;overlayMap=null;
  }
  function validRow(row){return !!row&&row[1]!=null&&row[2]!=null&&String(row[1]).trim()!==''&&String(row[2]).trim()!==''&&Number.isFinite(Number(row[1]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(row[2]))&&Math.abs(Number(row[1]))<=90&&Math.abs(Number(row[2]))<=180;}
  function pointFor(row,index){return {lat:Number(row[1]),lon:Number(row[2]),point:key(row),index:index};}
  function selectionPayload(){
    const rows=getResultData(),store=captureSelections(),groups=[],lines=[];
    if(window.GV_CARTO)syncStore(store,true);
    store.shared.forEach(item=>{
      const selected=rowsForSelection(item,rows).filter(validRow);
      if(gvProfileIsGroupSelection(item)){
        // Keep its full saved boundary when some stations are excluded, just as
        // group-scoped detection does. Hide groups with no included stations.
        if(selected.some(gvIsPointIncluded))groups.push({name:item.name,color:item.mapColor,points:selected.map(pointFor)});
      }else if(gvProfileIsLineSelection(item)){
        let run=[];const runs=[];
        // Do not fabricate a segment across a hidden or invalid station.
        rowsForSelection(item,rows).forEach(row=>{if(validRow(row)&&gvIsPointIncluded(row))run.push(pointFor(row));else{if(run.length>=2)runs.push(run);run=[];}});
        if(run.length>=2)runs.push(run);
        if(runs.length)lines.push({name:item.name,color:item.mapColor,runs:runs});
      }
    });
    return {groups,lines};
  }
  function groupPolygon(points){
    const lat0=points.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.lat,0)/points.length,lon0=points.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.lon,0)/points.length;
    const sx=Math.max(1000,111320*Math.cos(lat0*Math.PI/180));
    const hull=gvProfileBoundaryPolygon(points.map(p=>({x:(p.lon-lon0)*sx,y:(p.lat-lat0)*111320})));
    return hull.map(p=>[lat0+p.y/111320,lon0+p.x/sx]);
  }
  function addLabel(layer,latlng,name,type,color){
    L.tooltip({permanent:true,direction:type==='line'?'bottom':'center',offset:type==='line'?[0,6]:[0,0],opacity:1,interactive:false,className:'gv-report-profile-label gv-report-profile-'+type+'-label'})
      .setLatLng(latlng).setContent('<span style="color:'+esc(color||'#ffffff')+'">'+esc(name)+'</span>').addTo(layer);
  }
  function addArrow(layer,points,color){
    const end=points[points.length-1];let prev=points.length-2;
    while(prev>=0&&points[prev].lat===end.lat&&points[prev].lon===end.lon)prev--;
    if(prev<0)return;
    const a=points[prev],p1=a.lat*Math.PI/180,p2=end.lat*Math.PI/180,dl=(end.lon-a.lon)*Math.PI/180;
    const angle=(Math.atan2(Math.sin(dl)*Math.cos(p2),Math.cos(p1)*Math.sin(p2)-Math.sin(p1)*Math.cos(p2)*Math.cos(dl))*180/Math.PI+360)%360;
    const html='<div class="gv-report-profile-arrow" style="transform:rotate('+angle.toFixed(2)+'deg)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" style="stroke:'+esc(color||'#ffd84a')+'!important"><path d="M12 21V4 M5.5 10.5 12 4l6.5 6.5"/></svg></div>';
    L.marker([end.lat,end.lon],{interactive:false,zIndexOffset:1000,icon:L.divIcon({className:'gv-report-profile-arrow-icon',html:html,iconSize:[25,25],iconAnchor:[12.5,12.5]})}).addTo(layer);
  }
  function renderOverlay(){
    clearOverlay();const cb=byId('ShowLines-checkbox');window.SiteMapShowLines=!!(cb&&cb.checked);
    if(!cb||!cb.checked||!window.L||!window.map1||typeof map1.addLayer!=='function')return;
    const payload=selectionPayload();overlayMap=map1;overlayLayer=L.layerGroup().addTo(map1);
    payload.groups.forEach(group=>{
      const polygon=groupPolygon(group.points);if(polygon.length<3)return;
      L.polygon(polygon,{color:group.color,weight:2,opacity:1,fill:true,fillColor:group.color,fillOpacity:.30,interactive:false}).addTo(overlayLayer);
      addLabel(overlayLayer,[polygon.reduce((s,p)=>s+p[0],0)/polygon.length,polygon.reduce((s,p)=>s+p[1],0)/polygon.length],group.name,'group',group.color);
    });
    payload.lines.forEach(line=>{
      line.runs.forEach(points=>L.polyline(points.map(p=>[p.lat,p.lon]),{color:line.color,weight:3,opacity:1,interactive:false,lineCap:'round',lineJoin:'round'}).addTo(overlayLayer));
      const longest=line.runs.reduce((a,b)=>a.length>=b.length?a:b),mid=longest[Math.floor((longest.length-1)/2)];
      addLabel(overlayLayer,[mid.lat,mid.lon],line.name,'line',line.color);addArrow(overlayLayer,line.runs[line.runs.length-1],line.color);
    });
    if(window.GV_CARTO)GV_CARTO.showLegend(map1,payload);
    if(!payload.groups.length&&!payload.lines.length)updateStatus('No saved groups or lines are available. Save a named section/profile selection or use Create Profiles.');
  }
  function refreshOverlay(){if(overlayTimer)clearTimeout(overlayTimer);overlayTimer=setTimeout(()=>{overlayTimer=null;renderOverlay();},50);}
  function toggleOverlay(){
    const state=boxData().geovueReportTransferState||(boxData().geovueReportTransferState={version:3});
    state.reportProfilesOverlayVisible=!!byId('ShowLines-checkbox')?.checked;renderOverlay();
  }
  function orderedSelectedSnapshot(listId){
    const list=byId(listId),active=window.BoxData&&BoxData.data||[],master=getResultData();
    const wanted=new Set(list?Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]:checked')).map(cb=>active[Number(cb.value)]).filter(Boolean).map(key):[]);
    let selected=[];
    if(listId==='checkboxList')selected=window.SectionBoxData||[];
    else if(listId==='ContourcheckboxList')selected=window.ContourBoxData||[];
    else if(listId==='ModelcheckboxList')selected=window.ModelBoxData||[];
    else {const slot=['ProfilecheckboxListOne','ProfilecheckboxListTwo','ProfilecheckboxListThree'].indexOf(listId);selected=slot>=0&&window.ProfileBoxData?ProfileBoxData[slot]||[]:[];}
    const points=Array.from(new Set(selected.map(key).filter(p=>wanted.has(p)).concat(Array.from(wanted))));
    const indexes=points.map(p=>master.findIndex(r=>key(r)===p)).filter(i=>i>=0);
    return {indexes,points,pointCount:master.length};
  }
  function safeJSON(value){return JSON.stringify(value).replace(/</g,'\\u003c').replace(/>/g,'\\u003e').replace(/&/g,'\\u0026').replace(/\u2028/g,'\\u2028').replace(/\u2029/g,'\\u2029');}
  function buildHtml(){
    if(typeof window.GV_CAPTURE_REPORT_STATE==='function')window.GV_CAPTURE_REPORT_STATE();
    syncStore(captureSelections(),false);
    const state=boxData().geovueReportTransferState||(boxData().geovueReportTransferState={version:3});state.reportProfilesOverlayVisible=!!byId('ShowLines-checkbox')?.checked;
    const el=byId('gvReportSaveTemplate');if(!el)throw new Error('The local report template is missing. No report was saved.');
    const encoded=el.textContent.trim(),binary=atob(encoded),bytes=new Uint8Array(binary.length);for(let i=0;i<binary.length;i++)bytes[i]=binary.charCodeAt(i);
    let text=new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
    const values={BoxData:boxData(),selectionPointArray:nativeSelections(),
      plotDataStorage1:typeof plotDataStorage1==='undefined'?[]:plotDataStorage1,
      plotDataStorage2:typeof plotDataStorage2==='undefined'?[]:plotDataStorage2,
      plotDataStorage3:typeof plotDataStorage3==='undefined'?[]:plotDataStorage3,
      plotDataStorage4:typeof plotDataStorage4==='undefined'?[]:plotDataStorage4,
      plotDataStorage5:typeof plotDataStorage5==='undefined'?[]:plotDataStorage5,
      ExternalDataArray:typeof ExternalDataArray==='undefined'?[]:ExternalDataArray,
      WellD:typeof WellD==='undefined'?152.4:WellD,CaseDepth:typeof CaseDepth==='undefined'?0:CaseDepth,
      ScreenDepth:typeof ScreenDepth==='undefined'?10000:ScreenDepth,
      GlobalTemperature:typeof GlobalTemperature==='undefined'?25:GlobalTemperature,
      GradientDirectionArray:typeof GradientDirectionArray==='undefined'?[]:GradientDirectionArray};
    Object.keys(values).forEach(name=>{const marker='/*GV_REPORT_PAYLOAD_'+name+'*/';if(!text.includes(marker))throw new Error('Missing report data slot: '+name);text=text.replace(marker,()=>safeJSON(values[name]));});
    const marker='__GV_PROFILE_TEMPLATE_'+'BODY__';if(!text.includes(marker))throw new Error('The report template is incomplete.');
    text=text.replace(marker,()=>encoded);
    return text;
  }
  function saveReport(){
    const html=buildHtml(),blob=new Blob([html],{type:'text/html;charset=utf-8'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');
    a.href=url;a.download='SavedReport.html';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),2000);
    updateStatus('Saved report prepared with all points, saved groups, ordered lines and automatic-line backup history.');
  }
  let busy=false;
  async function createProfiles(){if(busy)return;busy=true;try{await gvCreateProfilesFromCurrentProject();}finally{busy=false;}}
  function installManualSelectionSavers(){
    // Replace the legacy row-only save functions with equivalent saves that also
    // retain the selection's purpose and travel order. Clone the array so later
    // point-picker edits cannot change a previously saved line by reference.
    const definitions=[
      ['ContoursaveSelection','ContourSelectionName','maps',()=>window.ContourBoxData||[]],
      ['SectionsaveSelection','SectionSelectionName','sections',()=>window.SectionBoxData||[]],
      ['ProfileOnesaveSelection','ProfileOneSelectionName','profilesOne',()=>window.ProfileBoxData&&ProfileBoxData[0]||[]],
      ['ProfileTwosaveSelection','ProfileTwoSelectionName','profilesTwo',()=>window.ProfileBoxData&&ProfileBoxData[1]||[]],
      ['ProfileThreesaveSelection','ProfileThreeSelectionName','profilesThree',()=>window.ProfileBoxData&&ProfileBoxData[2]||[]],
      ['ModelsaveSelection','ModelSelectionName','models',()=>window.ModelBoxData||[]]
    ];
    definitions.forEach(([fn,inputId,source,readRows])=>{
      window[fn]=function(){
        const input=byId(inputId),name=String(input&&input.value||'');
        if(!name.trim()){alert('Please provide a name for the selection.');return;}
        const selected=readRows().filter(Array.isArray).slice();
        if(!selected.length){alert('Please select at least one point before saving.');return;}
        const item={name:name,data:selected,source:source,savedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
        if(source==='sections'||source.indexOf('profiles')===0){
          item.manualLine=true;item.reportLine=true;item.selectionKind='line';item.profileKind='path';
          item.pathPoints=Array.from(new Set(selected.map(key).filter(Boolean)));
        }else{
          // Known area selections are not legacy untyped line selections.
          item.selectionKind=/^line(?:\b|\d)/i.test(name.trim())?'line':'area';
        }
        nativeSelections().push(item);
        if(typeof window.RefreshSelectionDropdownLists==='function')window.RefreshSelectionDropdownLists();
        else{syncStore(captureSelections(),false);refreshOverlay();}
        if(input)input.value='';
      };
    });
  }
  function install(){
    hydrateSelections();
    installManualSelectionSavers();
    const button=byId('gvCreateProfiles');if(button)button.addEventListener('click',createProfiles);
    const cb=byId('ShowLines-checkbox');if(cb){const state=boxData().geovueReportTransferState||{};if(typeof state.reportProfilesOverlayVisible==='boolean')cb.checked=state.reportProfilesOverlayVisible;}
    window.AutoLineCreate=createProfiles;
    window.toggleSiteMapShowLines=toggleOverlay;
    // The checkbox controls ALL stored profiles, not just the last section loaded.
    window.generateSiteMapLines=refreshOverlay;window.generateSiteMapProfileLines=refreshOverlay;
    const originalDropdowns=window.RefreshSelectionDropdownLists;
    if(typeof originalDropdowns==='function')window.RefreshSelectionDropdownLists=function(){
      const selects=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('select[id$="SelectionDropdown"]')),chosen=selects.map(s=>s.value);
      if(!hydrating)syncStore(captureSelections(),false);
      const result=originalDropdowns.apply(this,arguments);
      selects.forEach((s,i)=>{if(Array.from(s.options).some(o=>o.value===chosen[i]))s.value=chosen[i];});refreshOverlay();return result;
    };
    ['updateSiteMap','refreshSiteMap','generateSiteMapWaypoints','UpdatePointData'].forEach(name=>{
      const original=window[name];if(typeof original!=='function')return;
      window[name]=function(){const result=original.apply(this,arguments);if(result&&typeof result.then==='function')return result.finally(refreshOverlay);refreshOverlay();return result;};
    });
    window.addEventListener('geovue-report-point-inclusion-change',refreshOverlay);
    window.addEventListener('geovue-profile-selections-changed',refreshOverlay);
    window.addEventListener('load',refreshOverlay,{once:true});
    if(typeof window.RefreshSelectionDropdownLists==='function')window.RefreshSelectionDropdownLists();
    refreshOverlay();
  }
  window.GV_REPORT_PROFILES_V5={version:5,createProfiles,refreshOverlay,renderOverlay,clearOverlay,captureSelections,orderedSelectedSnapshot,buildHtml,saveReport,
    getOverlayPayload:selectionPayload,getData:getResultData,
    geometry:{median:gvProfileMedian,nearest:gvProfileNearestDistances,groups:gvProfileConnectedGroups,resolveGroups:gvProfileResolveGroupScopes,
      detectLines:gvProfileDetectGroupLines,reserved:gvProfileReservedPointKeys,savedPaths:gvProfileSavedLinePaths,buildUpdate:gvProfileBuildSelectionUpdate,
      validate:gvProfileValidateLineSelections,projectPoints:gvProfileProjectPoints},
    getOverlayLayer:()=>overlayLayer};
  install();
})();
